articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.en: The show floor was packed with the latest advancements across construction, aggregate, concrete and lifting. Attendees explored:
paras.zh: 展厅里充满了建筑、骨料、混凝土和起重方面的最新进展。与会者探讨：

paras.en: • New and upgraded equipment and machinery in action
paras.zh: • 新的和升级的设备和机械投入使用

paras.en: • Advances in automation, electrification and equipment intelligence
paras.zh: • 自动化、电气化和设备智能化的进步

paras.en: • Digital tools focused on productivity, fleet management and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.en: • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability
paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

paras.en: Hands on demos and a live equipment showcase gave attendees the opportunity to see innovations in action and understand how they can be applied on real jobsites.
paras.zh: 动手演示和现场设备展示让与会者有机会看到创新的实际应用，并了解如何将它们应用到实际工作现场。

paras.en: Technology continued to be a major focus at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026. Exhibitors and education sessions highlighted these key updates as transformational in construction operations:
paras.zh: 技术仍然是 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 的主要焦点。参展商和教育会议强调了这些关键更新对建筑运营的变革：

paras.en: • Digital workflows and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 数字化工作流程和工地可视性

paras.en: • Sustainability and emissions reduction
paras.zh: • 可持续发展和减排

paras.en: • Workforce challenges and talent development
paras.zh: • 劳动力挑战和人才发展

paras.en: Together, these topics reflected an industry adapting to change while looking toward long term growth.
paras.zh: 这些主题共同反映了行业在适应变化的同时寻求长期增长。

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction
paras.zh: 展望未来：建筑业的未来

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG shines a bold spotlight on the companies and innovations redefining what’s next in the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Our team’s conversations and key learnings will help shape our strategies for the coming year, and we’re committed to driving progress!
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 大胆聚焦于重新定义建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来发展的公司和创新。我们团队的对话和重要经验将有助于制定来年的战略，我们致力于推动进步！

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿式摩擦摩擦片生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩建空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场要求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

paras.en: Looking for a friction products partner for your next off-highway equipment build? Fill out the form below to connect with the Carlisle Brake & Friction India team and discuss your project needs.
paras.zh: 正在为您的下一个非公路设备制造寻找摩擦产品合作伙伴？填写下面的表格，与卡莱尔制动和摩擦印度团队联系并讨论您的项目需求。

articles.title: Payment Assist and Spense partner to streamline motor trade payments
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Payment Assist and Spense partner to streamline motor trade payments
paras.zh: Payment Assist 与 Spense 合作简化汽车贸易支付

paras.en: Flexible finance provider Payment Assist has formed a strategic partnership with automotive payment technology specialist Spense to enhance cashflow and reduce administrative burdens for UK bodyshops, franchised dealers, and service departments.
paras.zh: 灵活的金融提供商 Payment Assist 与汽车支付技术专家 Spense 建立了战略合作伙伴关系，以增强现金流并减轻英国车身修理厂、特许经销商和服务部门的管理负担。

paras.en: The agreement integrates Payment Assist’s Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solutions directly into Spense’s digital dealer platform. By automating the billing journey, the system generates and dispatches digital invoices via SMS or email, enabling motorists to settle bills online prior to vehicle collection. Automatic reconciliation instantly matches payments against invoices while offering real-time visibility across departments, saving retailers an average of 15 minutes per customer by eliminating manual tasks.
paras.zh: 该协议将 Payment Assist 的“先买后付”(BNPL) 解决方案直接集成到 Spense 的数字经销商平台中。通过自动化计费过程，系统通过短信或电子邮件生成和发送数字发票，使驾车者能够在取车前在线结算账单。自动对账可立即将付款与发票进行匹配，同时提供跨部门的实时可见性，通过消除手动任务，为零售商平均为每个客户节省 15 分钟的时间。

paras.en: Marcus Gregory, CEO of Payment Assist, said: “By partnering with Spense, we’re making it even easier for motorists to spread the cost of vehicle servicing, while subsequently helping dealers to carefully manage digital payments, improve cashflow and reduce manual administration. This not only streamlines efficiencies, but allows staff to focus their attention on maximising sales and prioritising exceptional customer service. While our immediate collective focus is franchised dealers and their service departments across the UK, collaborating with Spense supports our long-term internationalisation strategy thanks to its impressive European footprint.”
paras.zh: Payment Assist 首席执行官马库斯·格雷戈里 (Marcus Gregory) 表示：“通过与 Spense 合作，我们使驾驶者能够更轻松地分摊车辆维修成本，同时帮助经销商仔细管理数字支付、改善现金流并减少人工管理。这不仅提高了效率，而且使员工能够将注意力集中在销售最大化和优先考虑卓越的客户服务上。虽然我们当前的集体重点是英国各地的特许经销商及其服务部门，但与 Spense 的合作支持我们的长期发展国际化战略得益于其令人印象深刻的欧洲足迹。”

paras.en: Officially launching at Automotive Management LIVE at Birmingham’s NEC, the integration also marks a key milestone for Spense’s UK market entry. Didrik Jarlsby, vice president of sales & partnerships at Spense, noted that UK dealer groups specifically requested Payment Assist’s BNPL products on the platform. Echoing this, Payment Assist’s chief commercial officer Chris Masters highlighted that the collaboration combines deep sector expertise to give retailers greater choice and drivers more flexible ways to manage vehicle repair costs.
paras.zh: 此次整合在伯明翰 NEC 的 Automotive Management LIVE 上正式推出，也标志着 Spense 进入英国市场的一个重要里程碑。 Spense 销售与合作伙伴副总裁 Didrik Jarlsby 指出，英国经销商团体特别要求在该平台上使用 Payment Assist 的 BNPL 产品。 Payment Assist 首席商务官 Chris Masters 对此表示赞同，强调此次合作结合了深厚的行业专业知识，为零售商提供更多选择，为驾驶员提供更灵活的方式来管理车辆维修成本。

articles.title: Mitchell, Tractable to Transform Collision Intake Through Automated Vehicle Inspection and Estimating
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Mitchell announced plans to expand its collaboration with Tractable through a proposed, exclusive agreement focused on optimizing the vehicle intake process. By connecting Tractable’s LumaScanner vehicle inspection system with Mitchell’s automated estimating solution, Mitchell Intelligent Estimating, the companies intend to help North American multi-site operators and independent collision repair centers accelerate damage assessment and preliminary estimate creation.
paras.zh: Mitchell 宣布计划通过一项拟议的独家协议扩大与 Tractable 的合作，该协议专注于优化车辆进气流程。通过将 Tractable 的 LumaScanner 车辆检查系统与 Mitchell 的自动估算解决方案 Mitchell 智能估算连接起来，两家公司打算帮助北美多站点运营商和独立碰撞维修中心加快损害评估和初步估算的创建。

paras.en: “Every decision about a vehicle, whether to service it, repair it or sell it, depends on knowing its true condition,” said Venkat Sathyamurthy, CEO of Tractable. “Our ambition for LumaScanner is to make that knowledge available to everyone who relies on it, anytime, anywhere. Integrating LumaScanner with Mitchell’s intelligent solutions will bring that vision into the heart of collision repair, extending the value of the inspection into the estimating process itself.”
paras.zh: Tractable 首席执行官 Venkat Sathyamurthy 表示：“关于车辆的每一个决定，无论是保养、修理还是出售，都取决于了解其真实状况。” “我们对 LumaScanner 的目标是让每个依赖它的人随时随地都能获得这些知识。将 LumaScanner 与 Mitchell 的智能解决方案集成将把这一愿景带入碰撞修复的核心，将检查的价值延伸到评估过程本身。”

paras.en: As a vehicle passes through, LumaScanner automatically inspects it and produces a condition report: a consistent, time-stamped record of the vehicle’s physical state. Once integrated with Mitchell’s cloud ecosystem, that condition report could feed Mitchell Intelligent Estimating to automatically generate a preliminary estimate for appraisers to review and edit.
paras.zh: 当车辆经过时，LumaScanner 会自动对其进行检查并生成一份状况报告：一致的、带有时间戳的车辆物理状态记录。一旦与米切尔的云生态系统集成，该状况报告可以为米切尔智能估算提供信息，自动生成初步估算供评估人员审查和编辑。

paras.en: Together with Mitchell’s existing mobile photo-capture capabilities, the planned offering would give repairers the flexibility to document vehicle damage through either a physical or digital intake process. In AI estimating, capturing high-quality images of the damaged vehicle increases the accuracy and completeness of the preliminary estimate.
paras.zh: 与米切尔现有的移动照片捕捉功能相结合，计划中的产品将使维修人员能够灵活地通过物理或数字接收过程记录车辆损坏情况。在人工智能估算中，捕获受损车辆的高质量图像可以提高初步估算的准确性和完整性。

paras.en: With LumaScanner, the vehicle is driven or towed through the inspection system and the vehicle image set and condition report will be used to generate a preliminary estimate in minutes. This is designed to save time and assist in improving estimate accuracy and completeness.
paras.zh: 借助 LumaScanner，车辆可以通过检查系统进行驾驶或牵引，车辆图像集和状况报告将用于在几分钟内生成初步估计。这样做的目的是节省时间并帮助提高估算的准确性和完整性。

paras.en: “Our goal is to help collision repairers simplify the vehicle intake process by connecting innovative technologies that are designed to optimize key steps in the workflow,” said Olivier Baudoux, senior vice president of global product strategy and artificial intelligence at Mitchell. “Combining LumaScanner’s automated inspection capabilities with Mitchell’s advanced solutions, proprietary data and open, cloud-based platform is intended to give repairers a way to remove friction, improve productivity and safely return collision-damaged vehicles to the road.”
paras.zh: Mitchell 全球产品战略和人工智能高级副总裁 Olivier Baudoux 表示：“我们的目标是通过连接旨在优化工作流程中关键步骤的创新技术，帮助碰撞维修人员简化车辆接收流程。” “将 LumaScanner 的自动检测功能与 Mitchell 的先进解决方案、专有数据和基于云的开放平台相结合，旨在为维修人员提供一种消除摩擦、提高生产率并将碰撞损坏车辆安全返回道路的方法。”

paras.en: For more information on Mitchell, visit mitchell.com.
paras.zh: 有关米切尔的更多信息，请访问 mitchell.com。

paras.en: For more information on Tractable, visit tractable.ai.
paras.zh: 有关 Tractable 的更多信息，请访问tractable.ai。

articles.title: SEMA Show Spotlights AI Repair Tools, ADAS Calibration and More
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The 2026 SEMA Show concluded four days at the Las Vegas Convention Center, bringing together more than 150,000 industry professionals, media and enthusiasts from 140 countries and more than 2,200 exhibiting brands, including 400 first-time exhibitors.
paras.zh: 2026 SEMA Show 在拉斯维加斯会议中心结束四天，汇聚了来自 140 个国家的超过 150,000 名行业专业人士、媒体和爱好者以及 2,200 多个参展品牌，其中包括 400 家首次参展商。

paras.en: The event served as a global marketplace for the automotive aftermarket, an industry that generates $383 billion in annual economic impact, supports 1.25 million jobs and produces $107.7 billion in wages nationwide. Across the show campus, manufacturers, buyers, builders, educators and media connected around products, technologies and relationships driving the market forward.
paras.zh: 该活动是汽车售后市场的全球市场，该行业每年产生 3,830 亿美元的经济影响，支持 125 万个就业岗位，并在全国范围内创造 1,077 亿美元的工资。在整个展会园区，制造商、买家、建筑商、教育工作者和媒体围绕产品、技术和关系相互联系，推动市场向前发展。

paras.en: “The SEMA Show reflects the scale, creativity and economic importance of the automotive aftermarket,” said Mike Spagnola, CEO of SEMA. “This year’s event built on that foundation with an expanded powersports and motorcycle presence, advancements in emerging propulsion technologies, automation and smart manufacturing, and new opportunities to connect with consumers. Those developments underscore the strength of the market and the opportunities emerging across the industry.”
paras.zh: “SEMA 展会反映了汽车售后市场的规模、创造力和经济重要性，”SEMA 首席执行官 Mike Spagnola 说道。 “今年的活动建立在这一基础上，扩大了动力运动和摩托车的影响力，新兴推进技术、自动化和智能制造的进步，以及与消费者联系的新机会。这些发展凸显了市场的实力和整个行业正在出现的机遇。”

paras.en: New Products Translate Technology into Practical Solutions
paras.zh: 新产品将技术转化为实用的解决方案

paras.en: The 2026 SEMA Show highlighted an automotive aftermarket focused on turning emerging technologies into practical, market-ready solutions. Thousands of products were entered in the New Products Showcase and debuted across the show floor, reflecting advances in AI-enabled repair tools, ADAS calibration equipment, connected technology and performance components.
paras.zh: 2026 年 SEMA 展会重点关注汽车售后市场，重点是将新兴技术转化为实用的、面向市场的解决方案。数千种产品进入新产品展示区并在整个展厅首次亮相，反映出人工智能维修工具、ADAS 校准设备、互联技术和性能组件方面的进步。

paras.en: Key trends included the growing use of AI to streamline repair procedures and shop operations; greater integration of technology, durability and functionality into truck, off-road and powersports products; and continued improvements in performance and comfort for classic vehicles.
paras.zh: 主要趋势包括越来越多地使用人工智能来简化维修程序和车间运营；将技术、耐用性和功能更好地融入卡车、越野和动力运动产品中；以及经典车辆性能和舒适度的持续改进。

paras.en: Automakers Use SEMA as a Launch Platform
paras.zh: 汽车制造商使用 SEMA 作为发布平台

paras.en: Major automakers and performance organizations participated throughout the week, reinforcing the show’s role as a global meeting place where OEMs and aftermarket innovation intersect.
paras.zh: 主要汽车制造商和表演组织参加了整个星期，强化了该展会作为原始设备制造商和售后市场创新交叉的全球聚会场所的作用。

paras.en: - Ford Motor Company unveiled a ’66 Ford Racing R125 Mustang Fastback, a heritage-inspired vehicle built with Ford Racing parts to mark the organization’s 125th anniversary.
paras.zh: - 福特汽车公司推出了 '66 Ford Racing R125 Mustang Fastback，这是一款采用福特赛车零件制造的传统风格车辆，以纪念该公司成立 125 周年。

paras.en: - Honda Racing Corp. (Honda/Acura) showcased the recently unveiled Passport Baja Spec Trophy Truck, Passport TrailSport Baja Chase and HRC Performance Parts for the Civic Type R, Integra Type S and Passport TrailSport.
paras.zh: - Honda Racing Corp.（本田/讴歌）展示了最近推出的 Passport Baja Spec Trophy 卡车、Passport TrailSport Baja Chase 以及 Civic Type R、Integra Type S 和 Passport TrailSport 的 HRC 性能部件。

paras.en: - Mitsubishi unveiled its 2028 Outlander Diamond Trail Edition in a global debut.
paras.zh: - 三菱在全球首发推出了 2028 年 Outlander Diamond Trail Edition。

paras.en: - Nissan unveiled new Frontier, Pathfinder and Armada concepts, along with a Sentra Spec-V and two enthusiast-inspired Z concepts.
paras.zh: - 日产推出了新的 Frontier、Pathfinder 和 Armada 概念车，以及 Sentra Spec-V 和两款受发烧友启发的 Z 概念车。

paras.en: - Stellantis, through Dodge, Jeep and Mopar, unveiled its Jeep Wrangler Scrambler SRT Concept, showcased its Jeep Wrangler BUZZCUT concept and introduced an all-new series of crate engine packages through Direct Connection, the factory-backed performance arm of Stellantis’ SRT performance division.
paras.zh: - Stellantis 通过道奇、Jeep 和 Mopar 推出了 Jeep Wrangler Scrambler SRT 概念车，展示了 Jeep Wrangler BUZZCUT 概念车，并通过 Stellantis SRT 性能部门工厂支持的性能部门 Direct Connection 推出了全新系列的板条箱发动机套件。

paras.en: - Toyota introduced its Snowhunter Concept lineup, featuring the Tundra, Tacoma, 4Runner, Land Cruiser and Sequoia.
paras.zh: - 丰田推出了 Snowhunter 概念车系列，包括 Tundra、Tacoma、4Runner、Land Cruiser 和 Sequoia。

paras.en: Expanded Powersports Section Broadens Business Opportunities
paras.zh: 扩大的动力运动部分拓宽了商业机会

paras.en: The expanded Powersports, Side-by-Side (SxS) and Adventure Lifestyle section featured dirt bikes, motorcycles, side-by-sides, trailers, tow vehicles, gear and adventure-lifestyle products. The section brought together brands and industry organizations, including Harley-Davidson, Kawasaki Motors Corp., Yamaha Watercraft, Kymco USA Inc., Inferno Eyewear, Denago, Shock Therapy and the National Powersports Dealers Association.
paras.zh: 扩展后的动力运动、并排 (SxS) 和冒险生活方式部分以越野车、摩托车、并排、拖车、牵引车、装备和冒险生活方式产品为特色。该部分汇集了品牌和行业组织，包括哈雷戴维森、川崎汽车公司、雅马哈船艇、Kymco USA Inc.、Inferno Eyewear、Denago、Shock Therapy 和国家动力运动经销商协会。

paras.en: Its placement gave attendees opportunities to explore new business categories while providing a high-visibility platform for exhibitors such as Massimo Motor, a manufacturer and distributor of powersports vehicles, UTVs, ATVs and mobility solutions.
paras.zh: 它的布置为与会者提供了探索新业务类别的机会，同时为动力运动车辆、UTV、ATV 和移动解决方案的制造商和经销商 Massimo Motor 等参展商提供了一个高知名度的平台。

paras.en: “We’re really excited to be here because we launched the Sentinel 1500, as well as the Warrior 1500,” said Ron Luttrell, vice president of dealer development for Massimo Motor. “It was the first time the public had seen them, so launching at SEMA was important to us. The feedback has been overwhelmingly positive for both of those units, the brand and the other units we displayed.”
paras.zh: Massimo Motor 经销商开发副总裁 Ron Luttrell 表示：“我们很高兴来到这里，因为我们推出了 Sentinel 1500 和 Warrior 1500。” “这是公众第一次看到它们，所以在 SEMA 上发布对我们来说很重要。对于这些装置、品牌和我们展示的其他装置来说，反馈都是非常积极的。”

paras.en: SEMA Battle of the Builders Presented by Mothers expanded in 2026 with the addition of the Bike Builder Shootout, recognizing standout motorcycle builds. More than 50 motorcycles were entered into the competition with Steven Iacona earning the inaugural championship for his customized Harley Davidson Knucklehead.
paras.zh: 由 Mothers 主办的 SEMA 建造者之战于 2026 年扩大规模，增加了自行车建造者大战，以表彰杰出的摩托车建造者。超过 50 辆摩托车参加了比赛，Steven Iacona 凭借他定制的哈雷戴维森 Knucklehead 赢得了首届冠军。

paras.en: “I am truly grateful for this honor,” said Iacona. “The entire event was incredible. The competition was difficult, but I will absolutely be back next year. Thank you to everyone at SEMA for inviting custom bike builders to participate. It was amazing.”
paras.zh: “我真的很感激这项荣誉，”艾科纳说。 “整个活动令人难以置信。比赛很困难，但明年我绝对会回来。感谢 SEMA 邀请定制自行车制造商参加的所有人。太棒了。”

paras.en: Developing the Next Generation of Skilled Professionals
paras.zh: 培养下一代技术熟练的专业人员

paras.en: Preparing the next generation of industry talent was another theme of the 2026 SEMA Show, with hands-on experiences and education connecting students with career opportunities in the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 培养下一代行业人才是 2026 年 SEMA 展会的另一个主题，通过实践经验和教育将学生与汽车售后市场的职业机会联系起来。

paras.en: In the inaugural Ford Custom Garage Ultimate Build Competition, six Washtenaw Community College students brought an attendee-designed Ford Bronco to life, building the vehicle live in the Ford booth before its Friday reveal.
paras.zh: 在首届福特定制车库终极建造大赛中，六名沃什特诺社区学院的学生将一辆由与会者设计的福特野马变为现实，并在周五发布之前在福特展位上现场建造了该车辆。

paras.en: The SEMA Show Student Program reached a milestone, attracting more than 1,000 students, an all-time high. Education sessions highlighted workforce development strategies and ways companies can connect with emerging talent and recruit future employees.
paras.zh: SEMA Show 学生计划达到了一个里程碑，吸引了超过 1,000 名学生，创历史新高。教育会议强调了劳动力发展战略以及公司与新兴人才建立联系和招聘未来员工的方式。

paras.en: The program was part of SEMA Education, which featured education sessions across multiple SEMA-led and partner tracks.
paras.zh: 该计划是 SEMA 教育的一部分，其特色是跨多个 SEMA 主导和合作伙伴轨道的教育课程。

paras.en: Eddie Pettus won the 2026 SEMA Battle of the Builders Presented by Mothers competition with his ’70 Chevrolet Chevelle.
paras.zh: Eddie Pettus 驾驶着他的 70 款雪佛兰 Chevelle 赢得了 2026 年 SEMA 建造者之战，由母亲主办。

paras.en: Thomas Kincer of Kincer Chassis won the 2026 SEMA Best Engineered Vehicle of the Year Award for his ’77 Ford F-100. The annual award recognizes a feature vehicle at the SEMA Show that demonstrates exceptional engineering.
paras.zh: Kincer Chassis 的 Thomas Kincer 凭借其 '77 福特 F-100 荣获 2026 年 SEMA 年度最佳工程车辆奖。该年度奖项旨在表彰 SEMA 展会上展示卓越工程设计的特色车辆。

paras.en: Friday Expands Industry-Consumer Connection
paras.zh: 周五扩大行业与消费者的联系

paras.en: On Nov. 6, SEMA Show Friday — Open to the Public welcomed enthusiasts to experience the exhibit halls, vehicle builds and demonstrations. The SEMA Cruise carried show vehicles out of the convention center, while SEMA Fest continued the celebration with performances by The Offspring, Jimmy Eat World, 311 and The Alive.
paras.zh: 11 月 6 日，SEMA Show Friday — 向公众开放，欢迎爱好者前来体验展厅、车辆制造和演示。 SEMA Cruise 将展示车辆运出会议中心，而 SEMA Fest 则通过 The Offspring、Jimmy Eat World、311 和 The Alive 的表演继续庆祝活动。

paras.en: SEMA Live presented by AutoZone delivered 32 hours of scheduled coverage from the show campus on SEMA’s YouTube and Facebook channels. Coverage included product and vehicle reveals, interviews, outdoor demonstrations, Battle of the Builders and the SEMA Cruise. Highlights and on-demand coverage from the 2026 event are available through SEMA’s YouTube and Facebook channels.
paras.zh: AutoZone 主办的 SEMA Live 在 SEMA 的 YouTube 和 Facebook 频道上对展会园区进行了 32 小时的预定报道。报道内容包括产品和车辆展示、采访、户外演示、建造者之战和 SEMA 巡游。 2026 年活动的亮点和点播报道可通过 SEMA 的 YouTube 和 Facebook 频道观看。

paras.en: As a catalyst for commerce across the aftermarket, the SEMA Show connects the people, products and ideas that help businesses grow and the industry prosper. The show returns to Las Vegas Nov. 2-5, 2027 for its 60th anniversary, and exhibitors are encouraged to plan early: the priority booth-space application deadline has moved up to Feb. 1, 2027.
paras.zh: 作为整个售后市场商业的催化剂，SEMA 展会将人员、产品和创意联系起来，帮助企业发展和行业繁荣。该展会将于 2027 年 11 月 2 日至 5 日重返拉斯维加斯，庆祝其成立 60 周年，鼓励参展商尽早计划：优先展位申请截止日期已提前至 2027 年 2 月 1 日。

paras.en: Visit semashow.com for more information.
paras.zh: 请访问 semashow.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: South Carolina’s governor-elect holds first press conference at auto body shop
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Alan Wilson, South Carolina’s next governor, held his first press conference after the mid-term election at a West Columbia body shop where he worked his first job at 15, according to local media.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，南卡罗来纳州下一任州长艾伦·威尔逊 (Alan Wilson) 在西哥伦比亚的一家车身修理厂举行了中期选举后的首次新闻发布会，他 15 岁时就在那里开始了第一份工作。

paras.en: The governor-elect said he worked at Reeley’s Auto Body shop as a car washer.
paras.zh: 这位当选州长说，他在里利汽车车身店担任洗车工。

paras.en: He told the media that the shop is symbolic.
paras.zh: 他告诉媒体，这家商店具有象征意义。

paras.en: “A shop like this is where you come to fix a car, repair a car, improve a car, and that’s really what this transition is about,” News19 reports Wilson as saying.
paras.zh: 据 News19 报道，威尔逊表示：“像这样的商店是你修理汽车、修理汽车、改进汽车的地方，这就是这次转变的真正目的。”

paras.en: He said his transition into the role is repairing and improving a governmental system that is “broken or damaged.”
paras.zh: 他表示，他的过渡是为了修复和改善“破碎或受损”的政府系统。

paras.en: Wilson, current Attorney General, said an audit of the state’s government will be his first course of action. This will include a public website that publishes government data for the general public.
paras.zh: 现任总检察长威尔逊表示，对州政府进行审计将是他的首要行动方针。这将包括一个向公众发布政府数据的公共网站。

paras.en: He also said he will ask lawmakers to give the governor the power to temporarily suspend the gas tax during price spikes. He added that the neighboring Georgia governor has this authority.
paras.zh: 他还表示，他将要求立法者赋予州长在价格上涨期间暂时停止征收汽油税的权力。他补充说，邻近的佐治亚州州长拥有这一权力。

paras.en: “I also understand that we rely on the gas tax to fund infrastructure projects and road construction,” News19 reports Wilson as saying. He adds that the power will need guardrails.
paras.zh: 据 News19 报道，威尔逊表示：“我还了解到，我们依靠燃油税来资助基础设施项目和道路建设。”他补充说，电力需要护栏。

paras.en: Improving roads and bridges has been a part of Wilson’s campaign platform.
paras.zh: 改善道路和桥梁一直是威尔逊竞选纲领的一部分。

paras.en: “As part of his Families First Audit Initiative, he will modernize the Department of Transportation, demand transparency, streamline project timelines, and make sure every region of the state benefits from long-overdue improvements,” Wilson’s campaign website says. “Wilson understands rural communities have different infrastructure needs than urban communities. But we can’t prioritize one over the other–they both need attention.”
paras.zh: 威尔逊的竞选网站称，“作为家庭优先审计计划的一部分，他将实现交通部的现代化，要求透明度，简化项目时间表，并确保该州的每个地区都从早该进行的改进中受益。” “威尔逊了解农村社区与城市社区的基础设施需求不同。但我们不能优先考虑其中一个——它们都需要关注。”

paras.en: Fox Carolina previously reported that lowering insurance premiums is a part of Wilson’s plan. This includes reforming the Department of Insurance to allow for public audits of rate increases. He’d also required the department to give quarterly updates to the governor’s office and yearly reports on major carriers to the public.
paras.zh: 福克斯卡罗莱纳州此前报道称，降低保险费是威尔逊计划的一部分。这包括改革保险部，以允许对加息进行公开审计。他还要求该部门每季度向州长办公室提供最新情况，并向公众提供有关主要航空公司的年度报告。

paras.en: South Carolina’s insurance commissioner position is appointed by the governor.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州的保险专员职位由州长任命。

articles.title: Hyundai recalls vehicles for software malfunction that disables airbag
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Hyundai has recalled 37,901 vehicles due to a software malfunction that disables the airbag, according to a National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) report.
paras.zh: 根据美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 的报告，现代汽车因软件故障导致安全气囊失效而召回了 37,901 辆汽车。

paras.en: The recall includes 2019-2022 Hyundai Veloster and 2019-2023 Hyundai Kona Electric models.
paras.zh: 此次召回包括 2019-2022 年款现代 Veloster 和 2019-2023 年款现代 Kona Electric 车型。

paras.en: “The subject vehicles are equipped with an Airbag Control Unit (ACU) that detects crash signals and commands deployment of the airbag(s) and seat belt pretensioner(s),” the recall states. ”Under certain driving conditions, data may become corrupted during routine writing to the ACU’s memory, causing the airbag malfunction indicator light (MIL) to illuminate and the airbag system to deactivate.”
paras.zh: 召回声明称：“受影响的车辆配备了安全气囊控制单元（ACU），可以检测碰撞信号并命令展开安全气囊和安全带预紧器。” “在某些驾驶条件下，数据在对 ACU 内存进行例行写入期间可能会损坏，导致安全气囊故障指示灯 (MIL) 亮起并且安全气囊系统停用。”

paras.en: A deactivated airbag system may not deploy the vehicle’s airbags during a crash, increasing the risk of injury to vehicle occupants.
paras.zh: 停用的安全气囊系统在发生碰撞时可能无法展开车辆的安全气囊，从而增加车辆乘员受伤的风险。

paras.en: “A system reboot or power interruption while the ACU is writing data to its internal memory may result in data corruption,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“ACU 将数据写入内存时，系统重新启动或电源中断可能会导致数据损坏。”

paras.en: Hyundai started an investigation in August, 2024 after receiving an increase in airbag warning light warranty claims.
paras.zh: 现代汽车在收到安全气囊警告灯保修索赔增加后于 2024 年 8 月开始调查。

paras.en: The automaker worked with ACU supplier ZF Group to conduct a series of technical reviews of recovered parts. The reviews included focusing on fault-detection conditions and proposed replication methods.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商与 ACU 供应商采埃孚集团合作，对回收零件进行了一系列技术审查。审查的重点包括故障检测条件和提出的复制方法。

paras.en: The two companies also performed electrical stress testing and held multiple vehicle-level replication tests in 2025.
paras.zh: 两家公司还进行了电气压力测试，并在 2025 年进行了多次车辆级复制测试。

paras.en: By October 2026, Hyundai was updating its field data analysis and began finalizing its findings to date for review by its North America Safety Decision Authority (NASDA).
paras.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，现代汽车正在更新其现场数据分析，并开始最终确定迄今为止的调查结果，以供北美安全决策局 (NASDA) 审查。

paras.en: After reviewing the investigation findings, the company decided to conduct a safety recall, the report states.
paras.zh: 报告称，在审查调查结果后，该公司决定进行安全召回。

paras.en: As of November, Hyundai is aware of 331 unique incidents reported from October 2019 through September of this year.
paras.zh: 截至 11 月，现代汽车已获悉从 2019 年 10 月到今年 9 月报告的 331 起独特事件。

paras.en: The report adds that no crashes, fires, or injuries have been related to this condition.
paras.zh: 报告补充说，目前还没有与这种情况相关的撞车、火灾或受伤事故。

paras.en: Owners are instructed to bring their vehicle to a Hyundai dealer for an ACU software update. The remedy will be offered at no cost to owners for all affected vehicles.
paras.zh: 车主应将车辆带到现代经销商处进行 ACU 软件更新。所有受影响车辆的车主将免费获得补救措施。

paras.en: NHTSA announced last week that it will invest $1.5 million to help states improve vehicle recall rates to keep roads safe.
paras.zh: NHTSA 上周宣布将投资 150 万美元帮助各州提高车辆召回率，以确保道路安全。

paras.en: “A vehicle with an open recall creates an avoidable hazard on our roads,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in a news release. “By giving states the resources to flag open recalls when drivers register or renew their vehicles, we can keep dangerous cars off our roads and American families safe.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 局长乔纳森·莫里森 (Jonathan Morrison) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“公开召回的车辆对我们的道路造成了本可避免的危险。” “通过向各州提供资源，在司机注册或更新车辆时标记公开召回，我们可以让危险车辆远离我们的道路，并保证美国家庭的安全。”

paras.en: - “The development and execution of a reliable process to inform vehicle owners of any open safety recalls when registering their vehicles
paras.zh: - “制定并执行可靠的流程，在登记车辆时通知车主任何公开的安全召回

paras.en: - “Data-driven methods to measure recall completions
paras.zh: -“衡量召回完成情况的数据驱动方法

paras.en: - “Comprehensive reports outlining the methodologies and processes used so best practices can be shared.”
paras.zh: - “综合报告概述了所使用的方法和流程，以便共享最佳实践。”

paras.en: Morrison announced the funding during a “Recalls Next: Technological Innovation & Safety Recalls” event.
paras.zh: 莫里森在“下一步召回：技术创新与安全召回”活动中宣布了这笔资金。

paras.en: NHTSA learned during the Takata airbag recalls that convincing consumers to remedy a recall is complicated, he said. Researchers found some consumers were confused about what the recall meant or simply didn’t remember receiving the notices.
paras.zh: 他说，国家公路交通安全管理局在高田安全气囊召回事件中了解到，说服消费者对召回进行补救是很复杂的。研究人员发现，一些消费者对召回的含义感到困惑，或者根本不记得收到过通知。

paras.en: “That’s troubling, because it means they didn’t necessarily ignore a serious warning,” Morrison said. “Some didn’t internalize the danger at all. The notices didn’t convey to them that a defective inflator could rupture and send metal shrapnel toward their faces—even when the notices literally said as much. It didn’t resonate that they – or someone they loved – could die if they didn’t act—even when informed through multiple channels.”
paras.zh: 莫里森说：“这令人不安，因为这意味着他们不一定忽视严重警告。” “有些人根本没有意识到危险。通知并没有告诉他们，有缺陷的充气机可能会破裂，并将金属弹片射向他们的脸——即使通知上确实说了这么多。他们——或者他们所爱的人——如果不采取行动，可能会死亡——即使通过多种渠道告知，这并没有引起他们的共鸣。”

paras.en: NHTSA oversaw nearly 900 vehicle safety recalls affecting more than 29 million vehicles last year. The agency’s data shows 3-year-old vehicles have an average completion rate of 68%, while 15-year-old vehicles have an 18% completion rate.
paras.zh: 去年，NHTSA 监管了近 900 起车辆安全召回事件，影响了超过 2900 万辆汽车。该机构的数据显示，车龄3年的车辆平均完成率为68%，而车龄15年的车辆平均完成率为18%。

paras.en: “Surveys tell us that about four in 10 owners named inconvenience as a main reason for not completing a recall,” Morrison said. “That should be taken seriously.”
paras.zh: 莫里森说：“调查显示，大约十分之四的车主将不便视为未完成召回的主要原因。” “这应该被认真对待。”

paras.en: State motor vehicle agencies have been effective partners in amplifying research messaging, he said. He added that during the Takata recall, DMV letters sometimes produced repair rates two to three times higher than manufacturer notices alone.
paras.zh: 他说，国家机动车辆机构在扩大研究信息方面一直是有效的合作伙伴。他补充说，在高田召回期间，DMV 信件产生的维修率有时比制造商单独通知的维修率高出两到三倍。

paras.en: People recognize their DMV as an authoritative source of information that provides mail for critical transactional purposes linked to the ability to drive, Morrison said.
paras.zh: 莫里森说，人们将DMV视为权威信息来源，为与驾驶能力相关的关键交易目的提供邮件。

paras.en: “If somebody sees the DMV logo on an official piece of mail and doesn’t open it, their driver’s license or vehicle registration might expire, which is connected to their ability to work, run errands, take care of family, and generally participate in society,” he explained. “Registration renewal creates a natural opportunity to reach an owner with information that matters.”
paras.zh: “如果有人在官方邮件上看到 DMV 标志但没有打开它，他们的驾驶执照或车辆登记可能会过期，这与他们工作、办事、照顾家庭和普遍参与社会的能力有关，”他解释道。 “注册续订创造了一个自然的机会，可以向业主提供重要信息。”

paras.en: Morrison said NHTSA has also seen improvements in recall completions through other state avenues, such as Virginia’s EZPass toll collection system. The collaboration produced Takata recall completion rates eight to 10 times higher than comparable methods.
paras.zh: 莫里森表示，NHTSA 还发现其他州渠道（例如弗吉尼亚州的 EZPass 收费系统）的召回完成率有所提高。此次合作使高田召回完成率比同类方法高出 8 至 10 倍。

paras.en: A collaboration with a vehicle auction company also resulted in repairs on about 90% of vehicles traded in with open recalls, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，与一家汽车拍卖公司的合作还导致约 90% 的公开召回车辆得到了维修。

paras.en: NHTSA also recently launched a bulk VIN lookup tool that allows users to check up to 100 VINs at once for open safety recalls, making searches easier for dealerships, fleet operators and others managing multiple vehicles, Morrison said.
paras.zh: 莫里森说，NHTSA 最近还推出了批量 VIN 查找工具，允许用户一次检查多达 100 个 VIN，以进行公开安全召回，从而使经销商、车队运营商和其他管理多辆车辆的其他人更容易进行搜索。

paras.en: The agency has opened a public docket for feedback on recalls. Comments will be accepted here through Dec. 5.
paras.zh: 该机构已公开征求有关召回的反馈意见。在此之前，我们将在 12 月 5 日之前接受评论。

articles.title: Arapahoe Community College Wins  AAPEX Engine Build
articles.author: Frank Strong

paras.en: A pair of high school students concurrently enrolled in automotive classes at Arapahoe Community College, won the 2026 AAPEX Student Competition. John Parmley, 16, and Schafer Eirich, 18, shaved more than an hour off the winning time from last year’s competition. The duo tore down and rebuilt a V8 engine in front of a live audience that was hundreds of people deep, in just 39 minutes and 11 seconds.
paras.zh: 两名同时就读阿拉帕霍社区学院汽车课程的高中生赢得了 2026 年 AAPEX 学生竞赛。 16 岁的约翰·帕姆利 (John Parmley) 和 18 岁的谢弗·艾里奇 (Schafer Eirich) 比去年的比赛缩短了一个多小时的获胜时间。两人在数百人的现场观众面前拆解并重建了一台 V8 发动机，仅用时 39 分 11 秒。

paras.en: “It’s absolutely surreal,” said Eirich, following the competition. “We’ve been working toward this for so long; we saw it [the inaugural competition] last year and we knew in that moment we needed to do this.”
paras.zh: “这绝对是超现实的，”艾里奇在比赛结束后说道。 “我们为此努力了很长时间；去年我们看到了[首届比赛]，那一刻我们就知道我们需要这样做。”

paras.en: The competition tests the basic auto technician skills these students are learning. Each team starts with a small-block Chevy V8 engine and must dismantle the engine, including the pistons, crankshaft and camshaft. A judge then confirms the team has met the disassembly standard and the team races to rebuild it. The engine must turn when assembled; the fastest team wins.
paras.zh: 该比赛测试了这些学生正在学习的基本汽车技师技能。每个团队都从小型雪佛兰 V8 发动机开始，必须拆卸发动机，包括活塞、曲轴和凸轮轴。然后，法官确认该团队已达到拆卸标准，并开始进行重建。组装时发动机必须转动；最快的队伍获胜。

paras.en: “They’re amazing,” said Bob Parmley, the team’s coach and automotive instructor at the community college. “To build a champion team like this, it takes two guys who are willing to show up and work hard and take critical feedback.”
paras.zh: “他们太棒了，”社区大学车队教练兼汽车教练鲍勃·帕姆利 (Bob Parmley) 说。 “要打造一支这样的冠军团队，需要两个愿意出现、努力工作并接受批评反馈的人。”

paras.en: Through the generosity of aftermarket businesses that sponsored the event, the winning team took home an estimated $10,000 in prizes each. This included professional tool sets, which addresses one of the unique barriers for entry-level technicians and complicate the talent shortage: unlike other skilled trades, auto technicians must bring their own tools.
paras.zh: 由于售后市场企业的慷慨赞助，获胜团队每人获得了约 10,000 美元的奖金。其中包括专业工具套件，它解决了入门级技术人员的独特障碍之一，并使人才短缺变得更加复杂：与其他技术行业不同，汽车技术人员必须携带自己的工具。

paras.en: The Arapahoe team says they practiced two or three times a week for the last eight months. Finding time to practice was no small feat, given that both young men are in high school, taking college classes and also participating in school sports. However, busy schedules weren’t the only challenges the team faced.
paras.zh: 阿拉帕霍队表示，在过去的八个月里，他们每周训练两到三次。考虑到这两个年轻人都在读高中，正在上大学课程，并且还参加学校的体育运动，找到时间练习并不是一件容易的事。然而，繁忙的日程并不是团队面临的唯一挑战。

paras.en: First, John Parmley was hospitalized prior to the competition to have his appendix removed. He was unable to practice during the crucial week leading up to the competition – and yet he gutted it out alongside his partner.
paras.zh: 首先，约翰·帕姆利在比赛前住院接受阑尾切除术。他无法在比赛前的关键一周进行训练，但他和搭档一起坚持了下来。

paras.en: Second, the competition setup was a little different than they had expected. For example, they had practiced with two piston ring compressors, allowing the pair to work in tandem, but the competition only permitted each team to have one.
paras.zh: 其次，比赛的设置与他们的预期有些不同。例如，他们练习时使用了两台活塞环压缩机，允许两人串联工作，但比赛只允许每队拥有一台。

paras.en: Finally, when they arrived at the student competition, both young men were hit with nerves about the task at hand. Eirich described feeling “nauseous,” and the team was expressly worried about competing against an older team from Ferris State University.
paras.zh: 最后，当他们到达学生比赛现场时，两个年轻人都对眼前的任务感到紧张。艾里奇描述了感觉“恶心”，该团队明确担心与费里斯州立大学的老团队竞争。

paras.en: The Arapahoe team battled through these challenges anyway. They finished first in their qualifying round but second overall, behind Ferris State, as the final round began. Less than 40 minutes later, competition judge Charles Sanville, who is known in the industry as The Humble Mechanic, observed the engine turn and signaled they had won.
paras.zh: 无论如何，Arapahoe 团队都克服了这些挑战。他们在预选赛中获得第一名，但在最后一轮开始时，总体排名第二，落后于费里斯州立大学。不到 40 分钟后，比赛评委查尔斯·桑维尔（业内被称为“谦逊的机械师”）观察到发动机转动并示意他们获胜。

paras.en: “I’m still stunned by how fast these kids were,” said Bernard Tansey, a co-judge, event organizer and emcee. “The team’s preparedness and communication with each other and their coach was unparalleled. It’s obvious they put a lot of practice in, but with hundreds of people cheering just 10 feet away, it adds a level of stress and pressure you don’t get in a shop.”
paras.zh: “我仍然对这些孩子们的速度感到震惊，”共同评委、活动组织者兼主持人伯纳德·坦西 (Bernard Tansey) 说。 “球队的准备工作以及彼此之间以及教练之间的沟通是无与伦比的。很明显，他们投入了大量的练习，但是数百人在仅 10 英尺之外欢呼，这增加了你在商店中不会感受到的压力和压力。”

paras.en: Tansey owns Euro Clinic, an independent repair shop in Santa Clara, CA. He has been a dedicated volunteer and the driving force behind this competition two years in a row.
paras.zh: Tansey 拥有 Euro Clinic，这是一家位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉的独立维修店。他是一名热心的志愿者，也是连续两年这项比赛的推动者。

paras.en: Participating schools and aftermarket sponsors
paras.zh: 参与学校和售后赞助商

paras.en: Nine teams from seven schools participated in this year’s event, which is about double the schools and triple the teams that participated in the inaugural student competition last year. It takes commitment to prepare for a competition, and courage to step on a national stage and compete, so these students have distinguished themselves from their peers.
paras.zh: 来自七所学校的九支队伍参加了今年的活动，大约是去年参加首届学生比赛的学校的两倍和三倍。需要为比赛做好准备，需要勇气登上国家舞台参加比赛，所以这些学生在同龄人中脱颖而出。

paras.en: Participating schools in the 2026 AAPEX Student Competition were:
paras.zh: 参加 2026 年 AAPEX 学生竞赛的学校有：

paras.en: - Advanced Training Institute, Las Vegas, NV
paras.zh: - 高级培训学院，拉斯维加斯，内华达州

paras.en: - Arapahoe Community College, Littleton, CO
paras.zh: -阿拉帕霍社区学院，科罗拉多州利特尔顿

paras.en: - College of Southern Nevada, Las Vegas, NV
paras.zh: - 内华达州拉斯维加斯南内华达学院

paras.en: - Ferris State University, Grand Rapids, MI.
paras.zh: - 费里斯州立大学，密歇根州大急流城。

paras.en: - North Kansas City High Schools, North Kansas City, MO
paras.zh: - 密苏里州北堪萨斯城北堪萨斯城高中

paras.en: The entire event is made possible through the generosity of volunteers from the Auto Care Association Tool & Equipment Community and aftermarket businesses including:
paras.zh: 整个活动的举办得益于来自汽车护理协会工具和设备社区以及售后市场企业的志愿者的慷慨捐助，其中包括：

paras.en: For more information, visit AAPEXShow.com.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 AAPEXShow.com。

articles.title: The Basics of Wheel Speed Sensors
articles.author: Scott Shriber

paras.en: ABS wheel speed sensors provide critical data for anti-lock braking and traction control systems. Passive sensors generate a signal using a toothed ring, while active sensors provide greater accuracy, especially at low speeds.
paras.zh: ABS 轮速传感器为防抱死制动和牵引力控制系统提供关键数据。无源传感器使用齿环生成信号，而有源传感器提供更高的精度，尤其是在低速时。

paras.en: Technicians can diagnose sensor problems with a scan tool or digital multimeter. Counter pros should remember that ABS and traction control rely on the same wheel speed data.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以使用扫描工具或数字万用表诊断传感器问题。计数器专业人士应该记住，ABS 和牵引力控制系统依赖于相同的轮速数据。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by the Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: PennGrade Offers Gear Oil Fill Pouches
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn has introduced new 1-quart Precision Fill Pouches for its line of gear oils.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚一年级 | Brad Penn 为其齿轮油系列推出了新型 1 夸脱精密填充袋。

paras.en: According to the company, the pouch is designed to help reach tight and awkward fill locations where bottles can be difficult to maneuver. It features a precision-fill spout for greater control during gear oil changes and top-offs, the company added.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，该袋子的设计目的是帮助到达狭窄且尴尬的灌装位置，这些位置的瓶子很难操纵。该公司补充说，它具有精密加注嘴，可以在齿轮油更换和加注过程中更好地控制。

paras.en: The new pouch format is available for PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn Multi-Purpose “Classic” Gear Oil GL-4 SAE 80W-90, designed for many traditional manual transmissions and transaxles. The formulation is specifically suited for transmissions containing brass, bronze, copper and other soft-metal components, the company added.
paras.zh: 新的袋子格式可用于 PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn 多用途“经典”齿轮油 GL-4 SAE 80W-90，专为许多传统手动变速箱和变速驱动桥而设计。该公司补充说，该配方特别适用于含有黄铜、青铜、铜和其他软金属部件的变速箱。

paras.en: PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn Full Synthetic Limited Slip Gear Oils in SAE 75W-90 and SAE 75W-140 are also offered in the new pouches. These GL-5 formulations are designed for clutch-type limited slip differentials and demanding gear applications. The 75W-140 grade is specifically recommended for applications involving higher payloads and shock loading, the company notes.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚一年级 |新包装袋中还提供 SAE 75W-90 和 SAE 75W-140 的 Brad Penn 全合成限滑齿轮油。这些 GL-5 配方专为离合器式限滑差速器和要求苛刻的齿轮应用而设计。该公司指出，75W-140 等级特别推荐用于涉及更高有效载荷和冲击载荷的应用。

articles.title: Mitchell 1 Adds QuickSpecs Feature for Faster Repair Lookup
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Mitchell 1 has added a “QuickSpecs” feature in its ProDemand repair information, aimed at helping technicians look things up faster.
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 在其 ProDemand 维修信息中添加了“QuickSpecs”功能，旨在帮助技术人员更快地查找问题。

paras.en: “When technicians need specification information, they need it immediately,” said Cami Hermann, marketing director for Mitchell 1. “QuickSpecs helps eliminate unnecessary scrolling and table hunting so users can get directly to the information they need and keep repairs moving. The enhancement is part of Mitchell 1’s broader effort to streamline technician workflow and improve efficiency throughout the repair process.”
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 营销总监 Cami Hermann 表示：“当技术人员需要规格信息时，他们会立即需要。QuickSpecs 有助于消除不必要的滚动和表格搜索，因此用户可以直接获取所需信息并保持维修进度。这项增强功能是 Mitchell 1 简化技术人员工作流程并提高整个维修过程效率的更广泛努力的一部分。”

paras.en: With added integration with 1Search Plus navigation, QuickSpecs now displays only the information directly related to the search entered by the user. For example, if a technician searches for “lug nut torque,” the system immediately surfaces the matching torque specifications instead of requiring users to scroll through large tables or unrelated information, the company said.
paras.zh: 通过与 1Search Plus 导航的集成，QuickSpecs 现在仅显示与用户输入的搜索直接相关的信息。该公司表示，例如，如果技术人员搜索“凸耳螺母扭矩”，系统会立即显示匹配的扭矩规格，而不需要用户滚动浏览大表格或不相关的信息。

paras.en: Mitchell 1 says it also redesigned the Common Specs Quick Link experience with a cleaner accordion-style layout Instead of searching through one long table, users can jump directly to the section they need.
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 表示，它还重新设计了 Common Specs Quick Link 体验，采用了更简洁的手风琴式布局，用户可以直接跳转到他们需要的部分，而不是在一张长表格中搜索。

paras.en: QuickSpecs currently supports 2015-2026 vehicles at launch, and Mitchell 1 says it expects to add coverage for 1995-2014 vehicles by the end of 2026.
paras.zh: QuickSpecs 目前在发布时支持 2015-2026 年生产的车辆，Mitchell 1 表示预计到 2026 年底将增加对 1995-2014 年生产车辆的覆盖范围。

articles.title: Momentum USA Adds 12 Brake Part Numbers
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Momentum USA added 12 new part numbers to its brake friction and rotor catalog. This update expands coverage to over 5.3 million Vehicles in Operation (VIO) across North America.
paras.zh: Momentum USA 在其制动摩擦和转子目录中添加了 12 个新零件号。此次更新将覆盖范围扩大到北美地区超过 530 万辆运营车辆 (VIO)。

paras.en: The new products include rear brake pads for Ford commercial vans; front ceramic pads for electric vehicles; and rotors for luxury and performance vehicles.
paras.zh: 新产品包括福特商用货车的后刹车片；电动汽车前陶瓷垫；以及豪华和高性能车辆的转子。

paras.en: - Ford Police Interceptor Utility & Explorer (2020–2026): Expanded coverage with the AmeriBrakes – Max Duty rear pad set (RAM2231), engineered specifically for high-stress stopping requirements.
paras.zh: - 福特警用 Interceptor Utility 和 Explorer（2020-2026）：AmeriBrakes – Max Duty 后垫套件 (RAM2231) 扩大了覆盖范围，专为满足高压力制动要求而设计。

paras.en: - Hyundai, Kia & Honda: Expanded coverage across models including the Hyundai Palisade, Santa Fe, and Santa Cruz; Kia Sorento and Carnival (PTC2381); as well as the Honda HR-V and Honda Clarity (PRC2116 / CE2116).
paras.zh: - 现代、起亚和本田：扩大了现代 Palisade、Santa Fe 和 Santa Cruz 等车型的覆盖范围；起亚索兰托和嘉年华 (PTC2381)；以及本田 HR-V 和本田 Clarity (PRC2116 / CE2116)。

paras.en: - Cadillac Lyriq & Chevy Blazer EV (2024–2027): Targeted front ceramic pad options (PRC2521) for modern GM EV platforms.
paras.zh: - 凯迪拉克 Lyriq 和雪佛兰 Blazer EV（2024-2027）：适用于现代通用汽车电动平台的有针对性的前陶瓷垫选项（PRC2521）。

paras.en: - Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover & Volvo: Added seven new Coated and R90 Euro Rotor SKUs to serve luxury sedans, sports coupes, and performance SUVs—including Mercedes-Benz S-Class, SLK, and C-Class models, Land Rover Defender and Range Rover Sport models (537200), and the Volvo XC60 (521480).
paras.zh: - 梅赛德斯-奔驰、路虎和沃尔沃：新增七种涂层和 R90 Euro Rotor SKU，为豪华轿车、运动轿跑车和高性能 SUV 提供服务，包括梅赛德斯-奔驰 S 级、SLK 和 C 级车型、路虎卫士和路虎揽胜运动车型 (537200) 以及沃尔沃 XC60 (521480)。

articles.title: Sonic Tools USA Relaunches Next S15 13-Drawer Toolbox
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Sonic Tools USA has relaunched its Next S15 toolbox, a 13-drawer storage unit with a load capacity of more than one ton. The toolbox can scale from a mobile service cart to a full-capacity tool center for technicians, shops and fleets.
paras.zh: Sonic Tools USA 重新推出了 Next S15 工具箱，这是一款具有 13 个抽屉的存储单元，负载能力超过一吨。该工具箱可以从移动服务车扩展到面向技术人员、商店和车队的全功能工具中心。

paras.en: The Next S15 measures 46.5 inches high, 65 inches wide and 26 inches deep. It includes molded bumpers, integrated side pockets, two spray can holders and a paper roll holder.
paras.zh: Next S15 尺寸为 46.5 英寸高、65 英寸宽、26 英寸深。它包括模制保险杠、集成侧袋、两个喷雾罐支架和一个纸卷支架。

paras.en: According to the company, the toolbox uses ball-bearing drawer slides with soft-close technology and provides full-extension access on all 13 drawers. An advanced drawer-blocking system provides anti-tilt protection. A stainless steel worktop with integrated side pockets comes standard for shop use and tire maintenance operations.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，该工具箱采用滚珠轴承抽屉滑轨和软关闭技术，并为所有 13 个抽屉提供完全伸展的通道。先进的抽屉阻挡系统提供防倾斜保护。带有集成侧袋的不锈钢工作台是商店使用和轮胎维护操作的标准配置。

paras.en: Applications range from compact quick-service carts to large-format storage for high-volume service and tire repair facilities, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，应用范围从紧凑型快速服务推车到用于大容量服务和轮胎修理设施的大型存储。

paras.en: The relaunch includes a redesigned foam insert system. Two medium foam inserts can combine to form one large insert to accommodate growing tool sets. Existing foam inserts transfer directly into the S15, allowing users to maintain their current layouts without rebuilding configurations, the company said.
paras.zh: 重新推出包括重新设计的泡沫插入系统。两个中等泡沫嵌件可以组合成一个大嵌件，以容纳不断增长的工具套件。该公司表示，现有的泡沫插入物可直接转移到 S15 中，允许用户保持当前的布局，而无需重建配置。

articles.title: How did Cleopatra really die?
articles.author: Olivia Maule

paras.en: The death of Cleopatra is among the most famous in history. In 31 B.C., the Egyptian queen and her Roman ally and lover, Mark Antony, lost the Battle of Actium to Octavian, who would later become Rome's first emperor, Augustus. The following summer, Cleopatra was captured during a Roman ambush inside her royal tomb in Alexandria.
paras.zh: 克利奥帕特拉之死是历史上最著名的死亡事件之一。公元前 31 年，埃及女王和她的罗马盟友兼情人马克·安东尼在亚克兴海战中输给了屋大维，屋大维后来成为罗马第一位皇帝奥古斯都。第二年夏天，克利奥帕特拉在亚历山大皇家陵墓内的一次罗马伏击中被捕。

paras.en: According to Octavian’s account, rather than facing the disgrace of defeat, the queen allowed a venomous asp snake to bite her and quickly succumbed to its poison. Some Roman writers, such as the historian Velleius Paterculus, repeated that story without question.
paras.zh: 根据屋大维的说法，女王并没有面临失败的耻辱，而是让一条毒蛇咬了她，并很快死于毒液。一些罗马作家，例如历史学家维勒乌斯·帕特库勒斯，毫无疑问地重复了这个故事。

paras.en: But others were far less certain of this account, calling it Roman propaganda to cement Octavian's rise to power. And most historians today doubt that a snake was involved at all. So how did Cleopatra die?
paras.zh: 但其他人对这种说法不太确定，称其为罗马宣传，以巩固屋大维的权力崛起。如今大多数历史学家都怀疑是否有蛇参与其中。那么克利奥帕特拉是怎么死的呢？

paras.en: Live Science spoke with experts, who told us that the queen's death is still shrouded in mystery.
paras.zh: 《生活科学》采访了专家，他们告诉我们女王的死仍然笼罩在神秘之中。

paras.en: "We cannot know for sure exactly how Cleopatra died," Prudence Jones, a professor of classics at Montclair State University in New Jersey and author of "Cleopatra: A Sourcebook" (University of Oklahoma Press, 2006), told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “我们无法确切地知道克利奥帕特拉是怎么死的，”新泽西州蒙特克莱尔州立大学的古典学教授、《克利奥帕特拉：一本资料书》（俄克拉荷马大学出版社，2006 年）的作者普鲁登斯·琼斯在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: What historians largely agree on is that Cleopatra VII, the last queen of Egypt's Ptolemaic dynasty, took her own life and that she chose a method that left her body composed and dignified.
paras.zh: 历史学家们普遍认为，埃及托勒密王朝的最后一位女王克利奥帕特拉七世结束了自己的生命，并且选择了一种让自己的身体保持平静和尊严的方式。

paras.en: Physical evidence of Cleopatra's death is elusive. Much of Alexandria's royal quarter now lies underwater, and underwater archaeologist Franck Goddio, who has been excavating it, hasn't found the queen's mausoleum, Jones said. Even if Cleopatra's remains surfaced, bones would be unlikely to show evidence of snake venom, she added, noting that forensics is outside her area of expertise.
paras.zh: 克利奥帕特拉死亡的物证难以捉摸。琼斯说，亚历山大皇家区的大部分地区现在都位于水下，一直在挖掘的水下考古学家弗兰克·戈迪奥（Franck Goddio）尚未找到女王的陵墓。她补充说，即使克利奥帕特拉的遗骸浮出水面，骨头也不太可能显示出蛇毒的证据，并指出法医学超出了她的专业领域。

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独特的谜团来满足您的好奇心，这些谜团将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The best witness may have been Olympus, Cleopatra's personal physician. "Unfortunately, nothing survives of Olympus' account," Jones said.
paras.zh: 最好的证人可能是克利奥帕特拉的私人医生奥林巴斯。 “不幸的是，奥林巴斯的记录没有留下任何痕迹，”琼斯说。

paras.en: What does remain is a story told largely by Cleopatra's enemies. The earliest surviving account is a poem by the Roman poet Horace, whose patron was a close friend of Octavian, said Jane Draycott, a historian at the University of Glasgow. His Ode 1.37, written around the time of her death, celebrates Octavian's victory and already pictures the queen handling serpents — yet it ends with grudging admiration for a woman who refused to be paraded as a trophy.
paras.zh: 剩下的故事主要是由克利奥帕特拉的敌人讲述的。 The earliest surviving account is a poem by the Roman poet Horace, whose patron was a close friend of Octavian, said Jane Draycott, a historian at the University of Glasgow. His Ode 1.37, written around the time of her death, celebrates Octavian's victory and already pictures the queen handling serpents — yet it ends with grudging admiration for a woman who refused to be paraded as a trophy.

paras.en: Following her capture, Cleopatra was held under military guard. By then, she had already tried to end her life twice. Cleopatra had tried to stab herself when Roman soldiers broke into the mausoleum where she had barricaded herself, and she later tried to starve herself, stopping only after Octavian threatened her children.
paras.zh: 克利奥帕特拉被捕后，被军方看守。那时，她已经两次试图结束自己的生命。当罗马士兵闯入她设下的陵墓时，克利奥帕特拉曾试图刺伤自己，后来她又试图让自己挨饿，直到屋大维威胁她的孩子们后才停止。

paras.en: To Draycott, those attempts leave little doubt that Cleopatra would rather die than live as a captive. "She does not want to be a prisoner; she does not want to be led through the streets of Rome in triumph as a defeated foe," she told Live Science.
paras.zh: 对于德雷科特来说，这些尝试毫无疑问表明克利奥帕特拉宁愿死也不愿作为俘虏生活。她告诉《生活科学》杂志：“她不想成为一名囚犯；她不想作为一个被击败的敌人被带领走在罗马的街道上。”

paras.en: In the Greco-Roman world, suicide didn't carry the stigma it later acquired under Christianity, she added. "It was a way of wiping the slate clean, removing any shame, any disgrace from yourself." After the defeat of his remaining forces at Alexandria and hearing a false report of Cleopatra's death, Antony was the first of the two lovers to die by suicide.
paras.zh: 她补充说，在希腊罗马世界，自杀并不像后来在基督教下那样受到耻辱。 “这是一种抹去过去的方式，消除你身上的任何耻辱和耻辱。”在亚历山大的剩余军队被击败并听到有关克利奥帕特拉死亡的虚假报告后，安东尼成为两个恋人中第一个自杀身亡的人。

paras.en: According to the Greek biographer Plutarch, who based his account on that of Cleopatra's personal physician, Cleopatra visited Antony's tomb, bathed, ate and sent Octavian a sealed letter asking to be buried beside Antony, signaling that she meant to die. Octavian realized what was happening and sent messengers rushing to her, but they arrived too late. They found her dead in her royal regalia, with her attendants Iras and Charmion dying beside her.
paras.zh: 希腊传记作家普鲁塔克根据克利奥帕特拉的私人医生的叙述描述说，克利奥帕特拉参观了安东尼的坟墓，洗澡，吃饭，并向屋大维发送了一封密封的信，要求埋在安东尼身边，表明她打算死。奥克塔维安意识到发生了什么事，并派信使冲向她，但他们来得太晚了。他们发现她死在她的皇家服饰中，她的侍从伊拉斯和查米翁死在她身边。

paras.en: Jones has compiled what ancient historians, biographers, geographers and physicians wrote about Cleopatra's death. Every source mentions a snakebite, but several also suggest other possibilities, including a poisonous ointment, poison hidden in a hollow hairpin, and snake venom poured into a wound the queen made by biting herself. Only one of these writers, the geographer Strabo, was alive when Cleopatra died, and the only people in the room with her died, too.
paras.zh: 琼斯整理了古代历史学家、传记作家、地理学家和医生关于克利奥帕特拉之死的文章。每个消息来源都提到了蛇咬伤，但也有一些消息来源提出了其他可能性，包括有毒的药膏、藏在空心发夹中的毒药，以及蛇毒倒入女王咬伤自己的伤口中。当克利奥帕特拉去世时，这些作家中只有一位地理学家斯特拉博还活着，房间里唯一和她在一起的人也死了。

paras.en: The Roman historian Cassius Dio wrote that the sole clue was a pair of faint pricks on her arm. That doesn't settle much, however. "A cobra bite can appear as two small puncture wounds, but not all cobra bites appear this way and not all double puncture wounds result from snakebites," Jones said.
paras.zh: 罗马历史学家卡西乌斯·迪奥写道，唯一的线索是她手臂上的一对微弱的刺痛。然而，这并没有解决太多问题。琼斯说：“眼镜蛇咬伤可能会表现为两个小刺伤，但并非所有眼镜蛇咬伤都以这种方式出现，也并非所有双刺伤都是由蛇咬伤造成的。”

paras.en: Jones traces the snake version of the story to Octavian, who was in Alexandria when Cleopatra died. Plutarch reported that an image of Cleopatra with an asp clinging to her was carried in Octavian's triumphal procession in Rome. "Octavian, however, was Cleopatra's enemy and for that reason we may not want to accept his account uncritically," Jones said.
paras.zh: 琼斯将蛇版本的故事追溯到屋大维，克利奥帕特拉去世时，屋大维正在亚历山大。普鲁塔克报道说，在罗马屋大维的凯旋游行中，有一幅克利奥帕特拉身上缠着一只毒蛇的图像。 “然而，屋大维是克利奥帕特拉的敌人，因此我们可能不想不加批判地接受他的说法，”琼斯说。

paras.en: Draycott suggested another possible source of confusion: Snake-shaped jewelry was fashionable in Alexandria at the time, so Romans viewing an effigy of the queen may have mistaken a snake bracelet for a real snake.
paras.zh: 德雷科特提出了另一个可能的混乱来源：蛇形珠宝当时在亚历山大很流行，因此罗马人在观看女王的肖像时可能会将蛇手镯误认为是真正的蛇。

paras.en: Draycott doesn't think one snake could have killed all three women. Jones is less certain. Snakes don't inject the same amount of venom with every bite, and some "dry bites" deliver none at all, Jones said. "On the other hand, I don't think it is impossible, as the body of a cobra contains enough venom to kill multiple people," she added.
paras.zh: 德雷科特认为一条蛇不可能杀死所有三个女人。琼斯不太确定。琼斯说，蛇每次咬伤时不会注入等量的毒液，有些“干咬”根本不会释放毒液。 “另一方面，我认为这并非不可能，因为眼镜蛇体内含有足够的毒液来杀死多人，”她补充道。

paras.en: The general view among historians, Draycott said, is that Cleopatra took some kind of poison — one that worked quickly and didn't cause seizures or vomiting. The absence of these symptoms is telling: An asp is believed to be what is now known as the Egyptian cobra (Naja haje), whose venom causes a slow, agonizing death with respiratory failure.
paras.zh: 德雷科特说，历史学家普遍认为克利奥帕特拉服用了某种毒药，这种毒药起效很快，而且不会引起癫痫或呕吐。没有这些症状很能说明问题：一种毒蛇被认为是现在被称为埃及眼镜蛇 (Naja haje) 的东西，它的毒液会导致缓慢、痛苦的死亡并伴有呼吸衰竭。

paras.en: Cleopatra likely would have had other means, then. Alexandria was the Mediterranean's center of scientific study, and texts from the period, such as Nicander's "Theriaca," catalog venomous animals, Jones noted. Cleopatra's father, Ptolemy XII, even consulted the pharmacologist Zopyrus about antidotes. Plutarch claimed that Cleopatra personally oversaw experiments that observed the effects of deadly poisons on condemned prisoners.
paras.zh: 那么，克利奥帕特拉可能还有其他办法。琼斯指出，亚历山大是地中海的科学研究中心，那个时期的文献，例如尼坎德的《Theriaca》，对有毒动物进行了分类。克利奥帕特拉的父亲托勒密十二世甚至向药理学家佐皮鲁斯咨询解毒剂。普鲁塔克声称，克利奥帕特拉亲自监督了实验，观察致命毒药对死刑犯的影响。

paras.en: Still, that claim and other poison stories should be read with caution, Draycott said, because they draw on Roman stereotypes about women. In the Roman view, "manly men will battle with swords," while women, seen as "deceitful and weak" at this time, were thought to kill in secret. "They'll sneak it into your food," Draycott said, summing up the stereotype.
paras.zh: 德雷科特说，不过，这种说法和其他有毒的故事应该谨慎阅读，因为它们借鉴了罗马人对女性的刻板印象。在罗马人看来，“有男子气概的男人会用剑战斗”，而此时的女性则被视为“狡诈而软弱”，被认为会秘密杀人。 “他们会把它偷偷地混入你的食物中，”德雷科特总结道。

paras.en: Roman writers were equally suspicious. Poisoning allegations dogged the Hellenistic dynasties of ancient Egypt and the neighboring Seleucid kingdom, as well as Rome's own imperial family. Some were probably true, Draycott said, but others may have been foodborne illnesses or other health conditions people didn't understand.
paras.zh: 罗马作家也同样持怀疑态度。 Poisoning allegations dogged the Hellenistic dynasties of ancient Egypt and the neighboring Seleucid kingdom, as well as Rome's own imperial family.德雷科特说，有些可能是真的，但其他的可能是食源性疾病或其他人们不了解的健康状况。

paras.en: The method may remain a mystery, but for most historians, the motive doesn't change: Cleopatra chose to die on her own terms.
paras.zh: 这种方法可能仍然是个谜，但对于大多数历史学家来说，动机并没有改变：克利奥帕特拉选择按照自己的方式死去。

paras.en: Are you a fan of mummies and hieroglyphs? Find out with our ancient Egypt quiz!
paras.zh: 您是木乃伊和象形文字的粉丝吗？通过我们的古埃及测验找出答案！

paras.en: Olivia Maule is a former Live Science intern and science journalist whose beats include space, biotechnology and the environment. She holds a B.A. in biology and a B.S. in anthropology from the University of Florida and completed a master's degree in science communication at U.C. Santa Cruz. A 2025 AAAS Mass Media Fellow, she wrote stories and produced videos during a summer at El Nuevo Día, Puerto Rico's largest newspaper, and has written for Eos, Mongabay, Science magazine and Stanford Report. Olivia is a native Spanish and English speaker.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·莫尔 (Olivia Maule) 是《Live Science》前实习生和科学记者，关注领域包括太空、生物技术和环境。她拥有学士学位。生物学学士学位和学士学位获得佛罗里达大学人类学博士学位，并在加州大学获得科学传播硕士学位。圣克鲁斯。作为 2025 年美国科学促进会大众媒体研究员，她在一个夏天为波多黎各最大的报纸 El Nuevo Día 撰写故事并制作视频，并为《Eos》、《Mongabay》、《科学》杂志和《斯坦福报告》撰稿。奥利维亚的母语是西班牙语和英语。

articles.title: NASA's Voyager 1 mission forever changed our view of Jupiter
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: This Wednesday (Nov. 18), humanity's most distant spacecraft will hit a new milestone. NASA's Voyager 1 probe, which has been exploring our solar system at increasingly remote depths since 1977, will reach 16.09 billion miles (25.89 billion kilometers) from Earth — a distance so vast, it takes light 24 hours to traverse the space between Voyager and our planet.
paras.zh: 本周三（11 月 18 日），人类最远的航天器将达到一个新的里程碑。 NASA 的航行者 1 号探测器自 1977 年以来一直在越来越远的深度探索太阳系，它将到达距离地球 160.9 亿英里（258.9 亿公里）的地方——这个距离如此之大，光需要 24 小时才能穿过航行者号和我们星球之间的空间。

paras.en: While we celebrate this achievement on Earth, Voyager 1 will observe its "light-day" in darkness; mission scientists turned off the probe's camera in 1990, immediately after it snapped its iconic "Pale Blue Dot" and "Solar System Family Portrait" images from beyond the orbit of Neptune. But before that, Voyager 1 had already taken tens of thousands of images of our cosmic neighborhood, and some of them totally transformed our understanding of the outer planets.
paras.zh: 当我们在地球上庆祝这一成就时，航海家一号将在黑暗中迎来它的“光日”； 1990年，在探测器从海王星轨道之外拍摄了标志性的“淡蓝点”和“太阳系全家福”图像后，任务科学家立即关闭了探测器的相机。但在此之前，航海家一号已经拍摄了我们宇宙附近的数万张图像，其中一些完全改变了我们对外行星的理解。

paras.en: One of the most significant pieces of Voyager 1's legacy is its trip to Jupiter. From January to April 1979, the probe observed the solar system's largest planet and several of its giant moons up close, reaching a minimum distance of 174,000 miles (280,000 km) in March 1979, according to NASA. As it approached, Voyager snapped a photo of the gas giant every 96 seconds to create this incredible time-lapse movie of Jupiter's turbulent atmosphere.
paras.zh: 航海者一号最重要的遗产之一就是它的木星之旅。据美国宇航局称，从 1979 年 1 月到 4 月，探测器近距离观察了太阳系最大的行星及其几颗巨型卫星，并于 1979 年 3 月达到了 174,000 英里（280,000 公里）的最小距离。当它接近时，航海者号每 96 秒拍摄一次这颗气态巨行星的照片，以拍摄木星湍流大气层的令人难以置信的延时电影。

paras.en: Voyager observed discrete bands of Jupiter's atmosphere spinning at various speeds and in different directions, like a cosmic Rubik's Cube being twisted by an invisible hand. Clouds speed by as if on conveyor belts as giant, planet-size storms swirl.
paras.zh: 航行者号观察到木星大气层中离散的带状物质以不同的速度和不同的方向旋转，就像宇宙魔方被一只看不见的手扭曲一样。当巨大的行星大小的风暴旋转时，云层就像在传送带上一样快速掠过。

paras.en: Voyager's time-lapse film captures about 60 full days on Jupiter — the equivalent of about a month on Earth, since each Jupiter day is roughly 10 Earth hours —- providing the most comprehensive and high-resolution look at the planet yet. The observations significantly built on the data captured by NASA's Pioneer 10 and 11 Jupiter probes, which launched half a decade prior, showing the planet's atmosphere to be much more dynamic than astronomers realized.
paras.zh: Voyager 的延时影片拍摄了木星上大约 60 天的时间——相当于地球上大约一个月的时间，因为木星上的每一天大约是 10 个地球小时——提供了迄今为止最全面、最高分辨率的木星观察。这些观测结果很大程度上建立在美国宇航局先锋 10 号和 11 号木星探测器捕获的数据的基础上，这两个探测器在五年前发射，表明该行星的大气层比天文学家意识到的更加活跃。

paras.en: Just before making its closest approach to the planet, Voyager spotted something remarkable: Jupiter had a thin, faint ring system. Made primarily of dust, the rings appeared only when Voyager saw Jupiter backlit by the sun. No telescope had ever seen this before, but ground-based observatories soon confirmed the rings' existence, and Voyager 2 took even clearer pictures of the rings when it reached Jupiter in July 1979.
paras.zh: 就在距离木星最近的位置之前，航海者号发现了一些非凡的东西：木星有一个薄而微弱的光环系统。这些光环主要由尘埃构成，只有当航行者号看到木星被太阳背光照射时才会出现。以前没有望远镜见过这种情况，但地面天文台很快证实了这些光环的存在，航海者 2 号在 1979 年 7 月到达木星时拍摄了更清晰的光环照片。

paras.en: We now know that all four outer planets — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune — have rings. Today, scientists suspect Jupiter's dusty rings are replenished partially by volcanic eruptions on the planet's volatile moon Io.
paras.zh: 我们现在知道所有四颗外行星——木星、土星、天王星和海王星——都有光环。如今，科学家怀疑木星的尘埃环部分是由木卫一不稳定的卫星木卫一上的火山喷发所补充的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: This discovery, too, can be linked to Voyager. While making a close approach to Io, the spacecraft witnessed the first-ever volcanic eruption on a world beyond Earth. This observation showed that moons, not just planets, can be geologically active. In this image, a giant volcano called Loki Patera (the largest volcano on Io, measuring an estimated 125 miles, or 200 km, wide) spews its guts into space.
paras.zh: 这一发现也可以与 Voyager 联系起来。在近距离接近木卫一时，航天器目睹了地球以外世界的首次火山喷发。这项观察表明，卫星，而不仅仅是行星，也可能具有地质活动。在这张图片中，一座名为 Loki Patera 的巨型火山（木卫一上最大的火山，估计宽 125 英里，即 200 公里）将其内脏喷向太空。

paras.en: Taken together, these observations of Jupiter and its moons showed the largest planet and its moons to be a far more dynamic, complicated and chaotic system than anyone had realized. Moreover, the close-up views of these distant worlds made them more than just dots in the sky. It made them fully realized worlds — places to explore, map and eventually visit. Just this week, China's space agency announced its intention to send a lander to Jupiter's moon Callisto in the first-ever landing mission to the Jovian system.
paras.zh: 总而言之，对木星及其卫星的这些观测表明，这颗最大的行星及其卫星是一个比任何人想象的更加动态、复杂和混乱的系统。此外，近距离观察这些遥远的世界使它们不仅仅是天空中的点。它让他们完全实现了世界——探索、绘制地图并最终参观的地方。就在本周，中国航天局宣布打算向木星的卫星木卫四发射着陆器，这是有史以来首次登陆木星系统。

paras.en: Voyager 1's work continues in interstellar space, which it officially reached in 2012. With its camera off, it studies the radiation environment of space using magnetic field and plasma detectors — the last two of its 10 science instruments still receiving power. Scientists suspect the legendary probe will fully run out of power in the 2030s.
paras.zh: 航行者一号的工作仍在继续，它于 2012 年正式抵达星际空间。在关闭相机的情况下，它使用磁场和等离子体探测器研究太空的辐射环境——这是其 10 台科学仪器中的最后两台仍在通电的仪器。科学家怀疑这个传奇探测器将在 2030 年代完全耗尽电力。

paras.en: For more stunning space photos, check out our Space Photo of the Week gallery.
paras.zh: 如需更多令人惊叹的太空照片，请查看我们的本周太空照片库。

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: Which animal would you most want to talk to, if you could?
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: The idea of talking to animals like Dr. Dolittle might sound far-fetched, but researchers are making progress toward understanding how other species communicate. In a recent Live Science interview, University of California, Berkeley ethologist Julie Elie explained how she used artificial intelligence (AI) and behavioral experiments to decode the calls of zebra finches (Taeniopygia guttata). For instance, Elie was able to determine which calls the birds used to communicate over short distances versus longer distances.
paras.zh: 与杜立德博士这样的动物交谈的想法可能听起来很牵强，但研究人员在了解其他物种如何交流方面正在取得进展。在最近的《Live Science》采访中，加州大学伯克利分校动物行为学家 Julie Elie 解释了她如何使用人工智能 (AI) 和行为实验来解码斑胸草雀 (Taeniopygia guttata) 的叫声。例如，埃利能够确定鸟类使用哪些叫声进行短距离和长距离交流。

paras.en: Birds aren't the only animals scientists are hoping to understand. Researchers with Project CETI are using AI to decipher the clicks and calls of sperm whales, while a separate team (with the search for extraterrestrial intelligence, or SETI) conducted what they described as the first "conversation" between humans and a humpback whale. The whale, named Twain, responded to recorded calls played by researchers over a 20 minute period, a "conversation" scientists believe could help us figure out how to communicate with extraterrestrial life someday.
paras.zh: 鸟类并不是科学家希望了解的唯一动物。 CETI 项目的研究人员正在使用人工智能破译抹香鲸的点击声和叫声，而一个独立的团队（负责寻找外星智慧生物，简称 SETI）进行了他们所说的人类和座头鲸之间的首次“对话”。这只名叫吐温的鲸鱼对研究人员在 20 分钟内播放的录音电话做出了回应，科学家们认为这种“对话”有一天可以帮助我们弄清楚如何与外星生命进行交流。

paras.en: Closer to home, cats have already figured out how to use meows to get their human's attention, whether they're demanding food, affection or simply that we open the door for them (again). Whether this means they understand the human language or not is still up for debate, but it raises an interesting question: If we could understand what animals were saying, which species would you most want to talk to? Vote in our poll and let us know what you'd ask in the comments below!
paras.zh: 言归正传，猫已经学会了如何用喵喵声来引起人类的注意，无论它们是在要求食物、关爱，还是只是要求我们（再次）为它们开门。这是否意味着它们理解人类语言仍有争议，但这提出了一个有趣的问题：如果我们能理解动物在说什么，你最想与哪个物种交谈？在我们的民意调查中投票，并在下面的评论中告诉我们您想问什么！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。
