paras.en: SpaceX Starship successfully re-docks at Texas launch pad after orbiting Earth
paras.zh: SpaceX 星舰绕地球轨道运行后成功重新对接德克萨斯州发射台

paras.en: Company hopes accomplishment will further efforts to create fully reusable rocket
paras.zh: 公司希望这一成就将进一步努力制造完全可重复使用的火箭

paras.en: SpaceX's Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in midair by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier.
paras.zh: 周六，SpaceX 的星际飞船凯旋返回地球，被巨型机械臂抓住在半空中，它的旅程 22 小时前就开始了。

paras.en: It was the grand finale that Elon Musk and his team hoped for — the first-ever capture of a Starship flying back from space. But with the first-stage booster exploding shortly after Friday's liftoff from Texas, the company fell short of its desired double catch, still the goal for accelerating moon and Mars travel.
paras.zh: 这是埃隆·马斯克和他的团队所希望的大结局——首次捕获从太空飞回的星际飞船。但随着第一级助推器在周五从德克萨斯州升空后不久发生爆炸，该公司未能实现其预期的双重捕获，这仍然是加速月球和火星旅行的目标。

paras.en: Wreckage remained in the Gulf of Mexico, cordoned off by buoys, as the stainless steel, bullet-shaped spacecraft lowered itself upright at the launch pad.
paras.zh: 当不锈钢子弹形航天器在发射台上直立下降时，残骸仍留在墨西哥湾，被浮标封锁。

paras.en: The dramatic, sci-fi-like capture helped blot out the booster's messy miss. Cameras panned the spacecraft up and down as it hung high above the ground, supported by the arms of the launch tower.
paras.zh: 戏剧性的、科幻般的捕捉帮助掩盖了助推器混乱的失误。当航天器高高悬挂在地面上方、由发射塔的臂支撑时，摄像机上下摇摄航天器。

paras.en: "Can you believe it?" SpaceX commentator Dan Huot shouted, dragging out each word. "Look at her! Baby, she's back!"
paras.zh: “你能相信吗？” SpaceX 评论员 Dan Huot 大声喊道，每一个字都拖长了。 “快看她！宝贝，她回来了！”

paras.en: Calling it an "epic day," Musk later ascended the launch tower to take up-close video with his phone. He even hugged the spacecraft. "Looks great," he reported via X.
paras.zh: 马斯克称这是“史诗般的一天”，随后他登上发射塔，用手机拍摄了近距离视频。他甚至拥抱了飞船。 “看起来很棒，”他通过 X 报道。

paras.en: SpaceX officials said Saturday's catch demonstrates the full reusability of Starship, crucial for rapid and low-cost recycling. Although Friday's booster recovery failed, the company had already made three previous booster catches, validating the technique.
paras.zh: SpaceX 官员表示，周六的捕获证明了 Starship 的完全可重复使用性，这对于快速、低成本的回收至关重要。尽管周五的助推器回收失败，但该公司之前已经进行了三次助推器捕获，验证了该技术。

paras.en: NASA welcomed Saturday's news. The space agency is paying billions of dollars for Starship to land Artemis astronauts on the moon later this decade and help build a permanent lunar base. Musk's ambitions are even grander: He wants to launch a fleet of Starships to build a city on Mars.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局对周六的消息表示欢迎。美国宇航局正在斥资数十亿美元购买星际飞船，以便在本十年晚些时候将阿耳忒弥斯宇航员送上月球，并帮助建立一个永久的月球基地。马斯克的野心更加宏伟：他想发射一支星际飞船舰队，在火星上建造一座城市。

paras.en: "It was almost magic," NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said via X. "Making more believers by the day ... one step closer to (emojis of the moon and the U.S. flag)."
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 通过 X 表示：“这几乎是一种魔法。”“一天比一天让更多的信徒……离（月亮和美国国旗的表情符号）更近了一步。”

paras.en: The world's largest and most powerful rocket — a 124-metre behemoth — blasted off late Friday afternoon from SpaceX's Starship base near the U.S.-Mexican border. Separating neatly from its booster before things went awry, the upper-stage spacecraft soared into orbit and released 26 advanced Starlink satellites.
paras.zh: 世界上最大、最强大的火箭——一枚 124 米长的庞然大物——于周五下午从 SpaceX 位于美墨边境附近的 Starship 基地发射升空。在出现问题之前，上级航天器巧妙地与助推器分离，飞入轨道并释放了 26 颗先进的星链卫星。

paras.en: Starship continued circling the world 265 kilometres up, with live views of itself and Earth streaming down via Starlink. The spacecraft completed 14 laps around Earth, outshining the previous mission's one to two laps.
paras.zh: 星舰继续在 265 公里高空环绕地球飞行，通过星链传送星舰和地球的实时图像。该航天器绕地球飞行了 14 圈，比之前的任务只绕了 1 到 2 圈。

paras.en: It was SpaceX's 15th flight of a full-scale Starship since 2023 and its only second trip to orbit.
paras.zh: 这是 SpaceX 自 2023 年以来第 15 次全尺寸星际飞船飞行，也是其唯一第二次进入轨道。

paras.en: SpaceX reported that everything on the spacecraft, including its vital heat shield, appeared to work well.
paras.zh: SpaceX 报告称，飞船上的所有部件，包括重要的隔热罩，似乎都运行良好。

paras.en: As for the booster, SpaceX's Kate Tice said its engines stopped firing too soon on the way back down. The booster's guidance system sensed it wasn't in the right position and automatically initiated the watery detour and self-destruction. Engineers are still investigating the cause.
paras.zh: 至于助推器，SpaceX 的 Kate Tice 表示，其发动机在返回途中过早停止点火。助推器的制导系统感知到它不在正确的位置，并自动启动水上绕行和自毁。工程师仍在调查原因。

paras.en: SpaceX expects to begin launching Starships from Florida's Kennedy Space Center within the next few months. That is the starting point for NASA's next Artemis mission, which will skip the moon and remain in orbit around Earth for lunar lander practice.
paras.zh: SpaceX 预计将在未来几个月内开始从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射星际飞船。这是美国宇航局下一次阿尔忒弥斯任务的起点，该任务将跳过月球并留在绕地球轨道上进行月球着陆器练习。

paras.en: Artemis III's four astronauts will attempt to dock their capsule with not only Starship but Blue Origin's Blue Moon. The two companies will take turns delivering crews to the lunar surface. NASA is targeting as soon as 2028 for Artemis IV, humanity's first moon landing since the Apollo era more than half a century ago.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯三号的四名宇航员将尝试将他们的太空舱不仅与星际飞船对接，还与蓝色起源的蓝月亮对接。两家公司将轮流将宇航员运送到月球表面。 NASA 的目标是最快在 2028 年实现阿尔忒弥斯 IV，这是半个多世纪前阿波罗时代以来人类首次登月。

articles.title: European security plan floated by U.S. would benefit Putin, Zelenskyy says

paras.en: European security plan floated by U.S. would benefit Putin, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，美国提出的欧洲安全计划将使普京受益

paras.en: Separately, Ukrainian forces struck a major Russian oil facility on Saturday
paras.zh: 另外，乌克兰军队周六袭击了俄罗斯一处主要石油设施

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the United States had raised the possibility of a new security framework for Europe as part of efforts to end Russia's war in Ukraine, warning that Moscow could use such discussions to weaken NATO and reshape the continent's borders.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，美国提出了为欧洲建立新安全框架的可能性，作为结束俄罗斯在乌克兰战争的努力的一部分，并警告莫斯科可能利用此类讨论来削弱北约并重塑欧洲大陆的边界。

paras.en: Separately, Ukrainian forces struck a major Russian oil facility supporting Moscow's war effort, Ukraine's General Staff said in a statement on Saturday.
paras.zh: 另外，乌克兰总参谋部在周六的一份声明中表示，乌克兰军队袭击了支持莫斯科战争努力的俄罗斯主要石油设施。

paras.en: "In my view, this can be dangerous," Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday, referring to the new security framework. "This should not be the main agenda." His comments were embargoed until Saturday.
paras.zh: “在我看来，这可能很危险，”泽连斯基周五在谈到新的安全框架时告诉记者。 “这不应该是主要议程。”他的言论直到周六才发表。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president said he believed Moscow was interested in reopening broader questions about European security rather than focusing exclusively on ending the war.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统表示，他相信莫斯科有兴趣重新讨论有关欧洲安全的更广泛问题，而不是仅仅专注于结束战争。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin's "desire to change borders in Europe is a fact. I am sure this is part of his concept of revising security guarantees in Europe," he said. “This is dangerous because, in my view, it is precisely things like this that lead to wars or escalations."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京“希望改变欧洲边界是事实。我确信这是他修改欧洲安全保障概念的一部分，”他说。 “这很危险，因为在我看来，正是这样的事情导致了战争或升级。”

paras.en: European leaders have stressed that decisions about the continent's security must be made by Europeans themselves, warning against allowing Russia to dictate the terms of a new security order or negotiate the future of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人强调，有关欧洲大陆安全的决定必须由欧洲人自己做出，并警告不要让俄罗斯决定新安全秩序的条款或谈判北大西洋公约组织的未来。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said the U.S. had asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region in eastern Ukraine that Russia does not control if Kyiv were admitted to NATO. He reiterated that Kyiv would not surrender its territory.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，美国首次询问乌克兰是否会从乌克兰东部顿巴斯地区部分地区撤军，如果基辅加入北约，俄罗斯无法控制这些地区。他重申基辅不会放弃其领土。

paras.en: Ukraine is discussing a comprehensive security package with its partners that could include specific guarantees from NATO and the European Union, and strong Ukrainian military and financial support for a specified period, Zelenskyy said. It would also include a recovery plan.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰正在与合作伙伴讨论全面的安全一揽子计划，其中可能包括北约和欧盟的具体保证，以及乌克兰在特定时期内的强有力的军事和财政支持。它还将包括一个恢复计划。

paras.en: - U.S. envoys talk to Zelenskyy in Dublin, after prior sitdown with Putin in Moscow
paras.zh: - 美国特使在莫斯科与普京举行会谈后在都柏林与泽伦斯基进行了交谈

paras.en: - Russia-Ukraine talks mediated by U.S. end with news of 'good momentum,' large-scale prisoner swap
paras.zh: - 由美国斡旋的俄罗斯和乌克兰谈判以“良好势头”和大规模囚犯交换的消息结束

paras.en: "If the American side confirms precisely this to us, together with other NATO partners, then I will ask our Ukrainian society what it thinks: Do we accept it or not?" he said, adding that any arrangement would not involve recognizing occupied territories as Russian.
paras.zh: “如果美国方面和其他北约伙伴向我们证实了这一点，那么我将问问我们乌克兰社会的想法：我们接受还是不接受？”他补充说，任何安排都不会涉及承认被占领土为俄罗斯领土。

paras.en: Zelenskyy also rejected the possibility of Ukraine committing to neutrality, saying that would require changing the country’s constitution.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基还拒绝了乌克兰承诺中立的可能性，称这需要修改该国宪法。

paras.en: "If Putin expects Ukraine's neutrality to be enshrined, that's not going to happen," he said. "We're not in NATO right now anyway."
paras.zh: 他说：“如果普京希望乌克兰保持中立，那这种情况就不会发生。” “无论如何，我们现在不在北约。”

paras.en: Ukraine hits another major oil facility in Russia
paras.zh: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯另一处大型石油设施

paras.en: Ukrainian strikes on the Samara oil pipeline station on Friday near the village of Prosvet, in Russia's Samara region, set several oil storage tanks on fire, Ukraine's General Staff said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总参谋部表示，乌克兰周五对俄罗斯萨马拉地区普罗维特村附近的萨马拉石油管道站发动袭击，导致多个储油罐起火。

paras.en: The facility is a key part of the network exporting Russian oil to global markets, the General Staff said. The military also said it struck the Lipetsk-2 airfield in Russia's Lipetsk region.
paras.zh: 总参谋部表示，该设施是俄罗斯石油向全球市场出口网络的关键组成部分。军方还表示，它袭击了俄罗斯利佩茨克地区的利佩茨克2号机场。

paras.en: Separately, 22 people, including three children, were injured in a Russian attack on the southeastern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia on Friday, Ukraine's Emergency Service said. The injured include a six-month-old baby, a two-year-old girl and a 12-year-old boy.
paras.zh: 另外，乌克兰紧急服务部门表示，周五俄罗斯对乌克兰东南部城市扎波罗热的袭击造成 22 人受伤，其中包括 3 名儿童。伤者包括一名六个月大的婴儿、一名两岁的女孩和一名12岁的男孩。

paras.en: Zelenskyy says Europe must decide own future
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示欧洲必须决定自己的未来

paras.en: Zelenskyy warned that broader discussions about Europe's security could allow Putin to seek changes to NATO's military presence, including the withdrawal of American troops.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基警告说，有关欧洲安全的更广泛讨论可能会让普京寻求改变北约的军事存在，包括撤出美军。

paras.en: He said Putin had raised similar ideas with then-U.S. president Joe Biden in 2021, seeking a redistribution of power in Europe and the world.
paras.zh: 他说普京曾向当时的美国提出过类似的想法。 2021 年乔·拜登总统寻求在欧洲和世界上重新分配权力。

paras.en: "I think Putin will bring up Finland and Sweden. I'm sure he will raise the issue of Hungary and the presence of American troops in the Baltic countries," Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: “我认为普京会提到芬兰和瑞典。我相信他会提出匈牙利问题以及美国军队在波罗的海国家的存在问题，”泽伦斯基说。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said any changes to Europe's security arrangements must be decided by European NATO members only after the war ends.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，对欧洲安全安排的任何改变都必须在战争结束后由欧洲北约成员国决定。

paras.en: "The sequence should be as follows: a ceasefire, an end to the war in Ukraine and security guarantees for Ukraine," he said. "There can be no security guarantees in Europe, or for Europe, without Ukraine."
paras.zh: “顺序应该如下：停火、结束乌克兰战争以及乌克兰的安全保障，”他说。 “没有乌克兰，欧洲或欧洲就没有安全保障。”

paras.en: Energy ceasefire, prisoner exchanges are priorities
paras.zh: 能源停火、囚犯交换是优先事项

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Ukraine's priorities at meetings this week in Abu Dhabi included an energy ceasefire, reopening the Black Sea, prisoner releases and preparations for a leaders' meeting to end the war.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰本周在阿布扎比举行的会议上的优先事项包括能源停火、重新开放黑海、释放囚犯以及为结束战争的领导人会议做准备。

paras.en: He said Russian negotiators lacked authority to decide on several issues and that Moscow was unwilling to accept an energy ceasefire.
paras.zh: 他表示，俄罗斯谈判代表缺乏就几个问题做出决定的权力，而且莫斯科不愿意接受能源停火。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said talks in Moscow with U.S. negotiators resulted in an agreement to exchange more than 1,000 prisoners of war on each side.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，在莫斯科与美国谈判代表进行的会谈达成了双方交换1000多名战俘的协议。

paras.en: He said Washington supported Ukraine's demand for European countries to participate directly in future negotiations, rather than remain outside the main negotiating room.
paras.zh: 他表示，华盛顿支持乌克兰要求欧洲国家直接参与未来谈判，而不是留在主要谈判室之外。

paras.en: Britain, France, Germany and Italy attended the Abu Dhabi meetings, Zelenskyy said. He expected three to five European representatives at future discussions.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，英国、法国、德国和意大利出席了阿布扎比会议。他预计有三到五名欧洲代表参加未来的讨论。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said Moscow was open to European participation, adding that it would "help us understand how their stand could help the peace process." He said Russia would accept any representatives European countries chose to send.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，莫斯科对欧洲的参与持开放态度，并补充说这将“帮助我们了解他们的立场如何有助于和平进程”。他表示，俄罗斯将接受欧洲国家选择派出的任何代表。

paras.en: Zelenskyy questions Starshield restrictions
paras.zh: 泽连斯基质疑星盾限制

paras.en: Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of imposing restrictions on its Starshield satellite system in Russian-occupied Ukrainian territory, saying the limitations were hampering efforts to intercept Russian drones.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基指责 SpaceX 在俄罗斯占领的乌克兰领土上对其 Starshield 卫星系统施加限制，称这些限制阻碍了拦截俄罗斯无人机的努力。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president questioned the explanation that the problem was technical, saying the restrictions appeared to have been imposed by SpaceX despite previous assurances from U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Starshield was more under the control of the U.S. government.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统对问题是技术性的解释提出质疑，称这些限制似乎是 SpaceX 施加的，尽管美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥此前曾保证 Starshield 更多地处于美国政府的控制之下。

paras.en: "The current Starshield restrictions suggest that SpaceX imposed them," Zelenskyy said. "That's what our team is telling me. So this doesn't quite line up with what we heard earlier. That's why we need to get to the bottom of all this."
paras.zh: “目前的星盾限制表明 SpaceX 强加了这些限制，”泽伦斯基说。 “这就是我们的团队告诉我的。所以这与我们之前听到的不太相符。这就是为什么我们需要查清这一切的真相。”

articles.title: New Orleans port sues for control of China-linked tanker that crashed into cruise ship

paras.en: New Orleans port sues for control of China-linked tanker that crashed into cruise ship
paras.zh: 新奥尔良港起诉撞上游轮的与中国有关的油轮的控制权

paras.en: Move comes hours after tanker lost its steering, slammed into docked river cruise boat
paras.zh: 油轮失去转向并撞上停靠的内河游轮数小时后采取了行动

paras.en: Just hours after a tanker in New Orleans lost its steering and slammed into a docked river cruise boat, the city's port sued to make sure federal investigators can seize the vessel that is owned by a subsidiary of a Chinese company.
paras.zh: 就在新奥尔良的一艘油轮失去转向并撞上一艘停靠在码头的内河游轮几小时后，该市港口提起诉讼，以确保联邦调查人员能够扣押一家中国公司子公司拥有的这艘船。

paras.en: All 197 passengers and crew on the American Heritage cruise ship survived Friday, as well as the crew on the tanker.
paras.zh: 美国传统游轮上的所有 197 名乘客和船员以及油轮上的船员周五全部生还。

paras.en: Officials said 32 people were taken to hospital, including two police officers thrown into the Mississippi River when the boat rolled. None of the injuries were critical and eight remained hospitalized Saturday.
paras.zh: 官员称，32人被送往医院，其中包括两名警察在船翻滚时被扔进密西西比河。伤情均不严重，周六仍有八人住院。

paras.en: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) said the tanker's voyage data recorder has been recovered. The device — the maritime equivalent of a flight data recorder — records information such as the vessel's speed and audio from the bridge.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）表示，油轮的航行数据记录仪已被找到。该设备相当于海上飞行数据记录器，可记录船速和驾驶台音频等信息。

paras.en: NTSB member John DeLeeuw said the agency expects to release a preliminary report within 30 days, with the final investigation report expected in 18-24 months. A 16-member team will spend a week in New Orleans investigating the incident.
paras.zh: NTSB 成员 John DeLeeuw 表示，该机构预计将在 30 天内发布初步报告，最终调查报告预计将在 18-24 个月内发布。一个由 16 名成员组成的团队将在新奥尔良花费一周时间调查这一事件。

paras.en: The lawsuit filed by the Board of Commissioners of the Port of New Orleans said the Atlantic Asphalt tanker caused at least $1 million US in damage to its terminal. A judge issued a warrant Friday giving federal officials control of the ship for now.
paras.zh: 新奥尔良港委员会提起的诉讼称，大西洋沥青油轮对其码头造成了至少100万美元的损失。周五，一名法官发出逮捕令，让联邦官员暂时控制这艘船。

paras.en: The tanker has been towed away from the site, but it could take weeks to move the cruise ship, which remains turned on its side against a terminal in the Mississippi River, Coast Guard Capt. Melanie Burnham told reporters Saturday.
paras.zh: 海岸警卫队上尉梅兰妮·伯纳姆周六告诉记者，这艘油轮已被拖离现场，但可能需要数周时间才能移动这艘游轮，该游轮仍侧向密西西比河的一个码头。

paras.en: It could take weeks to move the cruise ship, which remains turned on its side against a terminal in the Mississippi River. (Matthew Hinton/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 移动这艘游轮可能需要数周时间，目前游轮仍侧向密西西比河的一个码头。 （马修·辛顿/美联社）

paras.en: The first step is to make sure the 60,500 litres of fuel on the boat are removed safely, she said. Traffic has been limited on the Mississippi River, but Burnham said boats should be able to move both upstream and downstream soon.
paras.zh: 她说，第一步是确保船上 60,500 升燃料被安全清除。密西西比河的交通受到限制，但伯纳姆表示，船只应该很快就能向上游和下游移动。

paras.en: The tanker appeared to lose steering, but the exact cause of the crash is not known, Burnham said. The U.S. National Transportation Safety Board was sending investigators to New Orleans.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆说，这艘油轮似乎失去了转向能力，但坠机的确切原因尚不清楚。美国国家运输安全委员会正在派遣调查人员前往新奥尔良。

paras.en: The first warning people on board the American Heritage had was the tanker blasting its horn several times as it floated toward the cruise ship, passenger Joe Knab told local news outlet WDSU-TV.
paras.zh: 乘客乔·纳布 (Joe Knab) 告诉当地新闻媒体 WDSU-TV，美国遗产号上的乘客收到的第一个警告是油轮在驶向游轮时多次鸣响喇叭。

paras.en: The hit was hard, and the ship immediately started leaning. The crew gathered everyone on the third deck to put on life vests and start getting them off the boat, but it suddenly rolled and sent Knab and about 100 other passengers and crew into the muddy Mississippi River, where the water was 19 C.
paras.zh: 撞击很重，船立即开始倾斜。船员们将所有人聚集在第三层甲板上，穿上救生衣并开始让他们下船，但船突然翻滚，将 Knab 和其他约 100 名乘客和船员送入泥泞的密西西比河，那里的水温为 19 摄氏度。

paras.en: Tugboat operators, other cruise ship captains, nearby workers, police and other rescuers rushed to help.
paras.zh: 拖船操作员、其他游轮船长、附近工人、警察和其他救援人员赶来提供帮助。

paras.en: People are helped out of the water by responders on Friday. Dozens were hospitalized but none of the injuries were deemed critical. (Devon Flanagan/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周五，救援人员将人们从水中救了出来。数十人被送往医院，但没有人被认为伤势严重。 （德文·弗拉纳根/美联社）

paras.en: "It's fine now, but it was a little scary there at the time. I thought I was drowning because I kept bobbing underneath — and the water doesn't taste very good," Knab told the television station, still in the jeans he was wearing on the boat, now covered in mud.
paras.zh: “现在已经好了，但当时有点害怕。我以为自己被淹死了，因为我一直在水下晃动，而且水的味道不太好，”纳布对电视台说，他仍然穿着在船上穿的牛仔裤，现在浑身都是泥。

paras.en: Knab said he thinks he was in the water about 15 minutes. He laughed and said his 20 years in the navy likely helped him.
paras.zh: Knab 说他认为自己在水中待了大约 15 分钟。他笑着说，20 年的海军生涯可能对他有帮助。

paras.en: "They taught us not to drown," Knab said.
paras.zh: “他们教我们不要淹死，”纳布说。

paras.en: Knab was wearing a shirt from a Hilton hotel where the passengers gathered. The rest of his belongings were in the river. Somehow his cellphone still worked. He hoped to get on a plane soon back to Wichita, Kansas, but he was not sure how Friday's nationwide ground stop was going to throw another problem at him.
paras.zh: 纳布穿着乘客聚集的希尔顿酒店的衬衫。他的其余物品都在河里。不知怎的，他的手机还能用。他希望尽快登上返回堪萨斯州威奇托的飞机，但他不确定周五的全国性地面停留会给他带来另一个问题。

paras.en: Putting the life vests on the passengers as they waited to get off the boat likely saved a number of lives when the boat suddenly turned into the water, New Orleans Harbor Police Chief Melanie Montroll said.
paras.zh: 新奥尔良港警察局长梅兰妮·蒙特罗尔表示，当船突然掉入水中时，在乘客等待下船时给他们穿上救生衣可能挽救了许多人的生命。

paras.en: "Whether it's 10 feet of water or 200 feet, having those vests, having that population put those vests on and kind of float upriver while we retrieve them — I think was the best factor of success," Montroll said.
paras.zh: 蒙特罗尔说：“无论是 10 英尺深还是 200 英尺深，穿上这些背心，让人们穿上这些背心，然后在我们取回它们时漂浮在上游——我认为这是成功的最佳因素。”

paras.en: The American Heritage was finishing an eight-day cruise to several Mississippi River destinations.
paras.zh: 美国遗产号即将结束前往密西西比河多个目的地的为期八天的航行。

paras.en: Tanker owner a subsidiary of Chinese company
paras.zh: 油轮船东是一家中国公司的子公司

paras.en: The Atlantic Asphalt is a 160-metre-long vessel. It had a final destination in New Orleans, according to MarineTraffic, and was sailing under a flag for the Marshall Islands.
paras.zh: Atlantic Asphalt 是一艘 160 米长的船只。据 MarineTraffic 称，这艘船的最终目的地是新奥尔良，并悬挂着前往马绍尔群岛的旗帜。

paras.en: The ship is owned by a company called Nave Shipping SA, which is registered in Monrovia, Liberia, according to the International Maritime Organization and was one of the defendants in the lawsuit filed Friday.
paras.zh: 据国际海事组织称，这艘船的所有者是一家名为 Nave Shipping SA 的公司，该公司在利比里亚蒙罗维亚注册，是周五提起的诉讼的被告之一。

paras.en: Nave Shipping is a subsidiary of the China State Shipbuilding Corporation, a sprawling Chinese state-owned conglomerate, according to the live shipping tracker MarineTraffic.
paras.zh: 据实时航运追踪网站 MarineTraffic 称，Nave Shipping 是中国大型国有企业集团中国船舶工业集团公司的子公司。

paras.en: China State Shipbuilding Corp. didn't respond to an emailed request for comment.
paras.zh: 中国船舶工业集团公司没有回复通过电子邮件发送的置评请求。

paras.en: The tanker involved in the crash specializes in carrying large quantities of asphalt and bitumen, a semi-solid substance that is often used for road construction and roofing, according to MarineTraffic.
paras.zh: 据 MarineTraffic 称，事故涉及的油轮专门运输大量沥青和沥青，这是一种经常用于道路建设和屋顶的半固体物质。

articles.title: Fact check: 'Iranian' content farms reach millions

paras.en: As fears of regional escalation grew after US strikes on Iran, US President Donald Trump claimed the US-Israel war with Iran was "effectively over" on November 9 at a White House briefing. "We're just keeping it the status quo."
paras.zh: 随着美国打击伊朗后地区局势升级的担忧加剧，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在 11 月 9 日的白宫新闻发布会上声称，美以与伊朗的战争“实际上已经结束”。 “我们只是保持现状。”

paras.en: Periods of heightened public interest, such as the conflict involving Iran, create fertile ground for so-called content farms. Following Trump's statement, posts on the Iran war surged online again. And a growing network of accounts claiming links to Iran's military has accumulated millions of views.
paras.zh: 公众兴趣高涨的时期，例如涉及伊朗的冲突，为所谓的内容农场创造了肥沃的土壤。特朗普发表声明后，网上有关伊朗战争的帖子再次激增。越来越多的声称与伊朗军方有联系的账户网络已经积累了数百万次浏览。

paras.en: DW Fact Check examined a number of these accounts and found recurring signs of content farm behavior. Experts who reviewed the accounts DW provided describe them as part of a broader ecosystem of pro-Iran content aggregators that connect across multiple social media platforms.
paras.zh: DW Fact Check 检查了其中一些帐户，并发现了内容农场行为的反复迹象。审查了《德国之声》提供的账户的专家将其描述为跨多个社交媒体平台连接的更广泛的亲伊朗内容聚合生态系统的一部分。

paras.en: Content farms are websites or social media accounts, or a network of either, producing large amounts of cheap content in a short time span. They may be driven by economic incentives, but they can also serve as vehicles for political influence campaigns.
paras.zh: 内容农场是网站或社交媒体帐户，或两者的网络，在短时间内生产大量廉价内容。它们可能受到经济激励的驱动，但也可以作为政治影响力活动的工具。

paras.en: The internet watchdog NewsGuard has found 165 false claims about the Iran warthat collectively have been watched hundreds of millions of times. Only a few of them originated from Iranian state media.
paras.zh: 互联网监管机构 NewsGuard 发现了 165 个有关伊朗战争的虚假信息，这些信息的观看次数已达数亿次。其中只有少数来自伊朗官方媒体。

paras.en: NewsGuard identified the majority as pushing a pro-Iran agenda, shifting toward AI-generated images, and increasingly claiming that accurate stories from authentic media are AI-generated and false.
paras.zh: NewsGuard 认为大多数人都在推动亲伊朗的议程，转向人工智能生成的图像，并越来越多地声称来自真实媒体的准确故事是人工智能生成的且是错误的。

paras.en: An analysis by the London-based Institute for Strategic Dialogue (ISD) identified pro-Iran networks of X accounts which revealed signs of coordination, cross-promotion and engagement tactics while spreading misleading and AI-generated war content. It found no links to state-affiliated actors.
paras.zh: 总部位于伦敦的战略对话研究所 (ISD) 的一项分析发现，亲伊朗的 X 账户网络显示出协调、交叉推广和接触策略的迹象，同时传播误导性和人工智能生成的战争内容。它没有发现与国家附属行为者的联系。

paras.en: Several accounts identified by DW Fact Check use the Iranian flag as their profile picture and a variation of "Iran Military" in their username. While ownership cannot always be verified, they share recurring characteristics commonly associated with content farms.
paras.zh: 德国之声事实调查发现的几个账户使用伊朗国旗作为他们的个人资料图片，并在用户名中使用“伊朗军方”的变体。虽然所有权并不总是能够得到验证，但它们具有与内容农场相关的常见特征。

paras.en: Content farms use repetitive and formulaic posting formats, as they are cheaper and easier to produce. Their posts frequently start with the word "BREAKING" and imitate the appearance of news updates on the conflict.
paras.zh: 内容农场使用重复且公式化的发布格式，因为它们更便宜且更容易制作。他们的帖子经常以“BREAKING”一词开头，并模仿有关冲突的新闻更新的外观。

paras.en: One account, called "Iran Military Media," is linked to a Facebook account that Iranian state media have verified as authentic. It has built a substantial audience across multiple social media platforms, with over 290,000 followers on X, 597,000 on Facebook and 17,200 followers on Instagram.
paras.zh: 一个名为“伊朗军事媒体”的账户与伊朗官方媒体已核实真实的 Facebook 账户相关联。它在多个社交媒体平台上拥有大量受众，其中 X 上有超过 290,000 名粉丝，Facebook 上有 597,000 名粉丝，Instagram 上有 17,200 名粉丝。

paras.en: It posts a handful of times a day, often sharing AI-generated or AI-enhanced videos and frequently adopting the "BREAKING" format. Since late 2025, it has published more than 1,600 posts on X, generating over 150 million views and 3.6 million likes.
paras.zh: 它每天发布几次，经常分享人工智能生成或人工智能增强的视频，并经常采用“BREAKING”格式。自 2025 年底以来，它已在 X 上发布了 1,600 多篇帖子，产生了超过 1.5 亿次浏览和 360 万次点赞。

paras.en: "The accounts discussed are a central part of this ecosystem as they distribute the pro-Iranian content, state and non-state allied media at relatively low cost and generate millions of views," said Moustafa Ayad, an expert in online influence operations at the ISD.
paras.zh: ISD 在线影响力运营专家穆斯塔法·阿亚德 (Moustafa Ayad) 表示：“所讨论的账户是这个生态系统的核心部分，因为它们以相对较低的成本传播亲伊朗的内容、国家和非国家联盟媒体，并产生数百万次浏览。”

paras.en: Ayad examined 10 similar "Iran Military"-themed accounts during the same period, and their combined reach is even greater. Together, they accounted for 12,588 posts, 353 million views and 6.6 million likes.
paras.zh: 阿亚德在同一时期检查了 10 个类似的“伊朗军事”主题账户，它们的总影响力更大。他们总共发布了 12,588 个帖子、3.53 亿次浏览和 660 万次点赞。

paras.en: This network is replicated on Facebook in numerous languages. According to Ayad, this strategy is part of what the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei outlined as "soft war."
paras.zh: Facebook 上以多种语言复制了该网络。阿亚德表示，这一战略是已故阿亚图拉阿里·哈梅内伊所概述的“软战争”的一部分。

paras.en: Ayad said the accounts' reach is amplified when they are paired with other accounts. Only a small share of "Iran Military Media's" 150 million views came from reposted content.
paras.zh: 阿亚德表示，当这些账户与其他账户配对时，它们的影响力会被放大。 “伊朗军事媒体”1.5亿浏览量中只有一小部分来自转发内容。

paras.en: A second account, "Iranian Force," has amassed more than 248,000 followers. It typically posts around 10 times a day, though on some days the volume exceeds 30 posts.
paras.zh: 第二个账户“Iranian Force”已经聚集了超过 248,000 名粉丝。通常每天发帖量约为 10 次，但有时发帖量会超过 30 条。

paras.en: Like "Iran Military Media," it frequently relies on "BREAKING" alerts and AI-generated content. It also includes genuine footage, often framed through a pro-Iran lens.
paras.zh: 与“伊朗军事媒体”一样，它经常依赖“突发”警报和人工智能生成的内容。它还包括真实的镜头，通常是通过支持伊朗的镜头拍摄的。

paras.en: X lists the account as being based in Pakistan and its profile history shows six username changes. In a break from the Iran-related content, one post suddenly defends a Pakistani TikToker and includes an appeal in Urdu to the government in Pakistan.
paras.zh: X 将该帐户列为位于巴基斯坦，其个人资料历史记录显示六次用户名更改。与伊朗相关的内容不同，一篇帖子突然为一名巴基斯坦 TikToker 辩护，并用乌尔都语向巴基斯坦政府发出呼吁。

paras.en: Charlene Lin, an analyst for the internet watchdog NewsGuard, told DW it had flagged this account for multiple false narratives. According to Lin, it is also linked to another account that spreads the same false narratives in coordination.
paras.zh: 互联网监管机构 NewsGuard 的分析师夏琳·林 (Charlene Lin) 告诉德国之声，该账户已标记为多个虚假叙述。据林说，它还与另一个协同传播相同虚假叙述的帐户相关联。

paras.en: A third account, called the "Iran Army," posts a handful of times a day, including AI-generated videos. Its posts regularly reach tens and at times hundreds of thousands of views.
paras.zh: 第三个账户名为“伊朗军队”，每天发布几次内容，其中包括人工智能生成的视频。其帖子的浏览量经常达到数万甚至数十万。

paras.en: Like "Iranian Force," it distributes videos from official briefings by the Iranian Armed Forces while also using the "BREAKING" format to drive engagement. One post claiming "the war has officially started" received over 41 million views.
paras.zh: 与“伊朗力量”一样，它分发伊朗武装部队官方简报的视频，同时也使用“突发”格式来推动参与。一篇声称“战争已经正式开始”的帖子获得了超过 4100 万次浏览。

paras.en: While these accounts differ in reach and post slightly different content, they share many characteristics. The accounts repeatedly share cheaply produced images, at times coordinated between accounts, and make sensational and unverified claims portraying Iran as militarily powerful or politically influential.
paras.zh: 虽然这些帐户的覆盖范围不同，发布的内容也略有不同，但它们有许多共同特征。这些账户反复分享廉价制作的图像，有时在账户之间进行协调，并做出耸人听闻且未经证实的说法，将伊朗描绘成军事强大或政治影响力。

paras.en: Several accounts in this wider ecosystem have faced restrictions. Since March, a number of prominent "Iran Military"-themed accounts have been suspended on X, including "Iran Military Monitor," which had close to 2 million followers before its removal.
paras.zh: 这个更广泛的生态系统中的一些帐户面临着限制。自3月份以来，X上一些著名的“伊朗军事”主题账户已被暂停，其中包括“伊朗军事监测”，该账户在被删除之前拥有近200万粉丝。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Iranian state media issued a statement distancing itself from a range of "Iran Military" accounts circulating on social media, stating that only one account was authentic.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，伊朗官方媒体发表声明，与社交媒体上流传的一系列“伊朗军方”账户保持距离，称只有一个账户是真实的。

paras.en: Yet for social media users, distinguishing that account from the others may not be straightforward. The verified account uses the same "Iran Military" branding and a similar profile picture, while also sharing AI-generated content and frequent "BREAKING" updates.
paras.zh: 然而，对于社交媒体用户来说，将该帐户与其他帐户区分开来可能并不简单。经过验证的帐户使用相同的“伊朗军方”品牌和类似的个人资料图片，同时还共享人工智能生成的内容和频繁的“重大”更新。

paras.en: Despite differences in authenticity and affiliation, many of these accounts consistently adopt a pro-Iran framing. They portray Iran as militarily capable, able to retaliate against adversaries and enjoying international support, while rarely highlighting information that contradicts that image.
paras.zh: 尽管真实性和隶属关系存在差异，但其中许多账户始终采用亲伊朗的框架。他们将伊朗描绘成军事能力强、能够对对手进行报复并享有国际支持的国家，但很少强调与这一形象相矛盾的信息。

paras.en: DW Fact Check found repeated postings of the same content close in time across the accounts and different platforms. The "Iranian Force" and "Iran Military Media" accounts have, for example, posted the same image (here and here), with the same caption on the same day, as have accounts in the wider "Iran Military Media" network.
paras.zh: 德国之声事实核查发现，同一内容在多个帐户和不同平台上重复发布，时间接近。例如，“伊朗力量”和“伊朗军事媒体”账户在同一天发布了同一张图片（此处和此处），标题相同，与更广泛的“伊朗军事媒体”网络中的账户一样。

paras.en: "The pro-Iranian ecosystem online is large, multi-layered and cuts across almost all of the various popular social media platforms and messaging services," said the ISD's Ayad. "[It's] a key component to the Iranian government's ability to withstand challenges to its rule both from within and outside, while generating sympathy and connections with other online communities."
paras.zh: “支持伊朗的在线生态系统规模庞大、多层次，几乎涵盖所有流行的社交媒体平台和消息服务，”独立安全局的阿亚德说。 “[它]是伊朗政府抵御来自内部和外部对其统治的挑战的能力的关键组成部分，同时与其他在线社区产生同情和联系。”

articles.title: Nigeria's upcoming election marred by rising AI disinformation

paras.en: Nigeria has just over two months to go until its general election, with incumbent Bola Tinubu running on a ticket focused on combating raging insecurity and resolving the nation's economic crisis. He faces off against former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and senior opposition figure Peter Obi.
paras.zh: 距离尼日利亚大选只剩下两个多月的时间，现任总统博拉·蒂努布的竞选重点是消除严重的不安全局势并解决该国的经济危机。他与前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔和高级反对派人物彼得·奥比对峙。

paras.en: The country's electoral body, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), recently released its preliminary voter's register, which reportedly is riddled with images believed to have been generated using artificial intelligence (AI).
paras.zh: 该国选举机构国家独立选举委员会（INEC）最近发布了初步选民登记册，据报道，登记册上充斥着据信是使用人工智能（AI）生成的图像。

paras.en: Among the telltale signs of AI usage were exaggerated facial features in images and inconsistencies on the electoral registers, such as duplicates of names and even identities of people who since the previous election had died.
paras.zh: 人工智能使用的明显迹象包括图像中夸张的面部特征和选举登记册上的不一致，例如自上次选举以来已去世的人的姓名甚至身份重复。

paras.en: The development raises concerns about the body's overall preparedness ahead of the country's upcoming 2027 general election. Instead of making the upcoming vote more transparent by allowing access to its procedures, INEC has come under fire amid broader controversies about the expanding influence of AI in elections across the continent.
paras.zh: 这一事态发展引发了人们对该机构在该国即将到来的 2027 年大选之前的整体准备情况的担忧。由于人工智能在非洲大陆选举中影响力不断扩大的广泛争议，INEC 并没有通过允许访问其程序来使即将到来的投票更加透明，而是受到了批评。

paras.en: Joash Amupitan, the chairman of the electoral commission, said the body is now investigating the development, focusing on discrepancies potentially created by AI use.
paras.zh: 选举委员会主席乔什·阿穆皮坦表示，该机构正在调查事态发展，重点关注人工智能的使用可能造成的差异。

paras.en: To this end, he announced the establishment of a dedicated unit to monitor AI-related threats, detect deepfakes and strengthen the integrity of the electoral process, warning that the credibility of the upcoming election could otherwise be under attack.
paras.zh: 为此，他宣布成立一个专门部门来监控人工智能相关威胁、检测深度造假并加强选举过程的完整性，并警告说，否则即将举行的选举的可信度可能会受到攻击。

paras.en: However, even prior to the proliferation of AI across Africa and the globe, this would not be the first time that Nigeria has found itself in the unfortunate position of having to deal with the circulation of fabricated images, doctored audio and fake videos online. In the run-up to the 2023 election, deepfakes falsely linking candidates to terror-related activities filled social media platforms.
paras.zh: 然而，即使在人工智能在非洲和全球范围内扩散之前，尼日利亚也不是第一次发现自己处于不得不应对网上伪造图像、篡改音频和虚假视频传播的不幸境地。在 2023 年大选前夕，社交媒体平台上充斥着将候选人与恐怖相关活动错误联系起来的深度造假内容。

paras.en: These are often designed to promote certain candidates or to discredit opponents in a bid to influence public perception, which now with the use of AI could create disinformation campaigns of new proportions.
paras.zh: 这些通常旨在宣传某些候选人或抹黑对手，以影响公众的看法，而现在，随着人工智能的使用，这可能会造成新规模的虚假信息活动。

paras.en: Artificial intelligence has various effects on voter behavior
paras.zh: 人工智能对选民行为有多种影响

paras.en: Lois Ugbede, the assistant editor at the factchecking platform DUBAWA, told DW that "based on our monitoring so far, AI-driven disinformation is serious and is becoming commonplace."
paras.zh: 事实核查平台 DUBAWA 的助理编辑洛伊丝·乌格贝德 (Lois Ugbede) 告诉德国之声，“根据我们迄今为止的监测，人工智能驱动的虚假信息非常严重，而且正在变得司空见惯。”

paras.en: "This could influence political discourse and voter behavior ahead of 2027 because we are already seeing parties using inflated crowds to show that they have a large followership or support," she added.
paras.zh: “这可能会影响 2027 年之前的政治言论和选民行为，因为我们已经看到政党利用膨胀的人群来表明他们拥有大量的追随者或支持，”她补充道。

paras.en: At the same time, rather than influencing the vote in favor of any particular candidate, "the deeper danger is that people may begin to doubt authentic information simply because they know convincing AI-generated fakes are possible," said Akintunde Babatunde, executive director of the Abuja-based Centre for Journalism, Innovation and Development.
paras.zh: 与此同时，阿布贾新闻、创新与发展中心执行主任阿金通德·巴巴通德 (Akintunde Babatunde) 表示，“更深层次的危险是，人们可能会开始怀疑真实信息，因为他们知道人工智能可能会生成令人信服的虚假信息，而不是影响对任何特定候选人的投票”。

paras.en: "We often focus on the risk of people believing an AI-generated falsehood, but there is another problem where genuine evidence can be dismissed as AI-generated," he noted, citing instances of a lawmaker who recently made inflammatory remarks during a campaign rally — but then claimed the clips were manipulated.
paras.zh: 他指出：“我们经常关注人们相信人工智能生成的谎言的风险，但还有另一个问题，即真实的证据可能会被视为人工智能生成而被驳回。”他引用了一位立法者的例子，该议员最近在一次竞选集会上发表了煽动性言论，但随后声称这些剪辑被操纵了。

paras.en: Further pitfalls behind a lack of safeguards against AI
paras.zh: 缺乏人工智能保障措施背后的更多陷阱

paras.en: Chibuike Mgbeahuruike, an election consultant at the Centre for Democracy and Development, told DW that apart from the spread of synthetic content online, AI intrusion into the electoral commission's portal could also "undermine its institutional credibility, especially with the low level of confidence that we are already witnessing."
paras.zh: 民主与发展中心的选举顾问奇布伊克·姆贝阿鲁伊克 (Chibuike Mgbeahuruike) 告诉德国之声，除了网上合成内容的传播之外，人工智能对选举委员会门户网站的入侵也可能“损害其机构可信度，尤其是在我们已经目睹的信任度较低的情况下”。

paras.en: He added, however, that AI itself is not inherently a threat to electoral integrity. The real threat lies in "the absence of effective accountability for its deployment," as innovations in tech increasingly appear to infiltrate governments and their democratic processes.
paras.zh: 不过，他补充说，人工智能本身并不是对选举公正性的固有威胁。真正的威胁在于“缺乏对其部署的有效问责”，因为技术创新似乎越来越多地渗透到政府及其民主进程中。

paras.en: "Voters must have confidence … that the technology is also transparent, accountable and independently scrutinized, and ultimately subject to human and institutional oversight," said Mgbeahuruike.
paras.zh: Mgbeahuruike 表示：“选民必须有信心……该技术也是透明的、负责任的、独立审查的，并最终受到人类和机构的监督。”

paras.en: Mallam Jibrin Baba Ndace, the director-general of state-owned broadcaster Voice of Nigeria, agrees, urging journalists at a recent conference also to not fall into the trap of believing reports, which later could turn out to be false due to AI manipulation.
paras.zh: 国有广播公司尼日利亚之声的总干事马拉姆·吉布林·巴巴·恩达斯 (Mallam Jibrin Baba Ndace) 对此表示同意，他在最近的一次会议上敦促记者不要陷入相信报道的陷阱，这些报道后来可能会因人工智能操纵而被证明是虚假的。

paras.en: He stressed the importance of protection measures and due diligence in news media, with the growing inability of public institutions like INEC to provide impartial information due to the use and influence of AI and other election-related tech.
paras.zh: 他强调了新闻媒体采取保护措施和尽职调查的重要性，因为随着人工智能和其他与选举相关的技术的使用和影响，像 INEC 这样的公共机构越来越无法提供公正的信息。

paras.en: Nigeria's marred relationship with new tech
paras.zh: 尼日利亚与新技术的关系受损

paras.en: Beyond AI, Nigeria's electoral processes have undergone various technological shifts over the years in hopes of improving transparency while increasing efficiency.
paras.zh: 除了人工智能之外，尼日利亚的选举流程多年来还经历了各种技术变革，希望在提高效率的同时提高透明度。

paras.en: Electoral authorities first deployed electronic assistance in 2011, when Direct Data Capture Machines were introduced; the devices collect voters' biometrics by scanning fingerprints or capturing facial recognition data with webcams to stop voters from submitting multiple ballots.
paras.zh: 选举当局于 2011 年首次部署电子援助，当时引入了直接数据捕获机；这些设备通过扫描指纹或使用网络摄像头捕获面部识别数据来收集选民的生物识别信息，以阻止选民提交多张选票。

paras.en: Ten years later, a system called the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) was introduced as the new standard, designed to combine fingerprints with facial recognition. However, during the 2023 general election, this voting process was marred by system failures, as poor cell signals delayed these voter accreditation procedures.
paras.zh: 十年后，一种名为双模选民认证系统（BVAS）的系统作为新标准被引入，旨在将指纹与面部识别相结合。然而，在 2023 年大选期间，投票过程因系统故障而受到影响，因为手机信号不佳延迟了选民认证程序。

paras.en: However, with INEC tallying more than 103 million Nigerians registered to participate in the coming poll, disinformation, fake news and technological challenges amount to only a few of several concerns pertaining to Nigeria's democracy.
paras.zh: 然而，根据 INEC 统计，有超过 1.03 亿尼日利亚人登记参加即将举行的民意调查，虚假信息、假新闻和技术挑战只是与尼日利亚民主有关的几个问题中的一小部分。

paras.en: Voter apathy has become a particular concern, especially among the country's youth. The 2023 election recorded the lowest voter turnout since the country's return to democratic rule in 1999, with merely 27% of registered voters going to the polls.
paras.zh: 选民的冷漠已经成为一个特别令人担忧的问题，尤其是在该国的年轻人中。 2023 年的选举创下了该国 1999 年恢复民主统治以来的最低投票率，只有 27% 的登记选民参加了投票。

articles.title: Beijing faces its Russia dilemma amid talk of Xi-Trump-Putin summit

paras.en: An unprecedented meeting between the leaders of China, Russia and the United States could be happening on the sidelines of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in China's tech hub of Shenzhen this week.
paras.zh: 中国、俄罗斯和美国领导人可能将于本周在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会期间举行一场史无前例的会晤。

paras.en: China has yet to confirm that the meeting will take place. However, a Chinese Foreign Ministry official recently told the press that Beijing was "in communication" with relevant parties. In Moscow, a Kremlin representative said work on "coordination" was underway.
paras.zh: 中国尚未确认此次会议是否会举行。然而，中国外交部一名官员最近对媒体表示，北京正在与有关方面“保持沟通”。在莫斯科，克里姆林宫的一名代表表示，“协调”工作正在进行中。

paras.en: The clearest indication about the potential summit came from US President Donald Trump last weekend. Talking to reporters at a Florida airport, Trump said he "thinks" one of the meetings planned for APEC will be with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping.
paras.zh: 关于潜在峰会的最明确迹象来自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普上周末。特朗普在佛罗里达机场对记者表示，他“认为”亚太经合组织计划的会议之一将是与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平举行。

paras.en: Despite the lack of official confirmation from either Beijing, Moscow, or Washington, the media has already dubbed the potential trilateral summit a "new Yalta," invoking the optics of the US, UK, and Soviet Union convening at the end of World War II and deciding on the new geopolitical power balance in the Crimean resort town.
paras.zh: 尽管缺乏北京、莫斯科或华盛顿的官方确认，但媒体已经将潜在的三边峰会称为“新雅尔塔”，援引美国、英国和苏联在二战结束时召开的会议，决定克里米亚度假小镇新的地缘政治权力平衡。

paras.en: At the same time, nobody seems to be quite sure what the three leaders would talk about if China agrees to host the trilateral summit at APEC.
paras.zh: 与此同时，似乎没有人十分确定如果中国同意在亚太经合组织主办三边峰会，三位领导人会谈论什么。

paras.en: In his brief remarks to reporters on Sunday, Trump avoided mentioning Russia's war in Ukraine when asked about the possibility of the meeting, bringing up only "Iran" and "denuclearization" as possible talking points.
paras.zh: 在周日对记者的简短讲话中，当被问及此次会面的可能性时，特朗普避免提及俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争，仅提出“伊朗”和“无核化”作为可能的话题。

paras.en: The Chinese Foreign Ministry reported "no information" when questioned earlier this week about the potential substance of talks.
paras.zh: 中国外交部在本周早些时候被问及潜在会谈内容时“没有透露任何信息”。

paras.en: A three-way meeting with a photo op would be a big diplomatic win for Russia's President Putin. Since launching the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, the Kremlin chief has faced years of diplomatic boycott by Kyiv's allies, most notably the US under Trump's predecessor Joe Biden.
paras.zh: 对于俄罗斯总统普京来说，三方会面并合影将是一次重大外交胜利。自2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵以来，这位克里姆林宫领导人多年来一直面临基辅盟友的外交抵制，尤其是特朗普前任乔·拜登领导下的美国。

paras.en: Putin first pitched the idea of a trilateral summit last month during a call with Trump. The Wall Street Journal has reported that Putin wanted the meeting to discuss an end to his war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 普京上个月在与特朗普通话时首次提出了三边峰会的想法。据《华尔街日报》报道，普京希望这次会议讨论结束乌克兰战争的问题。

paras.en: For the US, the president standing shoulder to shoulder with the leaders of America's foremost rivals could be a bad look, although Trump has already made a show of personally greeting both leaders with a red carpet at different points during his second term.
paras.zh: 对于美国来说，总统与美国最重要竞争对手的领导人肩并肩站着可能会不太好看，尽管特朗普在第二任期内的不同时刻已经亲自走上红地毯迎接两位领导人。

paras.en: As host, China is in an even trickier position. While Russia and China are broadly aligned on many issues, Beijing does not want to be explicitly tied to Russia's war in Ukraine and harm China's efforts to present itself as a long-term force for global stability.
paras.zh: 作为东道主，中国的处境更加棘手。尽管俄罗斯和中国在许多问题上有着广泛的共识，但北京不希望与俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争明确挂钩，也不希望损害中国将自己塑造为全球稳定长期力量的努力。

paras.en: EU wary of being left out of Ukraine talks
paras.zh: 欧盟担心被排除在乌克兰谈判之外

paras.en: The Chinese government is also working to rebalance economic ties with the EU. The European powers would likely bristle at a summit hosted by China and discussing the war in Ukraine without Kyiv or Brussels present at the table.
paras.zh: 中国政府还致力于重新平衡与欧盟的经济关系。欧洲列强可能会对中国主办的峰会感到愤怒，并在没有基辅或布鲁塞尔出席的情况下讨论乌克兰战争。

paras.en: "China is clearly uneasy about the possible trilateral meeting with the US and Russia, and although Beijing has shifted its position from saying nothing to admitting that the three powers are in contact, the vagueness of these declarations seems deliberate," Alicja Bachulska, Asia policy fellow at the European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR), told DW.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会(ECFR)亚洲政策研究员阿利恰·巴楚斯卡(Alicja Bachulska)告诉德国之声：“中国显然对可能与美国和俄罗斯举行的三边会议感到不安，尽管北京已经从不说话转而承认这三个大国正在接触，但这些声明的含糊之处似乎是故意的。”

paras.en: "Beijing is aware of the potential negative optics of the 'Yalta 2.0' framing, even if this historical comparison is inaccurate and does not reflect current geopolitical dynamics," Bachulska said.
paras.zh: 巴楚斯卡表示：“北京意识到‘雅尔塔2.0’框架的潜在负面影响，即使这种历史比较不准确并且不能反映当前的地缘政治动态。”

paras.en: She notes the trilateral meeting could "trigger further escalation in the already worsening relations between China and the EU" if Ukraine is discussed with no Europeans in the room.
paras.zh: 她指出，如果在没有欧洲人参加的情况下讨论乌克兰问题，三边会议可能“引发中国和欧盟之间本已恶化的关系进一步升级”。

paras.en: For China, there is also little to gain in terms of optics. Images of Xi standing with Trump, the leader of Beijing's top rival, and Putin, Beijing's partner in opposing the US, could present an awkward look.
paras.zh: 对于中国来说，在光学方面也没什么收获。习近平与北京最大竞争对手特朗普以及北京反对美国的伙伴普京站在一起的画面可能会显得尴尬。

paras.en: "Even if the meeting only yields a photo opportunity, it could nevertheless severely erode China's image," Bachulska added.
paras.zh: 巴楚斯卡补充说：“即使这次会面只是提供了一个拍照的机会，它仍然可能严重损害中国的形象。”

paras.en: Beijing and Moscow stick to 'no limits' partnership
paras.zh: 北京和莫斯科坚持“无限制”伙伴关系

paras.en: Putin and Xi have met some 40 times since the Chinese president came to power in 2012.
paras.zh: 自中国国家主席2012年上台以来，普京和习近平已会晤约40次。

paras.en: The two neighboring countries have grown especially close following the declaration of "no limits" partnership accord in early 2022. The move was announced by Xi and Putin on the sidelines of Beijing Winter Olympics, just weeks before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 继 2022 年初宣布“无限制”伙伴关系协议后，这两个邻国的关系变得尤为密切。这一举措是习近平和普京在北京冬奥会间隙宣布的，就在全面入侵乌克兰的几周前。

paras.en: The current Russia-China ties are deeper than they have been in decades.
paras.zh: 当前的俄中关系比几十年来更加深厚。

paras.en: At the core of the axis between the two nations is a long-term strategy to contain US power while fostering an alternative global order both Moscow and Beijing can use for their own ends.
paras.zh: 两国轴心的核心是遏制美国实力的长期战略，同时培育莫斯科和北京都可以利用的替代性全球秩序。

paras.en: Throughout the course of the Ukraine war, which is nearing the end of its fifth year with no solution in sight, Beijing has quietly provided Russia with crucial market for energy exports, while supplying technology and so-called "dual-use" goods.
paras.zh: 乌克兰战争已接近第五个年头，且看不到解决方案。在整个过程中，北京悄悄地为俄罗斯提供了重要的能源出口市场，同时提供技术和所谓的“军民两用”商品。

paras.en: While China did not explicitly provide Russia with weapons, its exports included high-tech components that could be used for modern weapons systems like drones.
paras.zh: 虽然中国没有明确向俄罗斯提供武器，但其出口包括可用于无人机等现代武器系统的高科技组件。

paras.en: Officially, Beijing maintains neutrality on the Ukraine war and has refused to take responsibility for its outcome.
paras.zh: 北京官方在乌克兰战争上保持中立，并拒绝为其结果承担责任。

paras.en: "China is more interested in reforming global governance in ways that reflect its preferences and red lines while preserving a collegial appearance," Aurelio Insisa, senior analyst at the Berlin-based Mercator Institute for China Studies (MERICS), told DW.
paras.zh: 柏林墨卡托中国研究所（MERICS）高级分析师奥雷利奥·英西萨（Aurelio Insisa）对德国之声表示：“中国更有兴趣以反映其偏好和红线的方式改革全球治理，同时保留学院形象。”

paras.en: Even if China agrees to host the meeting, it will likely avoid framing it as three top powers making decisions for the rest of the world, according to Insisa.
paras.zh: Insisa表示，即使中国同意主办这次会议，它也可能会避免将其定位为三个顶级大国为世界其他国家做出决定。

paras.en: "Embracing the 'G3' narrative would undermine its image as a champion of the Global South and developing countries. It is also worth noting that Beijing has shown no interest in engaging with the one pressing issue that could realistically be addressed in such a trilateral format: nuclear disarmament," he added.
paras.zh: “接受‘G3’的叙述将损害其作为全球南方和发展中国家的捍卫者的形象。还值得注意的是，北京没有表现出有兴趣参与可以通过这种三边形式实际解决的一个紧迫问题：核裁军，”他补充道。

paras.en: What are the actual limits of China-Russia axis?
paras.zh: 中俄轴心的实际界限是什么？

paras.en: In a report published in August, the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission (USCC), painted China as a "decisive enabler" of Russia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 美中经济与安全审查委员会（USCC）在八月发布的一份报告中将中国描绘成俄罗斯乌克兰战争的“决定性推动者”。

paras.en: Beijing was "converting Moscow's dependence into lasting military, technological, economic, and geopolitical advantages while avoiding the obligations of a formal alliance," according to the US body.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，北京正在“将莫斯科的依赖转化为持久的军事、技术、经济和地缘政治优势，同时避免承担正式联盟的义务”。

paras.en: However, the commission also noted there were limits to Beijing's strategic support, and intelligence and security concerns remain a constraint on deeper cooperation. The report emphasizes the relationship is more of a strategic alignment than an alliance, with deep mistrust remaining in some key areas.
paras.zh: 然而，该委员会也指出，北京的战略支持是有限的，情报和安全问题仍然制约着更深层次的合作。报告强调，两国关系更像是一种战略联盟，而不是联盟，在一些关键领域仍然存在严重的不信任。

paras.en: Russian defense firms, for instance, have accused Chinese companies of stealing intellectual property. Beijing, on the other hand, is concerned with Russia's growing strategic relationship with North Korea, which has reduced Pyongyang's dependence on China.
paras.zh: 例如，俄罗斯国防公司指责中国公司窃取知识产权。另一方面，北京则对俄罗斯与朝鲜不断加强的战略关系感到担忧，这减少了平壤对中国的依赖。

paras.en: China and Russia also differ on nuclear doctrine. While Beijing maintains a longstanding "no first use" policy, Moscow uses nuclear threats as part of its strategy.
paras.zh: 中国和俄罗斯在核理论上也存在分歧。虽然北京维持长期的“不首先使用”政策，但莫斯科却将核威胁作为其战略的一部分。

paras.en: China getting a 'privileged vantage point' on Ukraine war
paras.zh: 中国在乌克兰战争中获得“有利优势”

paras.en: But for now, the benefits of alignment remain.
paras.zh: 但就目前而言，协调的好处仍然存在。

paras.en: MERICS' analyst Insisa believes the cooperation between Russia and China will largely continue within this year's framework, including Russia providing energy and potentially transfering military technology in the "few remaining areas where it retains an advantage."
paras.zh: MERICS的分析师Insisa认为，俄罗斯和中国之间的合作将在今年的框架内继续下去，包括俄罗斯提供能源，并可能在“其保留优势的少数领域”转让军事技术。

paras.en: "China, in turn, will continue to supply dual-use technologies, purchase Russian energy, provide Moscow with a measure of diplomatic cover, and — more importantly — offer channels for circumventing Western sanctions," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“反过来，中国将继续提供军民两用技术，购买俄罗斯能源，为莫斯科提供一定程度的外交掩护，更重要的是，提供规避西方制裁的渠道。”

paras.en: Notably, China will also get a "privileged vantage point" on how the battlefield in Ukraine is evolving land warfare.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，中国还将在乌克兰战场如何演变陆战方面获得“有利的制高点”。

paras.en: "Strategic distrust between the two sides, particularly Russia's concerns about economic dependence on China, will continue to limit the scope of their cooperation," Insisa said.
paras.zh: 英西萨表示：“双方之间的战略不信任，特别是俄罗斯对经济依赖中国的担忧，将继续限制两国合作的范围。”

articles.title: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift

paras.en: Leaders of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) are meeting in Cambodia amid a dispute between the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Rwanda over who should lead the association of French-speaking nations, which threatens to split the group.
paras.zh: 法语国家国际组织 (OIF) 领导人正在柬埔寨举行会议，刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 和卢旺达之间就法语国家联盟的领导者问题发生争端，该组织有可能分裂。

paras.en: The OIF is holding a three-day summit in the Cambodian capital, Phnom Penh, through Monday. A loose confederation of 90 states and governments where French is spoken or widely used, the OIF has 53 full members, five associate members and 32 observers.
paras.zh: OIF 将于周一在柬埔寨首都金边举行为期三天的峰会。 OIF 是一个由 90 个使用或广泛使用法语的国家和政府组成的松散联盟，拥有 53 名正式成员、5 名准成员和 32 名观察员。

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron, who chaired the last summit in 2024 and will hand the chair to Cambodia, arrived on Saturday and met Prime Minister Hun Manet, The Associated Press news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于周六抵达并会见了首相洪马内。他主持了 2024 年最后一次峰会，并将把主席交给柬埔寨。

paras.en: About 20 leaders are expected, including Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, Vietnamese President To Lam, Rwandan President Paul Kagame and DRC President Felix Tshisekedi.
paras.zh: 预计约20位领导人将出席，其中包括加拿大总理马克·卡尼、越南国家主席林涛、卢旺达总统保罗·卡加梅和刚果民主共和国总统菲利克斯·齐塞克迪。

paras.en: On Monday, leaders will choose the organisation’s next secretary-general for a four-year term.
paras.zh: 周一，领导人将选出该组织的下一任秘书长，任期四年。

paras.en: Rwanda’s Louise Mushikiwabo, who has led the OIF since 2018, is seeking a third term.
paras.zh: 卢旺达的路易丝·穆希基瓦博 (Louise Mushikiwabo) 自 2018 年以来一直领导 OIF，目前正在寻求第三次连任。

paras.en: The DRC, however, which accuses Rwanda of backing the M23 armed group in the country’s east, has threatened to leave the OIF if she is re-elected. Congo, the United States and United Nations experts say Rwanda backs the M23, one of about 100 armed groups in the mineral-rich region.
paras.zh: 然而，刚果民主共和国指责卢旺达支持该国东部的“3·23”武装组织，并威胁说，如果卢旺达连任，将退出法语国家组织。刚果、美国和联合国专家表示，卢旺达支持“M23”运动，该组织是矿产资源丰富地区约 100 个武装组织之一。

paras.en: On Saturday, the DRC withdrew its candidate, Juliana Lumumba, the daughter of independence hero Patrice Lumumba, and backed Romanian former Prime Minister Dacian Ciolos to allow “consensus around a unifying candidacy”.
paras.zh: 周六，刚果民主共和国撤回了独立英雄帕特里斯·卢蒙巴的女儿朱莉安娜·卢蒙巴的候选人，并支持罗马尼亚前总理达契安·乔洛斯，以允许“围绕统一候选人达成共识”。

paras.en: Rwanda’s foreign minister, Olivier Nduhungirehe, said Mushikiwabo would stay in the race. Mauritania’s Coumba Ba, a former minister, is also running, the AFP news agency reported.
paras.zh: 卢旺达外交部长奥利维尔·恩杜洪吉雷赫 (Olivier Nduhungirehe) 表示，穆希基瓦博将继续参加竞选。据法新社报道，毛里塔尼亚前部长库姆巴·巴也在竞选。

paras.en: Macron’s office said that most members agreed on the need for consensus and that he would take it up with his African counterparts. France is the biggest contributor to the OIF’s 2026 budget of 71.7 million euros ($79m).
paras.zh: 马克龙办公室表示，大多数成员都同意需要达成共识，他将与非洲同行讨论这一问题。法国是 OIF 2026 年预算的最大贡献者，预算为 7170 万欧元（7900 万美元）。

paras.en: Rwanda has said Macron asked Kagame to withdraw its candidate and that Kigali refused, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，卢旺达表示，马克龙要求卡加梅撤回其候选人，但基加利拒绝了。

paras.en: The DRC has a population of more than 110 million, roughly 40 million more than France, and is the most populous country where French is an official language. Its exit would be a blow to the organisation, which lost Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso, which announced their withdrawals in March 2025 following suspensions over military coups.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国人口超过1.1亿，比法国多约4000万，是人口最多的以法语为官方语言的国家。它的退出将对该组织造成打击，该组织失去了马里、尼日尔和布基纳法索，这些组织因军事政变而暂停，并于 2025 年 3 月宣布退出。

paras.en: The summit’s slogan is “Reinvest in Peace for Shared Prosperity and Lasting Stability”. Activists see it as a chance to press Cambodia, a de facto one-party state, on rights.
paras.zh: 峰会的口号是“重新投资和平，实现共同繁荣和持久稳定”。活动人士认为这是向柬埔寨这个事实上的一党制国家施压的机会。

paras.en: UN Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews urged delegates to press for the release of detained activists. “No one should be detained for defending human rights, reporting on matters of public concern, or voicing critical opinions,” he said.
paras.zh: 联合国特别报告员汤姆·安德鲁斯敦促代表们施压，要求释放被拘留的活动人士。 “任何人都不应该因为捍卫人权、报道公众关心的问题或发表批评意见而被拘留，”他说。

paras.en: Macron arrived as France faces widespread protests at home. He is due to visit the Angkor World Heritage Site on Monday before leaving for Malaysia.
paras.zh: 马克龙上任之际，法国国内面临广泛抗议。他将于周一参观吴哥世界遗产，然后前往马来西亚。

articles.title: Secret votes and vetoes: How will the next UN chief be picked?

paras.en: Secret votes, coloured ballot papers, straw polls and backroom efforts to force a consensus — with the threat of powerful vetoes hanging over it all. These could be the contours of how boards of mubil-billion dollar corporations decide on contentious issues.
paras.zh: 无记名投票、彩色选票、草拟民意调查和幕后努力迫使达成共识——而强大否决权的威胁笼罩着这一切。这些可能是价值数十亿美元的公司董事会如何决定有争议问题的轮廓。

paras.en: It’s also the way the United Nations picks its secretary-general, the person at the apex of a vast and sprawling machinery tasked with upholding fast-fraying international laws and practices.
paras.zh: 这也是联合国挑选秘书长的方式，秘书长是一个庞大而庞大的机构的最高层，其任务是维护快速磨损的国际法和惯例。

paras.en: That process is now barrelling towards a tense climax, with the UN Security Council holding multiple straw polls in a bid to select its new secretary-general by December 31, when incumbent Antonio Guterres must step down.
paras.zh: 这一进程现在正迅速走向紧张的高潮，联合国安理会举行了多次民意调查，力求在12月31日之前选出新任秘书长，届时现任秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯必须下台。

paras.en: Eight candidates are in the fray — from Costa Rica’s Rebeca Grynspan, the head of the UN Conference on Trade and Development, the organisation’s trade body, and Rafael Grossi, the head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), to Lana Nusseibeh, the United Arab Emirates minister of state for foreign affairs.
paras.zh: 八名候选人参与角逐——从哥斯达黎加的丽贝卡·格林斯潘（该组织的贸易机构）联合国贸易和发展会议主席、国际原子能机构（IAEA）主席拉斐尔·格罗西到阿拉伯联合酋长国外交部长拉娜·努塞贝。

paras.en: The UNSC recommends a candidate who gets nine votes without a veto from its five permanent members. The process ends after the UN General Assembly (UNGA) gives its seal of approval to that candidate.
paras.zh: 联合国安理会推荐的候选人获得五个常任理事国的九票且无否决权。在联合国大会 (UNGA) 批准该候选人后，该过程结束。

paras.en: In effect, the 15-member UNSC chooses the UN chief.
paras.zh: 实际上，联合国安理会 15 名成员选出了联合国秘书长。

paras.en: The council has five permanent members – China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States – who hold veto power.
paras.zh: 该理事会有五个常任理事国——中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国和美国——拥有否决权。

paras.en: Ten elected non-permanent members also make up the council. Bahrain, Colombia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Denmark, Greece, Latvia, Liberia, Pakistan, Panama, and Somalia are the current UNSC members — non permanent members are elected by rotation every two years.
paras.zh: 十个当选的非常任理事国也组成了安理会。巴林、哥伦比亚、刚果民主共和国、丹麦、希腊、拉脱维亚、利比里亚、巴基斯坦、巴拿马和索马里是联合国安理会现任成员——非常任理事国每两年轮流选举一次。

paras.en: According to Article 97 of the UN Charter, the UNSC decides on a candidate and recommends them to the UNGA for a vote by all members.
paras.zh: 根据《联合国宪章》第九十七条，联合国安理会决定候选人，并推荐联大，由全体会员国投票表决。

paras.en: There has never been a time when the council has picked a candidate who was voted down by the assembly, meaning that while, in theory, everyone has a say, the assembly have never gone against the 15-member security council. And because the five permanent members wield a veto, the secretary-general in effect is chosen by them, once they’ve convinced the non-permanent members.
paras.zh: 安理会选出的候选人从未被议会否决，这意味着虽然理论上每个人都有发言权，但议会从未反对过由 15 名成员组成的安理会。由于五个常任理事国拥有否决权，一旦他们说服了非常任理事国，秘书长实际上就是由他们选出的。

paras.en: However, one time, in 1950, the UNGA voted to extend the term of the then secretary-general without the UNSC’s recommendation after a deadlock in the council.
paras.zh: 然而，1950年，联合国大会在安理会陷入僵局后，未经联合国安理会建议，投票延长了当时秘书长的任期。

paras.en: How does the Security Council make its choice?
paras.zh: 安理会如何做出选择？

paras.en: The council holds informal, anonymous polls, also known as straw polls, on whether the members “encourage”, “discourage”, or “have no opinion” about a candidate.
paras.zh: 该委员会举行非正式、匿名的民意调查，也称为“稻草民意调查”，调查成员对某位候选人是否“鼓励”、“劝阻”或“没有意见”。

paras.en: Although it is expected to be secret, the number of encourage, discourage, or no-opinion votes is often leaked.
paras.zh: 尽管预计是秘密的，但鼓励票、反对票或无意见票的数量经常被泄露。

paras.en: In later rounds of voting, coloured paper ballots are used to distinguish between the UNSC’s permanent members and the 10 elected members, providing a clearer sense of where members are leaning.
paras.zh: 在随后的几轮投票中，彩色纸选票用于区分联合国安理会常任理事国和 10 名当选成员，从而更清楚地了解成员的倾向。

paras.en: Once a straw poll confirms that a candidate has at least nine “encourage” votes and no vetoes against them, the council holds a formal vote to recommend them to the UNGA, which is expected to endorse that nomination.
paras.zh: 一旦初步民意调查确认一名候选人至少获得九张“鼓励”票并且没有反对票，该理事会就会举行正式投票，将其推荐给联合国大会，预计联合国大会将批准该提名。

paras.en: Jane Kinninmont, CEO of United Nations Association UK, an independent, non-governmental organisation, explained that the process to select a candidate has traditionally been “closed and secretive” but has become more open as a result of campaigning by civil society groups and member states.
paras.zh: 独立非政府组织英国联合国协会首席执行官简·金宁蒙特解释说，选举候选人的过程传统上是“封闭和秘密的”，但由于民间社会团体和成员国的宣传，选举过程变得更加公开。

paras.en: “However, the Security Council continues to guard its secrecy tightly – part of a political culture that many other countries regard as outmoded,” Kinninmont told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “然而，安理会继续严格保密——这是许多其他国家认为过时的政治文化的一部分，”金宁蒙特告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “One of the stated reasons is that no country wants to have a situation where it votes for one candidate, but another candidate actually is appointed and resents them for not voting for them,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“其中一个原因是，没有一个国家希望出现这样的情况：它投票给一名候选人，但另一名候选人实际上已被任命，并因他们不投票给他们而感到不满。”

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s UN correspondent, Gabriel Elizondo, also explained that the secrecy behind the selection was just due to the way the system was set up.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台驻联合国记者加布里埃尔·埃利松多(Gabriel Elizondo)也解释说，选择背后的秘密只是由于系统的建立方式所致。

paras.en: “Now, there have been some talks in recent years, including this year, about trying to make the process more transparent in the Security Council, but the five permanent members just want to keep it the way that it is,” he said.
paras.zh: “现在，近年来，包括今年，已经进行了一些关于试图使安理会进程更加透明的谈判，但五个常任理事国只想保持现状，”他说。

paras.en: Eight candidates are currently running to become secretary-general, after some dropped out earlier in the race.
paras.zh: 目前有八名候选人正在竞选秘书长，有些人在竞选初期就退出了。

paras.en: Two leading candidates are IAEA chief Grossi from Argentina and Costa Rican Rebeca Grynspan, the UNCTAD head.
paras.zh: 两位主要候选人是来自阿根廷的国际原子能机构总干事格罗西和贸发会议主席哥斯达黎加人丽贝卡·格林斯潘。

paras.en: Grynspan, who, if successful, could become the first woman and first Jewish person to lead the UN, played a key role in brokering the Black Sea Grain Initiative between Russia and Ukraine in 2022. The deal allowed for millions of tonnes of food to be exported from war-torn Ukraine, much of which went to developing nations.
paras.zh: 格林斯潘如果成功，可能成为第一位领导联合国的女性和第一位犹太人，她在2022年俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的黑海粮食倡议的斡旋中发挥了关键作用。该协议允许从饱受战争蹂躏的乌克兰出口数百万吨粮食，其中大部分流向发展中国家。

paras.en: Grossi has headed the UN nuclear agency since 2019, and has been at the centre of the UN’s efforts to prevent nuclear escalations between Russia and Ukraine, amid their ongoing war. But Grossi has also faced criticism, especially from Iran, over perceptions that some of his reports critiquing Tehran’s nuclear programme helped serve as pretext that the US and Israel used to attack Iran.
paras.zh: 格罗西自 2019 年以来一直担任联合国核机构负责人，并一直处于联合国防止俄罗斯和乌克兰之间持续战争中核升级的努力的中心。但格罗西也面临批评，尤其是来自伊朗的批评，因为人们认为他批评德黑兰核计划的一些报告有助于成为美国和以色列攻击伊朗的借口。

paras.en: - Maria Fernanda Espinosa Garces (Former UNGA chief, Ecuador)
paras.zh: - 玛丽亚·费尔南达·埃斯皮诺萨·加塞斯（Maria Fernanda Espinosa Garces）（厄瓜多尔前联合国大会主席）

paras.en: - Lana Zaki Nusseibeh (UAE minister of state at the Foreign Ministry )
paras.zh: - Lana Zaki Nusseibeh（阿联酋外交部国务部长）

paras.en: - Feridun Hadi Sinirlioglu (Organization for Security and Co-operation chief, Turkiye)
paras.zh: - Feridun Hadi Sinirlioglu（土耳其安全与合作组织主席）

paras.en: - Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett (Guyana’s ambassador to the UN)
paras.zh: - 卡罗琳·罗德里格斯·伯克特（圭亚那驻联合国大使）

paras.en: What’s happened in the 2026 straw polls so far?
paras.zh: 2026年的稻草民意调查到目前为止发生了什么？

paras.en: Eight polls have been held so far, but no consensus has emerged on a candidate who has received no discouraging votes.
paras.zh: 迄今为止已经进行了八次民意调查，但尚未就一位没有获得令人沮丧的选票的候选人达成共识。

paras.en: According to the 1 for 8 Billion campaign, supported by organisations and individuals worldwide to call for a fair, open, and inclusive selection process for Guterres’s job, the eighth poll had Grynspan leading.
paras.zh: 根据由世界各地组织和个人支持的“1 for 80亿”运动，呼吁为古特雷斯的职位建立公平、公开和包容的选拔程序，第八次民意调查显示格林斯潘领先。

paras.en: Last week’s poll saw Grynspan receive 12 encourage votes and three discourage votes.
paras.zh: 上周的民意调查显示，格林斯潘获得了 12 票鼓励票和 3 票反对票。

paras.en: In second place, Grossi received nine encourage votes, four discourage votes, and two no-opinion votes. He was followed by Birkett, who received eight encourage votes, five discourage votes, and two no-opinion votes.
paras.zh: 位居第二的格罗西获得了九张鼓励票、四张反对票和两张无意见票。紧随其后的是伯克特，他获得了八张鼓励票、五张反对票和两张无意见票。

paras.en: While it is unclear how the permanent members voted and whether any had used a veto, candidates need zero discourage votes from them to secure the nomination.
paras.zh: 虽然尚不清楚常任理事国如何投票以及是否有人使用否决权，但候选人需要零票数才能获得提名。

paras.en: According to Kinninmont, there is “growing resentment” about the five permanent members of the council using their vetoes that have often led to a paralysed council.
paras.zh: 金宁蒙特表示，人们对安理会五个常任理事国使用否决权的“不满情绪与日俱增”，这往往导致安理会瘫痪。

paras.en: “The appointment of the SG is a different issue from any single conflict, but ultimately this person is supposed to be the world’s leading defender of the UN Charter and a spokesperson for the peoples of the world, in whose name the charter is written,” she said.
paras.zh: “秘书长的任命与任何单一冲突都是不同的问题，但最终这个人应该是《联合国宪章》的世界主要捍卫者和世界人民的发言人，宪章是以他们的名义写成的，”她说。

paras.en: “Thus, it seems hard to defend the idea that any single power should be able to veto a candidate even if that candidate has the support of the majority of other countries on the Security Council and indeed a majority of the countries in the world.”
paras.zh: “因此，似乎很难捍卫这样一种观点：任何一个国家都应该能够否决某个候选人，即使该候选人得到了安理会大多数其他国家以及世界上大多数国家的支持。”

paras.en: On more powers for the General Assembly in the selection process, Elizondo said that while there is talk of reforming the system, it would mean the permanent members would have to give up some of their power.
paras.zh: 关于联合国大会在选举过程中的更多权力，埃利松多表示，虽然有人讨论改革这一制度，但这意味着常任理事国将不得不放弃部分权力。

paras.en: “None of them want to give up their power because, essentially, the truth is, while the United Nations is made up of 193 member states, it’s really the five permanent members (the US, Russia, China, France, and the UK) that really have the overwhelming amount of power to select who the next Secretary General is,” he said.
paras.zh: “他们都不想放弃自己的权力，因为从本质上讲，事实是，虽然联合国由 193 个会员国组成，但实际上是五个常任理事国（美国、俄罗斯、中国、法国和英国）真正拥有压倒性的权力来选择下一任秘书长，”他说。

paras.en: What happens if no one is picked by December 31?
paras.zh: 如果 12 月 31 日之前没有人被选中怎么办？

paras.en: There is nothing in the UN Charter about what happens if no candidate is picked before Guterres’s term ends.
paras.zh: 《联合国宪章》中没有规定如果在古特雷斯任期结束前没有选出候选人会发生什么。

paras.en: The UNSC has some options if it is struggling to decide on a pick, including recommending a candidate for a shorter term or compromising on a candidate, as it did in 1996 to select Kofi Annan after a deadlock.
paras.zh: 如果联合国安理会难以决定人选，它有一些选择，包括推荐一名任期较短的候选人或对一名候选人做出妥协，就像1996年在陷入僵局后选择科菲·安南那样。

paras.en: Member states could also let a senior UN official oversee operations in the meantime.
paras.zh: 与此同时，成员国还可以让一名联合国高级官员监督行动。

paras.en: According to Elizondo, Guterres has also been asked if he would stay on if no secretary-general was selected.
paras.zh: 埃利松多表示，古特雷斯还被问到，如果没有选出秘书长，他是否会继续留任。

paras.en: “He gives a pretty noncommittal answer. He says as of January 1, he hopes to be and expects to be back home in Portugal. What would happen? Nobody knows because that’s never happened before,” Elizondo said.
paras.zh: “他给出了一个相当不置可否的答案。他说从 1 月 1 日起，他希望并预计回到葡萄牙的家。会发生什么？没有人知道，因为以前从未发生过，”埃利松多说。

paras.en: Kinninmont said one way of achieving a more “transparent and democratic process” in selecting a candidate could be for the Security Council to agree on two or three candidates and the General Assembly to vote on those.
paras.zh: 金宁蒙特表示，在选择候选人方面实现更加“透明和民主的程序”的一种方法可能是由安理会就两到三名候选人达成一致，然后由大会对这些候选人进行投票。

articles.title: The French Republic’s forgotten promise of equality

paras.en: Liberté, égalité, fraternité (liberty, equality, fraternity). Every French child learns the motto long before learning what it means to live up to it. It is a powerful promise. So is France’s habit of breaking it.
paras.zh: Liberté、égalité、fraternité（自由、平等、博爱）。每个法国孩子早在了解践行这句座右铭意味着什么之前就已经学会了这句座右铭。这是一个强有力的承诺。法国打破这一习惯的做法也是如此。

paras.en: France has spent more than two centuries struggling to fulfil the French Republic’s founding principles of equality, liberty and fraternity. All citizens are supposed to be equal before the law, and public institutions are meant to serve the common good, regardless of origin or social background.
paras.zh: 两个多世纪以来，法国一直在努力实现法兰西共和国平等、自由和博爱的建国原则。所有公民在法律面前都应该是平等的，公共机构应该服务于共同利益，无论出身或社会背景如何。

paras.en: So, when students at under-resourced schools in Parisian suburbs or rural areas protest against missing teachers, deteriorating conditions in school buildings and years of neglect, their grievances extend beyond the classroom. They are challenging a system that promises equal opportunity while leaving many young people to pursue it with fewer resources than others.
paras.zh: 因此，当巴黎郊区或农村地区资源匮乏学校的学生抗议教师失踪、校舍条件恶化和多年忽视时，他们的不满不仅仅限于课堂。他们正在挑战一个承诺平等机会的制度，但却让许多年轻人用比其他人更少的资源来追求这一机会。

paras.en: As the movement attracted support from workers, unions and other protesters, it has become part of a broader confrontation over the cost of living, the dismantlement of public services and the state’s retreat from its social responsibilities.
paras.zh: 随着这场运动吸引了工人、工会和其他抗议者的支持，它已成为围绕生活成本、公共服务的废除和国家逃避社会责任的更广泛对抗的一部分。

paras.en: The constitutional promise is explicit. The 1789 Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen establishes equality in rights, while the Preamble to the 1946 French Constitution makes public education at every level a duty of the state.
paras.zh: 宪法的承诺是明确的。 1789 年的《人权和公民权利宣言》确立了权利平等，而 1946 年法国宪法的序言则将各级公共教育视为国家的义务。

paras.en: A republic cannot indefinitely tolerate schools whose quality depends on where children live and what their families can afford. When equality exists in constitutional texts but recedes from everyday life, the state loses credibility as the guarantor of l’intérêt general (general interest).
paras.zh: 共和国不能无限期地容忍学校的质量取决于儿童居住的地方及其家庭的负担能力。当平等存在于宪法文本中但远离日常生活时，国家就失去了作为l’intérêt general（公共利益）保障者的信誉。

paras.en: There is a historical reason this contradiction carries particular weight in France. The Revolution of 1789 challenged a social order in which privilege was attached to birth. The Third Estate, encompassing the vast majority of the population, carried much of the country’s economic burden while the nobility and clergy enjoyed advantages denied to ordinary people. The French Revolution abolished the legal foundations of this system and established equal citizenship as a founding principle.
paras.zh: 这种矛盾在法国尤为重要，这是有历史原因的。 1789 年的革命挑战了出生即享有特权的社会秩序。第三等级涵盖了绝大多数人口，承担了国家的大部分经济负担，而贵族和神职人员则享有普通民众所没有的优势。法国大革命废除了这一制度的法律基础，并确立了平等公民权作为一项基本原则。

paras.en: More than two centuries later, there is something of a déjà vu. The French government is not the Ancien Régime, and today’s students are not a new Third Estate. Yet the question that animated 1789 has never entirely disappeared: what does equality mean when opportunity remains so dependent on the circumstances into which someone is born?
paras.zh: 两个多世纪后，有一种似曾相识的感觉。法国政府不是旧制度，今天的学生也不是新的第三阶层。然而，动画 17​​89 年的问题从未完全消失：当机会仍然如此依赖于一个人出生的环境时，平等意味着什么？

paras.en: Hereditary privilege has been abolished as a legal principle, but social privilege can reproduce itself through family wealth, geography, access to good schools and professional networks. The mechanisms might have changed, but the problem has not disappeared.
paras.zh: 世袭特权作为一项法律原则已被废除，但社会特权可以通过家庭财富、地理位置、进入好学校和职业网络来复制。机制可能已经改变，但问题并没有消失。

paras.en: This is what makes the school central to the current movement. Public schools form citizens; they should enable social mobility and should make merit more important than birth. When students protest because their schools lack teachers and adequate facilities, they are confronting the failure of an institution supposedly designed to make equality real. A system that tells young people their future depends on their effort cannot reasonably hold them responsible for failing to succeed in schools it has failed to equip.
paras.zh: 这就是学校成为当前运动的中心的原因。公立学校培养公民；它们应该促进社会流动，并且应该使功绩比出身更重要。当学生因为学校缺乏教师和足够的设施而抗议时，他们面临的是一个据称旨在实现平等的机构的失败。一个告诉年轻人他们的未来取决于他们的努力的体系不能合理地让他们为未能在其未能装备的学校中取得成功承担责任。

paras.en: While protest has deep roots in French history, it should not be reduced to a cultural stereotype. It is a recurring struggle over the authority of a centralised state that claims to represent the general interest. In May 1968, student unrest expanded into a nationwide crisis involving millions of striking workers. The movement did not overthrow the state, but it demonstrated how a conflict within universities could expose wider questions about hierarchy, work and political authority.
paras.zh: 尽管抗议在法国历史上有着深厚的根源，但它不应该被简化为一种文化刻板印象。这是一场针对声称代表普遍利益的中央集权国家权威的反复斗争。 1968 年 5 月，学生骚乱扩大为全国性危机，涉及数百万罢工工人。这场运动并没有推翻国家，但它表明大学内部的冲突如何可能暴露出有关等级制度、工作和政治权威的更广泛问题。

paras.en: In 2018, the Yellow Vests movement expressed a different, heterogeneous revolt against decisions perceived to impose disproportionate costs on ordinary households. These movements are not interchangeable. What connects them is the recurring demand that institutions justify their authority and honour their promises.
paras.zh: 2018 年，黄背心运动表达了一种不同的、异质性的反抗，反对被认为给普通家庭带来不成比例成本的决定。这些动作不可互换。将它们联系在一起的是不断出现的要求，要求机构证明其权威并兑现其承诺。

paras.en: Today, while voicing their demands, student protesters have developed a distinct cultural language during protests. Anime, manga, memes and social media have become ways of expressing solidarity and defiance. References to One, Dragon Ball, the Avengers, Batman and other fictional worlds have also appeared in demonstrations, alongside creative slogans, costumes and visual jokes.
paras.zh: 如今，学生抗议者在表达诉求的同时，在抗议过程中形成了一种独特的文化语言。动漫、漫画、表情包和社交媒体已成为表达团结和反抗的方式。示威中还出现了对《一号》、《龙珠》、《复仇者联盟》、《蝙蝠侠》和其他虚构世界的提及，以及创意口号、服装和视觉笑话。

paras.en: These types of symbols allow young demonstrators to recognise one another, communicate across schools and cities, and express a collective identity that does not depend on traditional political organisations.
paras.zh: 这些类型的符号使年轻的示威者能够相互认识，在学校和城市之间进行交流，并表达一种不依赖于传统政治组织的集体身份。

paras.en: However, their humour should not be mistaken for political shallowness. It is one way of making abstract ideas about injustice, freedom and solidarity tangible and visible both in France and beyond its borders.
paras.zh: 然而，他们的幽默不应该被误认为是政治上的肤浅。这是使有关不公正、自由和团结的抽象观念在法国及其境外变得有形和可见的一种方式。

paras.en: Students’ legitimate grievances have met a state increasingly inclined to treat protests as a problem of security and to use violence as a response, rather than a warning about the condition of public institutions.
paras.zh: 学生的合理不满遇到了一个越​​来越倾向于将抗议视为安全问题并使用暴力作为回应的国家，而不是对公共机构状况的警告。

paras.en: Security and public order have become an excuse for suppressing dissent. France’s experience after the 2015 terrorist attacks illustrates how exceptional powers can outlast the circumstances used to justify them: some measures associated with the state of emergency were incorporated into ordinary law in 2017. A government risks undermining its own legitimacy when it appears more capable of containing the consequences of institutional failure by force than of correcting them.
paras.zh: 安全和公共秩序已成为镇压异议的借口。法国2015年恐怖袭击后的经验表明，特殊权力如何能够比用来证明其正当性的情况更持久：2017年，一些与紧急状态相关的措施被纳入普通法。当政府似乎更有能力通过武力遏制制度失败的后果而不是纠正这些后果时，它就有可能损害自己的合法性。

paras.en: France keeps returning to its revolutionary ideals not because nothing has changed. It returns to them because their meaning remains contested.
paras.zh: 法国不断回归其革命理想并不是因为什么都没有改变。它又回到了他们身上，因为它们的意义仍然存在争议。

paras.en: The republic abolished privilege as a legal principle more than two centuries ago. It has yet to eliminate every way in which privilege reproduces itself. The students are forcing that unfinished question back into public life. And when they do, the state appears more capable of containing the consequences of its failures with brutality, rather than of repairing them. That is the contradiction at the heart of this movement, and the test it poses for the French Republic.
paras.zh: 两个多世纪前，共和国就废除了作为法律原则的特权。它尚未消除特权复制的一切方式。学生们正在迫使这个未解决的问题重新回到公众生活中。当它们发生时，国家似乎更有能力通过残酷手段遏制其失败的后果，而不是修复它们。这是这场运动的核心矛盾，也是它对法兰西共和国提出的考验。

paras.en: Many of the students in the streets will be among the voters in the April 2027 presidential elections. If history is any guide, the condescending response by Macron and his government will only harden student determination to participate in the election process. A higher youth turnout could benefit the left. However, it is up to the left to seize this opportunity, reconnect with younger generations and fill the political vacuum with a solid alternative.
paras.zh: 街头的许多学生将成为 2027 年 4 月总统选举的选民。如果以史为鉴，马克龙及其政府的居高临下的回应只会坚定学生参与选举过程的决心。更高的青年投票率可能有利于左翼。然而，左派应该抓住这个机会，与年轻一代重新建立联系，并用可靠的替代方案填补政治真空。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Former U.S. Ambassador William Taylor discusses the latest Russia-Ukraine talks
articles.author: A Martínez

paras.en: Former U.S. Ambassador William Taylor discusses the latest Russia-Ukraine talks
paras.zh: 美国前大使威廉·泰勒讨论最新的俄罗斯-乌克兰会谈

paras.en: NPR's A Martinez speaks with former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, William Taylor, about the ongoing peace talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine.
paras.zh: NPR 的 A 马丁内斯与前美国驻乌克兰大使威廉·泰勒谈论了美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰之间正在进行的和平谈判。

paras.en: William Taylor has been listening along with us. He served as U.S. ambassador to Ukraine during the George W. Bush and Obama administrations. Ambassador, so I know no major breakthroughs, but a prisoner swap. So is this an accomplishment, nonetheless?
paras.zh: 威廉·泰勒一直在和我们一起听。他在乔治·W·布什和奥巴马政府期间担任美国驻乌克兰大使。大使，所以我知道没有重大突破，只是囚犯交换。那么，这算是一项成就吗？

paras.en: WILLIAM TAYLOR: Not that great, A. Of course, it's good to have prisoners come back. That's always a good thing. But what they're really after is ending the war. They want a ceasefire. And they apparently made no progress toward that.
paras.zh: 威廉·泰勒：没那么好，A。当然，让囚犯回来是件好事。这总是一件好事。但他们真正追求的是结束战争。他们想要停火。他们显然没有在这方面取得任何进展。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: OK. Now, one of the biggest sticking points in these negotiations is the role of Europe, or what role Europe may play in all of this going forward. Moscow doesn't want Europe involved. Meanwhile Europe is focusing on protecting the continent from Russian aggression, any future Russian aggression. So in your view, should Europe be involved somehow in these direct talks?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：好的。现在，这些谈判中最大的症结之一是欧洲的角色，或者欧洲在未来的所有这一切中可能扮演的角色。莫斯科不希望欧洲卷入其中。与此同时，欧洲正致力于保护欧洲大陆免受俄罗斯侵略以及俄罗斯未来的任何侵略。那么在您看来，欧洲是否应该以某种方式参与这些直接谈判？

paras.en: TAYLOR: Absolutely. Absolutely. Not only indirectly, they should be directly there. They should be at the table. As you say, this is about European security. But it's first about supporting Ukraine and allowing them to prevail. And the Europeans have been there, more so now, A, than the Americans. So the Europeans should definitely be there. They have a lot at stake, and they're a strong supporter of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 泰勒：当然。绝对地。不仅是间接的，他们应该直接在那里。他们应该在餐桌上。正如你所说，这事关欧洲安全。但首先是支持乌克兰并让他们获胜。欧洲人曾经去过那里，现在比美国人更是如此。所以欧洲人肯定应该在那里。他们的利益攸关，而且他们是乌克兰的坚定支持者。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: If European involvement, though, is something Vladimir Putin draws a line in the sand on, how does that happen then?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：如果欧洲的参与是弗拉基米尔·普京所划定的界限，那么这是如何发生的呢？

paras.en: TAYLOR: Then the Ukrainians say no. The Ukrainians say, no, we don't have the conversation unless the Europeans are there. And the Americans are also there. The U.S. position is Europeans need to be there. That will be the message, the combined message, to the Russians.
paras.zh: 泰勒：那么乌克兰人就说不。乌克兰人说，不，除非欧洲人在场，否则我们不会进行对话。美国人也在那里。美国的立场是欧洲人需要在那里。这将是向俄罗斯人传达的信息，综合信息。
