articles.title: Global Fossil Fuel Emissions Are Expected to Drop This Year, Partly Because of the Conflicts in Iran and Ukraine

paras.en: In 2020, humans hunkered down amid the Covid-19 pandemic, contributing to an unprecedented 7 percent decrease in global fossil fuel emissions, according to the Global Carbon Project, an international collaboration that releases annual reports on emissions trends. For the first time since then, emissions are expected to fall again, although to a lesser degree.
paras.zh: 根据发布年度排放趋势报告的国际合作组织全球碳项目的数据，2020年，人类在新冠疫情中蛰伏下来，导致全球化石燃料排放量史无前例地下降了7%。自那以后，预计排放量将首次再次下降，尽管降幅较小。

paras.en: Global Carbon Project researchers predict that in 2026, countries will have emitted 42.1 billion U.S. tons of planet-warming carbon dioxide, a 0.4 percent decrease compared with the previous year. That’s partly because of growing solar and wind power, but also a surge in oil prices and supply chain issues sparked by the United States-Israel war with Iran.
paras.zh: 全球碳项目研究人员预测，2026年，各国将排放421亿美国吨导致全球变暖的二氧化碳，比上一年减少0.4%。这部分是因为太阳能和风能发电的增长，但也与美国-以色列对伊朗的战争引发的油价飙升和供应链问题有关。

paras.en: The team described these findings in a preprint report, which has not been peer-reviewed, released on November 10 in the journal Earth System Data Science. Some of the scientists also published an analysis in the journal Nature Climate Change.
paras.zh: 该团队在11月10日发表于《地球系统数据科学》期刊上的一份预印本报告中介绍了这些发现，该报告尚未经过同行评审。一些科学家还在《自然气候变化》杂志上发表了一篇分析文章。

paras.en: “A decline in fossil [carbon dioxide] emissions is encouraging, but a reduction driven partly by geopolitical shocks is not a sustainable climate solution,” says report and study co-author Pierre Friedlingstein, a climate scientist at the University of Exeter in England, in a statement. “The long-term answer remains the rapid deployment of clean energy technologies. While renewables and electric vehicles are increasingly offsetting growth in energy demand, further acceleration is needed if global emissions are to peak and enter a sustained decline.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: According to Friedlingstein and colleagues’ calculations, emissions from oil and gas are projected to decline this year by 1.9 and 0.3 percent, respectively. However, that’s partially offset by a 0.6 percent rise in emissions from coal. (Burning coal generates more pollution than oil or gas.)
paras.zh: 根据弗里德林施泰因及其同事的计算，今年石油和天然气的排放量预计将分别下降1.9%和0.3%。然而，煤炭排放量增加了0.6%，部分抵消了这一降幅。（燃烧煤炭产生的污染比石油或天然气更多。）

paras.en: Did you know? Atmospheric methane surged
paras.zh: 您知道吗？大气甲烷含量飙升

paras.en: In 2020, levels of methane—the second-largest contributor to climate change—surprisingly spiked. Earlier this year, researchers reported that the unexpected surge was caused by dynamics in the atmosphere and natural sources of the gas, including wetlands.
paras.zh: 2020年，甲烷（气候变化的第二大影响因素）的含量出乎意料地飙升。今年早些时候，研究人员报告称，这种意外飙升是由大气动力学和包括湿地在内的天然气源造成的。

paras.en: China emits around one-third of the world’s fossil emissions, making it the country that produces the most carbon dioxide. This year, its emissions declined overall, despite a small bump in coal pollution. That’s likely because China is leading the clean energy transition—it’s responsible for half of global emissions avoided due to renewable energy and electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 中国排放的化石燃料二氧化碳约占全球总量的三分之一，是二氧化碳排放量最多的国家。今年，尽管煤炭污染略有增加，但其排放量总体上有所下降。这很可能是因为中国正在引领清洁能源转型——由于可再生能源和电动汽车的使用，全球减排量的一半要归功于中国。

paras.en: In the United States, which follows China as a polluter, researchers predict a 1.3 percent decrease in emissions in 2026. That’s mainly thanks to a decrease in coal emissions following a spike last year due to high natural gas prices and cold weather.
paras.zh: 在美国，该国是仅次于中国的污染大国，研究人员预测2026年的排放量将减少1.3%。这主要归功于去年因天然气价格高企和寒冷天气而导致煤炭排放量激增后有所下降。

paras.en: Emissions from the rest of the world are projected to decline by 0.7 percent, driven largely by lower oil use.
paras.zh: 在很大程度上由于石油使用量减少，预计世界其他地区的排放量将下降0.7%。

paras.en: “I would call it unexpected,” says study and report co-author Glen Peters, a climate scientist at the Center for International Climate Research in Norway, to Brad Plumer at the New York Times. “It’s pretty rare to see a drop in oil demand this big.”
paras.zh: “我会称之为出乎意料。”挪威国际气候研究中心的气候科学家、研究和报告的合著者格伦·彼得斯（Glen Peters）在接受《纽约时报》记者布拉德·普卢默（Brad Plumer）采访时表示。“石油需求出现如此大幅度的下降非常罕见。”

paras.en: The researchers call this an “energy shock,” a short-term response triggered by the war in Iran. The combat zone caused officials to close the Strait of Hormuz, located partially in Iranian waters and a major global chokepoint for oil transportation. That conflict, along with the Russia-Ukraine war, has caused prices for oil and gas to soar worldwide, forcing many countries to turn to domestic fossil or renewable energy sources, reports the Times.

The team emphasizes that this global decline in fossil emissions will not last without structural efforts to tackle emissions, such as deploying more electric vehicles along with solar and wind projects. In the Nature Climate Change paper, the authors estimate that these renewable energy strategies should offset 64 to 79 percent of increasing emissions from now through 2028. Still, that means the transition to clean energy isn’t yet robust enough to offset the anticipated rise in emissions from growing energy demands.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “There’s plenty of good news in terms of the rapid expansion of renewables,” says report co-author Mike O’Sullivan, a climate scientist at the University of Exeter, to Simmone Shah at Time. “But on a global scale, it’s completely inadequate.”

articles.title: This Mysterious Combination Lock Sank in a 1583 Shipwreck. When Engineers Cracked the Code, It Clicked Open for the First Time in More Than 400 Years

paras.en: In 1999, Peter Hughes stumbled upon the brass combination lock on Margam Beach in Wales. It featured four rotating dials, each bearing six letters. The dials turned smoothly, but only one of 1,296 possible combinations would open the device.
paras.zh: 1999年，彼得·休斯在威尔士的马格姆海滩偶然发现了这把黄铜密码锁。它有四个旋转拨盘，每个拨盘上有六个字母。密码盘转动顺畅，但1296种可能的组合中只有一种能打开该装置。

paras.en: The lock was an artifact from the Ann Francis, a merchant ship that sank in 1583. Hundreds of the vessel’s treasures—including compasses, coins and cannonballs—have since surfaced on the beach. But Hughes was particularly intrigued by the lock. He fiddled with the dials for two decades, trying to solve the puzzle.
paras.zh: 这把锁是“安·弗朗西斯”号商船上的文物，该船于1583年沉没。此后，这艘船上的数百件宝藏——包括指南针、硬币和炮弹——陆续在海滩上被发现。但休斯对这把锁特别感兴趣。他摆弄了二十年的密码盘，试图解开这个谜题。

paras.en: Now, researchers have used CT scans to reveal the four-letter code: ANCE. When they tested it out, the lock clicked open for the first time in more than four centuries. “For me, it’s like opening the Ark of the Covenant,” Hughes tells BBC Wales’ Meleri Williams. “I’m delighted—truly thrilled.”
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员通过CT扫描揭示了由四个字母组成的密码：ANCE。当他们进行测试时，这把锁在四百多年来首次咔哒一声打开了。“对我来说，这就像打开约柜一样。”休斯对BBC威尔士的梅莱里·威廉姆斯（Meleri Williams）说。“我很高兴，真的非常兴奋。”

paras.en: The Ann Francis was traveling from Spain to England when a storm swept in on December 28, 1583. The winds blew it off course, and it ultimately wrecked off Margam Beach in southern Wales. According to a parish register, 14 sailors died in December 1583, and these men may have been the Ann Francis’ crew. The record blamed the incident on “the detestable working of an execrable witch.”
paras.zh: 1583年12月28日，安·弗朗西斯号正从西班牙驶往英格兰，这时一场风暴袭来。大风将它吹离航线，最终在威尔士南部的马格姆海滩（Margam Beach）触礁沉没。根据一份教区登记册，1583年12月有14名水手死亡，这些人可能是“安·弗朗西斯”号的船员。该记录将这起事件归咎于“一个可恶女巫的卑劣行径”。

paras.en: As word spread, looters descended upon the beach, prompting legal disputes over the rights to the ship’s treasures. A few months after the wreck, Francis Shaxton, the owner of the Ann Francis, claimed the vessel and recovered some of the items.
paras.zh: 随着消息的传播，掠夺者蜂拥至海滩，引发了关于船上宝藏所有权的法律纠纷。沉船事故发生几个月后，“安·弗朗西斯”号的所有人弗朗西斯·沙克斯顿（Francis Shaxton）对该船提出所有权主张，并取回了一些物品。

paras.en: For centuries, many more artifacts remained buried beneath the sand. Hughes, a metal detectorist, made his discoveries between 1996 and 2017, aided by dredging and storms that shifted the beach’s sand. He found the combination lock near coin weights and Spanish silver coins—perhaps items that the lock once protected.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，还有更多文物一直埋藏在沙下。休斯是一名金属探测爱好者，他在1996年至2017年间发现了这些文物，疏浚和风暴吹移海滩的沙子为他的发现提供了帮助。他在秤锤和西班牙银币附近发现了这把密码锁，这些物品或许曾是这把锁所保护的物品。

paras.en: “It’s in fantastic condition. It still has its working parts. All of the letters are really clear,” Siân Iles, a senior curator at Museum Wales, says in a video. “I think it’s human nature when you have a code to crack—that’s what you want to do.”
paras.zh: “它的状况非常好。它的工作部件仍然完好。所有字母都非常清晰。”威尔士博物馆高级策展人Siân Iles在一段视频中说道。“我认为，当人们面对一个需要破解的密码时，就会想要破解它，这是人之常情。”

paras.en: Museum Wales recently acquired Hughes’ trove of artifacts, including the lock. Curators decided to ask researchers at Cardiff University for help identifying the combination. They explained that they had an Elizabethan lock on their hands, but nobody knew how to open it. Would they be able to use micro-CT scanners to peer inside?
paras.zh: 威尔士博物馆最近收购了休斯的藏品，其中包括这把锁。馆长们决定请卡迪夫大学的研究人员帮忙破解密码。他们解释说，他们手里有一把伊丽莎白时代的锁，但没有人知道如何打开它。他们能否使用微型CT扫描仪来窥探内部？

paras.en: David Williams, a biomechanical engineer at Cardiff University, was intrigued. Normally, he studies how humans move, sometimes using micro-CT scanners to see inside 3D objects on a very small scale. He didn’t know whether the scans would reveal anything useful about the artifact. But he had a few history buffs on his team, and they agreed to try.
paras.zh: 卡迪夫大学的生物力学工程师大卫·威廉姆斯（David Williams）对此很感兴趣。通常，他研究人类的运动方式，有时会使用微型CT扫描仪以极小的比例观察3D物体的内部。他不知道扫描是否会揭示有关该文物的任何有用的信息。不过，他的团队里有几位历史爱好者，他们同意一试。

paras.en: “Micro-CT scanning allowed us to look inside the lock without damaging it,” Williams says in a statement. “We normally use this technology to study bones and other biological structures, so investigating a 400-year-old padlock was certainly a first for us!”
paras.zh: Williams在一份声明中表示：“微型CT扫描让我们能够在不损坏锁具的情况下观察其内部结构。” “我们通常使用这项技术来研究骨骼和其他生物结构，因此研究一把有400年历史的挂锁对我们来说绝对是第一次！”

paras.en: When the lock arrived, the researchers conducted an initial scan to determine whether this approach was worth pursuing. When they saw that they could make out letters in the images, they realized the answer might be close at hand.
paras.zh: 锁具送达后，研究人员进行了初步扫描，以确定这种方法是否值得继续研究。当他们看到可以在图像中辨认出字母时，他们意识到答案可能近在眼前。

paras.en: The team used the scans to determine how the notches on the lock’s dials lined up with the teeth on the key inside them. Unfortunately, the second scan was a bust. The third, however, was much more revealing, suggesting that the long-lost code was ANCE.
paras.zh: 研究团队利用扫描结果来确定锁盘上的凹槽如何与内部钥匙上的齿槽对齐。不幸的是，第二次扫描失败了。然而，第三次扫描揭示的信息要多得多，表明失传已久的密码是ANCE。

paras.en: “After a couple of days’ work, we were able to be fairly confident that what we had was the correct code,” Alastair Willis, a senior curator at the museum, says in the video. “And then when we took the lock back to the museum, we very carefully tried moving the rings in the right combination.” Right away, he noticed that the four dials felt looser. After conservators cleaned out some of the grit that had accumulated, the lock finally clicked open.
paras.zh: “经过几天的工作，我们有相当的把握认为我们找到了正确的密码。”博物馆高级策展人阿拉斯泰尔·威利斯（Alastair Willis）在视频中说道。“然后，当我们把锁带回博物馆时，我们非常小心地尝试以正确的组合转动密码环。” 他立刻注意到，四个密码盘感觉松动了。在文物修复师清理掉一些积聚的砂砾后，锁终于咔哒一声打开了。

paras.en: The combination lock is now on display at “Tides of Treasure,” a free exhibition at the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea. The show features other artifacts from the Ann Francis, including a boatswain’s whistle and gold coins dating to Ferdinand and Isabella’s reign.
paras.zh: 这把密码锁现正于斯旺西国家滨海博物馆的免费展览“Tides of Treasure”（宝藏潮汐）中展出。展览还展出了“安·弗朗西斯”号上的其他文物，包括一把水手长哨子和几枚可追溯至斐迪南和伊莎贝拉统治时期的金币。

paras.en: According to a 16th-century inventory of items recovered from the wreck, at least three chests had been aboard the ship. Their locks had been broken, and no objects were found inside. The researchers wonder whether the combination lock protected one of these chests.
paras.zh: 根据一份16世纪的船难文物清单，这艘船上至少有三个箱子。它们的锁已被撬开，里面没有发现任何物品。研究人员想知道密码锁是否保护了其中一个箱子。

paras.en: - According to Museum Wales, a similar combination lock is currently housed at the British Museum.
paras.zh: - 据威尔士博物馆称，大英博物馆目前收藏了一把类似的密码锁。

paras.en: - Found in York, England, this early 17th-century lock features one fixed ring and four rotating dials. The word that opens it is MARCI.
paras.zh: - 这把17世纪初的锁发现于英格兰约克，有一个固定的圆环和四个旋转的拨盘。打开它的密码是“MARCI”。

paras.en: “Elizabethan combination locks are known in Britain, but this one is in exceptionally good condition and is associated with a dated wreck, making it a unique find and the code a tantalizing mystery to solve,” Willis says in the statement. “Of course, now we’ve solved it, we are left wondering if the code meant something to its owner.”
paras.zh: “伊丽莎白时代的密码锁在英国并不鲜见，但这一把的保存状况格外良好，且与一艘年代久远的沉船有关，因此堪称独一无二的发现，而密码则是一个令人心痒难耐的谜团，亟待破解。”威利斯在声明中说道。“当然，现在我们已经破解了密码，但我们不禁想知道，这个密码对它的主人来说是否有什么意义。”

paras.en: In addition to the four letters on the rotating dials, the lock features stationary letters on its outer edges. But how these letters align with ANCE is unclear. Whatever the code’s meaning, Hughes thinks the intricately crafted artifact once protected something dear to the owner’s heart.
paras.zh: 除了旋转表盘上的四个字母外，密码锁的外缘还有一些固定的字母。但这些字母如何与ANCE对应尚不清楚。无论密码的含义是什么，休斯都认为这件工艺精湛的文物曾保护过主人心中珍视的东西。

paras.en: “Tides of Treasure” is on view at the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea, Wales, through June 26, 2027.
paras.zh: “Tides of Treasure”展览将于2027年6月26日在威尔士斯旺西的国家滨海博物馆展出。

articles.title: Florida Is Facing Its Worst Dengue Outbreak in Decades, With at Least 524 Locally Acquired Cases. Here's What to Know

paras.en: This year, the Florida Department of Health has recorded a staggering 524 locally acquired cases of dengue, a mosquito-borne viral disease, as of October 31. That’s the highest number recorded there since the disease returned to the state in 2009, according to Forbes’ John Drake. For context, only 62 locally acquired cases were documented in 2025.
paras.zh: 截至10月31日，佛罗里达州卫生部今年已记录了惊人的524例本地感染登革热病例，登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病。据《福布斯》的约翰·德雷克（John Drake）称，这是该疾病于2009年在该州再次出现以来记录的最高数字。为了说明情况，2023年仅记录了62例本地感染病例。

paras.en: Most infected people either do not show symptoms or experience only mild illness. But in early September, a Tampa-area woman named Gay Rabb Small died of dengue on her 80th birthday, after developing a tremor and going to the emergency room, per the New York Times’ Anemona Hartocollis.
paras.zh: 大多数感染者要么没有出现症状，要么仅出现轻度不适。但据《纽约时报》的Anemona Hartocollis报道，9月初，坦帕地区一位名叫Gay Rabb Small的女士在80岁生日那天因登革热去世。在此之前，她出现了震颤症状并被送往急诊室。

paras.en: Later that month, three counties in Florida declared local emergencies over the illness, and in October, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) issued a national emergency response to dengue.
paras.zh: 当月晚些时候，佛罗里达州有三个县因该疾病宣布进入地方紧急状态；10月，美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）发布了针对登革热的国家级紧急响应。

paras.en: “It is very unusual to have transmission in the United States,” Eva Harris, an infectious diseases expert at the University of California, Berkeley, tells the Times. “This is so very much of an eye-opener.”
paras.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校的传染病专家伊娃·哈里斯（Eva Harris）在接受《纽约时报》采访时表示：“在美国发生传播非常罕见。” “这真是大开眼界。”

paras.en: Dengue is a viral disease spread by mosquitoes, mainly the species Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which are both present in Florida, among other places. The disease is more common in tropical and subtropical regions, where these biting insects thrive, than in temperate climates.
paras.zh: 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒性疾病，主要传播媒介是埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊，这两种蚊子在佛罗里达州等地区均有分布。与温带气候地区相比，这种疾病在这些叮咬性昆虫大量繁殖的热带和亚热带地区更为常见。

paras.en: Around three in four infected people are asymptomatic or have mild flu-like symptoms, such as fever, headache, nausea and rash. Muscle and joint pain is another common symptom, which is why the disease is sometimes called “breakbone fever.” Symptoms usually appear within two weeks of being bitten by an infected mosquito and clear up after a week or two.
paras.zh: 大约四分之三的感染者无症状或有轻度流感样症状，如发热、头痛、恶心和皮疹。肌肉和关节疼痛是另一种常见症状，这就是为什么这种疾病有时被称为“骨折热”。症状通常在被感染的蚊子叮咬后两周内出现，并在一两周后消失。

paras.en: However, one in four dengue cases becomes severe. Those symptoms include extreme abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing and blood in vomit or stool, and anyone experiencing them should seek medical care. These signs often appear after the fever goes away, and people who have previously been infected are at a greater risk of severe dengue.
paras.zh: 然而，四分之一的登革热病例会发展为重症。这些症状包括剧烈腹痛、持续呕吐、呼吸急促以及呕吐物或粪便中带血，任何出现这些症状的人都应就医。这些症状通常在发烧消退后出现，既往感染过的人患重症登革热的风险更高。

paras.en: Individuals who recover from dengue can continue feeling fatigued for several weeks.
paras.zh: 从登革热中康复的人可能会持续感到疲劳数周。

paras.en: Although dengue vaccines exist, none are currently approved for use in the United States. They’re authorized in nations where the disease is more common, such as Argentina, Brazil, Indonesia and Thailand.
paras.zh: 虽然存在登革热疫苗，但目前尚无任何疫苗获准在美国使用。这些疫苗在登革热高发国家/地区已获批准，如阿根廷、巴西、印度尼西亚和泰国。

paras.en: Vaccines are also challenging to develop, because dengue has four distinct but closely related virus types, called 1, 2, 3 and 4. When infected with one type, the body builds up pathogen-fighting antibodies against it, and immunity lasts for life, reports the Associated Press’ Mike Stobbe. But if later infected with a different type of dengue, the antibodies might fail to attack that virus and even help the pathogen enter immune cells and make copies of itself.
paras.zh: 疫苗的研发也面临挑战，因为登革热有四种截然不同但又密切相关的病毒类型，分别称为1型、2型、3型和4型。美联社的Mike Stobbe报道称，当感染其中一种病毒时，人体会产生对抗该病原体的抗体，并且免疫力终生有效。但如果后来感染了另一种类型的登革热，抗体可能无法攻击该病毒，甚至会帮助病原体进入免疫细胞并自我复制。

paras.en: Experts say the best way to protect yourself is to avoid mosquito bites. Cover up with loose-fitting long sleeves and pants, apply insect repellent with DEET and control for mosquitoes in and around your home, such as by removing stagnant water—where young mosquitoes live—and treating your yard with insecticide.
paras.zh: 专家表示，保护自己的最佳方式是避免被蚊子叮咬。穿上宽松的长袖上衣和长裤，涂抹含有避蚊胺（DEET）的驱虫剂，并控制家中及周围的蚊子，例如清除蚊子幼虫栖息的积水，并在院子里喷洒杀虫剂。

paras.en: Additionally, there are no specific treatments for dengue. For those with mild symptoms, physicians recommend drinking plenty of fluids and resting. Ill individuals can take acetaminophen to alleviate fever and pain, but they should avoid nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), such as ibuprofen and aspirin, because they can increase the risk of bleeding.
paras.zh: 此外，登革热尚无特效治疗方法。对于症状较轻的患者，医生建议多喝水并多休息。患者可以服用对乙酰氨基酚来缓解发热和疼痛，但应避免使用非甾体抗炎药（NSAID），如布洛芬和阿司匹林，因为这些药物会增加出血的风险。

paras.en: People with severe dengue might need oral or intravenous fluids or even blood transfusions.
paras.zh: 患有重症登革热的人可能需要口服或静脉输液，甚至需要输血。

paras.en: Why is dengue so bad in Florida this year?
paras.zh: 为什么今年佛罗里达州的登革热疫情如此严重？

paras.en: Historically, most U.S. cases of dengue have come from travel to other countries or U.S. territories. Southern Florida has hosted many of them, because it’s a transit hub that welcomes lots of travelers from Puerto Rico and other locations where the disease is prevalent, says Dawn Wesson, an infectious diseases researcher at Tulane University, to the AP. In fact, the state has reported 382 travel-associated cases of dengue in 2026, as of October 31.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，美国的大多数登革热病例都源于前往其他国家或美国领土的旅行。杜兰大学的传染病研究员Dawn Wesson在接受美联社采访时表示，南佛罗里达州是其中许多病例的所在地，因为它是一个交通枢纽，接待了大量来自波多黎各和该疾病流行地区的旅客。事实上，截至2026年10月31日，该州已报告382例与旅行相关的登革热病例。

paras.en: Quick fact: Previous largest statewide outbreak
paras.zh: 简要事实：此前最大的全州性疫情爆发

paras.en: Before Florida’s current dengue outbreak, the largest statewide one occurred in Hawaii. Health officials there recorded 264 locally acquired cases in a six-month stretch from 2015 to 2016.
paras.zh: 在佛罗里达州当前登革热疫情爆发之前，规模最大的全州性疫情发生在夏威夷。该州的卫生官员记录了2015年至2016年6个月期间的264例本地感染病例。

paras.en: However, that means locally acquired cases have outpaced travel-linked ones this year, and many infections have shown up in the central part of the state. Researchers are still trying to figure out what’s behind the trend, per the Times.
paras.zh: 然而，这意味着今年本地感染病例的增幅超过了与旅行相关的病例，该州中部地区出现了许多感染病例。据《纽约时报》报道，研究人员仍在努力弄清这一趋势背后的原因。

paras.en: Rainstorms have recently flooded parking lots and playgrounds in Southern Florida, which could potentially help mosquitoes lay eggs, multiply and continue spreading dengue. Additionally, climate change is continuing to make the state a warmer and wetter place, creating an even more ideal environment for the disease-carrying creatures.
paras.zh: 最近，暴雨淹没了佛罗里达州南部的停车场和游乐场，这可能会助长蚊子产卵、繁殖并继续传播登革热。此外，气候变化正使该州变得越来越温暖潮湿，为携带疾病的生物创造了更加理想的环境。

paras.en: “I think the dengue outbreaks will get worse over the coming years in the U.S.,” Ira Longini, a biostatistician at the University of Florida, tells the Times.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达大学的生物统计学家Ira Longini在接受《纽约时报》采访时表示：“我认为未来几年美国登革热疫情将更加严重。”

articles.title: How to Run SteamOS on Your Mac
articles.author: Justin Pot

paras.en: Most of my Steam collection won't run on my Mac. It's not (entirely) my fault.
paras.zh: 我大部分的Steam游戏都无法在我的Mac上运行。这（完全）不是我的错。

paras.en: I will be the first to admit that my collection is mostly old indie games, all of which work fine on Windows. Less so on the Mac. Apple stopped supporting 32-bit games back in 2019 when it released macOS Catalina. A good chunk of my Steam library has a "No" symbol next to it because of that restriction. And next year it will get even worse: macOS will drop support for running Intel Mac applications, which could leave even more games unplayable (though Apple claims that certain older games will keep working).
paras.zh: 我首先要承认，我的收藏主要是老牌独立游戏，所有这些游戏都可以在 Windows 上正常运行。 Mac 上则不然。 Apple 早在 2019 年发布 macOS Catalina 时就停止支持 32 位游戏。由于这一限制，我的 Steam 库的很大一部分旁边都有一个“否”符号。明年情况会变得更糟：macOS 将放弃对运行 Intel Mac 应用程序的支持，这可能会导致更多游戏无法玩（尽管苹果声称某些较旧的游戏将继续运行）。

paras.en: But there's another way. A free, open source app called FX Steam Launcher boots the ARM version of SteamOS—the operating system that powers Valve's Steam Deck gaming handheld—right on your Mac, using a combination of a virtual machine and compatibility layers. You will need a Mac with an Apple Silicon processor, as Intel Macs aren't supported, running macOS 15 or later. I set this up recently, connected a controller, and I've been playing all kinds of games that are otherwise unplayable on my MacBook Air.
paras.zh: 但还有另一种方法。一款名为 FX Steam Launcher 的免费开源应用程序可使用虚拟机和兼容层的组合，直接在您的 Mac 上启动 ARM 版本的 SteamOS（该操作系统为 Valve 的 Steam Deck 游戏手持设备提供支持）。您需要一台配备 Apple Silicon 处理器的 Mac，因为不支持运行 macOS 15 或更高版本的 Intel Mac。我最近设置了这个，连接了一个控制器，并且我一直在玩各种在我的 MacBook Air 上无法玩的游戏。

paras.en: It wasn't even hard to set up. To get started, download the application, mount the DMG file, and drag the app to your Applications folder. The first time you launch the application, a pop-up will offer to download and install SteamOS for you in a virtual machine.
paras.zh: 设置起来并不难。首先，下载应用程序，安装 DMG 文件，然后将应用程序拖到您的应用程序文件夹中。第一次启动该应用程序时，将弹出一个窗口，要求您在虚拟机中下载并安装 SteamOS。

paras.en: Click Create New Disk, and you'll be asked a few questions. The most important step is the hard drive size—the default is 64 GB, which is plenty, but consider allocating more space if you plan on installing multiple large games. You can also choose the drive location, if you like, and set a password for opening SteamOS.
paras.zh: 单击“创建新磁盘”，系统会询问您一些问题。最重要的一步是硬盘大小 - 默认为 64 GB，这已经足够了，但如果您计划安装多个大型游戏，请考虑分配更多空间。如果您愿意，您还可以选择驱动器位置，并设置用于打开 SteamOS 的密码。

paras.en: Click Create, and the application will download SteamOS and install it in a virtual machine. I recommend using this time to pair a game controller with your Mac in System Settings under Bluetooth. FX Steam Launcher works with most current gamepads, including Xbox, DualSense, DualShock, and Made for iPhone. I used a Nintendo Pro Controller.
paras.zh: 点击“创建”，应用程序将下载 SteamOS 并将其安装在虚拟机中。我建议您利用这段时间，在“系统设置”的“蓝牙”下将游戏手柄与 Mac 配对。FX Steam Launcher 兼容大多数主流游戏手柄，包括 Xbox、DualSense、DualShock 和 Made for iPhone。我使用的是任天堂 Pro 手柄。

paras.en: Eventually, you will see the login screen, where you can enter your Steam credentials. Once you're in, you'll see your Steam library. The virtual machine operates like an actual Steam Deck, which takes some getting used to if you've never used one. It divides your library into games known to work in SteamOS and those that might work, which is helpful. A lot of my games started running immediately, with full gamepad support.
paras.zh: 最终，您将看到登录屏幕，您可以在其中输入您的 Steam 凭据。进入后，您将看到您的 Steam 库。虚拟机的运行方式与实际的 Steam Deck 类似，如果您从未使用过，则需要一些时间来适应。它将您的库分为已知可在 SteamOS 中运行的游戏和可能运行的游戏，这很有帮助。我的许多游戏立即开始运行，并提供完整的游戏手柄支持。

paras.en: This isn't a drop-in solution for every game. SteamOS itself is quite fiddly, and you're now running it in a virtual machine. In some cases, I needed to tweak the graphics settings for games to run correctly. For Psychonauts, specifically, I had to download a user-made patch to get the controller working properly—but I'd have needed that fix for an actual Steam Deck too. When a game ran poorly, I frequently found the solution by Googling and finding actual Steam Deck owners who ran into similar problems.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: There is a limit to the processing power you get out of a Mac, especially if you (like me) are using a MacBook Air. And a virtual machine, by definition, doesn't have access to all of your machine's capabilities. But the list of compatible games, compiled from other users, shows which devices have successfully played various titles. Check that page for your favorite games before you dive in.
paras.zh: Mac 的处理能力是有限的，特别是如果您（像我一样）使用 MacBook Air。根据定义，虚拟机无法访问计算机的所有功能。但从其他用户那里整理出来的兼容游戏列表显示了哪些设备可以成功玩各种游戏。在开始之前，先检查该页面是否有您最喜欢的游戏。

paras.en: If nothing else, this is a lot easier than my previous method for running Windows games on a Mac, which involved setting up a version of Wine that's no longer supported. I even got a few non-Steam games installed. Sideloading on SteamOS means booting into Desktop Mode, which you can find in the SteamOS sidebar under Power. You'll end up in a Linux-based desktop, complete with a web browser. You can download games, put them in the folder of your choice, and point Steam to them. I couldn't add custom art, but I got multiple games up and running this way.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Honestly, Valve should update the official Steam Mac client with similar compatibility tech so it can run Windows games natively. It would be a huge hit with Mac users.
paras.zh: 老实说，Valve 应该使用类似的兼容性技术更新官方 Steam Mac 客户端，以便它可以本地运行 Windows 游戏。这将受到 Mac 用户的巨大欢迎。

paras.en: If you're a power user, I recommend checking out the settings for FX Steam Launcher, which you can open from the menu bar or with the keyboard shortcut Command-comma. You can change the resolution for your virtual Steam Deck, configure the sound to your liking, and submit game statistics.
paras.zh: 如果您是高级用户，我建议您查看 FX Steam Launcher 的设置，您可以从菜单栏或使用键盘快捷键 Command-逗号打开该设置。您可以更改虚拟Steam Deck的分辨率，根据喜好配置声音，并提交游戏统计数据。

paras.en: It's remarkable software. And, with an HDMI cable and a gamepad, you can plug your MacBook into your TV and game from your couch. That's what I plan on doing when I'm done writing this article (which I guess is right now).
paras.zh: 这是一款出色的软件。此外，使用HDMI线和游戏手柄，您可以将MacBook连接到电视，然后躺在沙发上玩游戏。这就是我写完这篇文章（我想现在已经写完了）之后打算做的事情。

articles.title: I Put the Best Digital Notebooks to the Test. Here Are My Favorites (2026)
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: Do you take a lot of notes? Whether it's daily to-do lists, notes for class, or just jotting down thoughts, I've found the best digital notebooks to keep them organized. Sure, you could just open your Notes app, but physically writing something down helps you remember and learn more. Plus, I just love to write things down, and these digital notebooks keep me from burning through paper or losing a great idea I wrote down.
paras.zh: 你做很多笔记吗？无论是日常待办事项列表、课堂笔记，还是只是记下想法，我都找到了最好的数字笔记本来让它们井井有条。当然，您可以打开笔记应用程序，但实际写下一些内容可以帮助您记住并了解更多信息。另外，我只是喜欢写下来，这些数字笔记本可以让我避免烧毁纸张或丢失我写下的好主意。

paras.en: Most of these tablets use E Ink technology to give you a more paperlike experience to write your ideas and notes on. It's easy on the eyes and helps keep you distraction-free as you take your notes as a classic notebook would. As our team's resident obsessive notetaker, I've tried almost every digital notebook on the market to find the best ones worth buying. Whether you want to be able to take detailed notes and access them on your laptop, annotate a book, or have near-never-ending battery life, I've found a digital notebook for you. They're especially great for students who need to do a lot of note-taking and stay engaged without getting distracted by notifications and other apps.
paras.zh: 这些平板电脑大多数都使用电子墨水技术，为您提供更像纸质的体验来书写您的想法和笔记。它既不伤眼，又可以让您像经典笔记本一样记笔记，不会分心。作为我们团队的常驻痴迷记事本，我尝试了市场上几乎所有的数字笔记本，以找到最值得购买的笔记本。无论您是希望能够记下详细笔记并在笔记本电脑上访问它们、为书本添加注释，还是拥有近乎永无止境的电池寿命，我都为您找到了一款数字笔记本。它们特别适合需要做大量笔记并保持专注而又不会被通知和其他应用程序分散注意力的学生。

paras.en: If your notes need an upgrade, I highly recommend giving these a try. If you're looking for more organizational tools and e-paper gadgets, don't miss my guides to the Best Paper Planners, Best Digital Wall Calendars, and Best E-Readers That Aren't a Kindle.
paras.zh: 如果您的笔记需要升级，我强烈建议您尝试一下。如果您正在寻找更多的组织工具和电子纸小工具，请不要错过我的最佳纸质规划师、最佳数字挂历和非 Kindle 电子阅读器指南。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: The Supernote Manta is now our runner-up pick, and the Supernote Nomad is now our budget pick.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：Supernote Manta 现在是我们的第二名优选，Supernote Nomad 现在是我们经济实惠的优选。

paras.en: Comparing Our Favorite Digital Notebooks
paras.zh: 比较我们最喜欢的数字笔记本

paras.en: Neo Smartpen M1+ for $129: If you don't want an entire tablet to write your digitized notes on, you can get a smart pen to use on regular paper that will log your notes into its companion app. The Neo Smartpen M1+ was the thinnest and lightest smart pen former WIRED reviewer Medea Giordiano tried, and she easily used it with notebooks and planners alike. You'll pair it with the Neo Studio app, which has a notebook system that's easy to navigate and organize your notes.
paras.zh: Neo Smartpen M1+ 售价 129 美元：如果您不想在整个平板电脑上书写数字化笔记，您可以购买一支智能笔，在普通纸上使用，将您的笔记记录到其配套应用程序中。 Neo Smartpen M1+ 是前《连线》评论员 Medea Giordiano 尝试过的最薄、最轻的智能笔，她可以轻松地在笔记本和记事本上使用它。您可以将其与 Neo Studio 应用程序配对，该应用程序具有一个笔记本系统，可以轻松导航和组织您的笔记。

paras.en: Neo Smartpen Dimo for $59: This is the cheapest smart pen option and uses replaceable batteries. It isn't compatible with Google Calendar, iCal, or Outlook like our other picks.
paras.zh: Neo Smartpen Dimo 售价 59 美元：这是最便宜的智能笔选项，并且使用可更换电池。与我们的其他选择一样，它与 Google 日历、iCal 或 Outlook 不兼容。

paras.en: Boox Note Air4 C for $470: If you're looking for something a little more powerful than just taking notes and annotating, but still want the E Ink screen experience, then a Boox device is what you need. The Boox Note Air4 C has an e-paper screen and is primarily described as an “e-paper notebook,” but runs on Android 13 and has access to the Google Play Store, giving it more of a tablet feel that happens to have a colorful e-paper screen instead of your usual brightly lit iPad or Android tablet. You're able to easily access the web (called NeoBrowser) right from the Boox homepage, which usually takes several steps and is incredibly slow on a true digital notebook. You'll also access apps that look like a tablet, including an image gallery, calendar, music player, and tools like a clock, recorder, and calculator. It was a pick in this guide, but it's now out of stock for US warehouses (you can still order from the Hong Kong warehouse, but you might have to pay extra tariffs and fees), and there's a new version out, the Note Air5 ($530).
paras.zh: Boox Note Air4 C 售价 470 美元：如果您正在寻找比记笔记和注释更强大的功能，但仍然想要电子墨水屏幕体验，那么 Boox 设备就是您所需要的。 Boox Note Air4 C 有一个电子纸屏幕，主要被描述为“电子纸笔记本”，但运行 Android 13 并可以访问 Google Play 商店，这让它更像是平板电脑，恰好有一个彩色电子纸屏幕，而不是通常明亮的 iPad 或 Android 平板电脑。您可以直接从 Boox 主页轻松访问网络（称为 NeoBrowser），这通常需要几个步骤，并且在真正的数字笔记本上速度非常慢。您还可以访问类似于平板电脑的应用程序，包括图片库、日历、音乐播放器以及时钟、录音机和计算器等工具。它是本指南中的一个选择，但现在美国仓库缺货（你仍然可以从香港仓库订购，但你可能需要支付额外的关税和费用），并且有一个新版本，Note Air5（530 美元）。

paras.en: Kindle Scribe Colorsoft for $630 and Kindle Scribe (3rd Gen) for $500 and Kindle Scribe Without Front Light for $430: The new versions of the Kindle Scribe are still solid all-around devices that have a good mix of e-reader and digital notebook features, but I still prefer the older model's price point. While the new Scribe Colorsoft is a nice option if you want color, I think these are too expensive for what they are. The price comes from all the AI features packed into the device, plus connectivity to services like Google and Microsoft, but it still isn't as powerful as a ReMarkable or Supernote if you want better tools. My picks above are a better price for similar features, though the Scribe does have the most impressive battery life of any digital notebook device I've tried (and that's still true for the older model that I recommend above, too, so you don't need the newest model for the best battery life).
paras.zh: Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 售价 630 美元，Kindle Scribe（第三代）售价 500 美元，不带前灯的 Kindle Scribe 售价 430 美元：新版本的 Kindle Scribe 仍然是坚固的全能设备，具有电子阅读器和数字笔记本功能的良好组合，但我仍然更喜欢旧型号的价格点。虽然如果您想要色彩，新的 Scribe Colorsoft 是一个不错的选择，但我认为它们的价格太贵了。价格来自于设备中包含的所有人工智能功能，再加上与谷歌和微软等服务的连接，但如果你想要更好的工具，它仍然不如 ReMarkable 或 Supernote 强大。我上面的选择对于类似的功能来说是一个更好的价格，尽管 Scribe 确实拥有我尝试过的所有数字笔记本设备中最令人印象深刻的电池寿命（对于我上面推荐的旧型号也是如此，所以你不需要最新的型号来获得最佳的电池寿命）。

paras.en: Moleskine Smart Writing Set for $225: Moleskine is already known for its notebooks, and the brand has a smart version now, too. Our team previously tested a version in 2018 that only cost $149, but the current version that's $224 is next on my list to test. The set comes with a notebook and pen that will pair with the Moleskine Notes app to show you your notes.
paras.zh: Moleskine 智能书写套装售价 225 美元：Moleskine 因其笔记本电脑而闻名，该品牌现在也推出了智能版本。我们的团队之前在 2018 年测试了一个仅需 149 美元的版本，但当前的版本售价 224 美元是我要测试的下一个版本。该套装配有笔记本和笔，可与 Moleskine Notes 应用程序配对以显示您的笔记。

paras.en: Montblanc Digital Paper for $950: Yes, that Montblanc, the one with the famous pens, now has a digital notebook of its own. It's no surprise that I'd call its digital pen one of the best. It's got a super-lightweight feel while sporting three different buttons, two of which you can customize. (There's no eraser, but I'll give it up for that end of the pen to instead be a home button). I really like this device overall, but it's pricey for what you get—aside from the customizable pen buttons, there's not much to differentiate it from my top picks.
paras.zh: 万宝龙电子纸售价 950 美元：是的，那个拥有著名钢笔的万宝龙现在拥有了自己的数字笔记本。毫不奇怪，我将其数字笔称为最好的数字笔之一。它具有超轻的感觉，同时具有三个不同的按钮，其中两个按钮您可以自定义。 （没有橡皮擦，但我会放弃它，将笔的那一端改为主页按钮）。总的来说，我真的很喜欢这款设备，但就你所得到的东西来说，它的价格很高——除了可定制的笔按钮之外，它与我的首选没有太多区别。

paras.en: ReMarkable Paper Pro Move for $449: The ReMarkable Paper Pro Move is similar in size to a reporter's notebook, which turns out to be a pretty great size for daily task and to-do lists. There's room for a multilevel to-do list and brainstorming, and it's a nice, small size with just a 7.3-inch screen. There are other small options on the market, but this is the only one designed like a long notebook rather than a square, e-reader-like design. I like this size to layer on top of a paper planner or slip into a bag. It can do everything the larger Paper Pro can, including packing a color screen, and honestly feels like you sliced off a bottom third of the device and kept using it.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: ReMarkable Paper Pure for $399: This is another good budget option if you want something larger than the Supernote Nomad. It has the same price as the second-generation Kindle Scribe I adore, but with more powerful digital notebook tools instead of a focus on reading. If you're looking for a great digital notebook without spending the better part of a grand, ReMarkable's new Paper Pure is its new basic digital notebook with a black-and-white screen, a lightweight feel, and a great writing experience that is one of the closest things you'll get to writing on actual paper. It doesn't have a front light, though, so you need to use it in lit rooms only.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: ReMarkable 2 for $419 (Refurbished): This is the older ReMarkable digital notebook from 2020, and it's still a great device with a great range of accessories—while they're still available, that is. This device is only available refurbished or secondhand after getting essentially replaced earlier this year with the ReMarkable Paper Pure.
paras.zh: ReMarkable 2 售价 419 美元（翻新）：这是 2020 年推出的较旧的 ReMarkable 数字笔记本，它仍然是一款出色的设备，拥有大量配件 - 也就是说，它们仍然可用。该设备在今年早些时候被 ReMarkable Paper Pure 基本取代后，仅提供翻新或二手设备。

paras.en: Rocketbook Fusion Plus for $30: If you really prefer the paper experience and don't want something you need to charge, then Rocketbook is for you. Rocketbook makes several reusable notebooks, planners, and accessories like index cards and sticky notes. I like the Rocketbook Fusion Plus since it comes with a ton of different template styles, from your classic monthly and weekly pages to project management layouts and meeting notes, making it feel closer to the variety a digital notebook can offer you. Take notes with an erasable Pilot Frixion Pen (one comes with whichever item you buy), scan photos of the pages into the Rocketbook app, and erase the whole thing with the damp microfiber cloth (also included). The app is designed to keep everything organized and easily send things off to Google Drive, Slack, Trello, OneNote, and a handful of other options.
paras.zh: Rocketbook Fusion Plus 售价 30 美元：如果您确实更喜欢纸质体验并且不想要需要收费的东西，那么 Rocketbook 适合您。 Rocketbook 生产多种可重复使用的笔记本、记事本以及索引卡和便利贴等配件。我喜欢 Rocketbook Fusion Plus，因为它配备了大量不同的模板样式，从经典的每月和每周页面到项目管理布局和会议记录，使其感觉更接近数字笔记本可以为您提供的多样性。使用可擦除的 Pilot Frixion 笔（无论您购买的商品都附赠一支）记笔记，将页面照片扫描到 Rocketbook 应用程序中，然后用湿的超细纤维布（也随附）擦除整个内容。该应用程序旨在使所有内容井井有条，并轻松将内容发送到 Google Drive、Slack、Trello、OneNote 和一些其他选项。

paras.en: Do You Need a Digital Note-Taking Device?
paras.zh: 您需要数字笔记设备吗？

paras.en: The short answer is no. These devices are expensive, usually costing several hundred dollars when a simple notebook and pen costs a few bucks. But if you like the physical act of writing but need to have digital copies, they're worth considering.
paras.zh: 简短的回答是否定的。这些设备价格昂贵，通常需要数百美元，而一个简单的笔记本和笔只需几美元。但如果您喜欢实体写作但需要数字副本，那么它们值得考虑。

paras.en: - Digital notebooks are thin and light but hold hundreds of notes.
paras.zh: - 数字笔记本轻薄小巧，但可以储存数百条笔记。

paras.en: - You can transcribe your notes into text files, making them easier to read and manipulate.
paras.zh: - 您可以将笔记转录为文本文件，使它们更易于阅读和操作。

paras.en: - Depending on the device, you can export files as PDFs, Google Docs, Evernote files, and more.
paras.zh: - 根据设备的不同，您可以将文件导出为 PDF、Google Docs、Evernote 文件等。

paras.en: - Most smart pens need to be paired with an accompanying notebook. The upcoming Nuwa Pen promises smart notes on any paper.
paras.zh: - 大多数智能笔需要与配套的笔记本配对使用。即将推出的Nuwa Pen承诺在任何纸张上都能实现智能笔记。

paras.en: E Ink notebooks are easier on the eyes and feel closer to paper than a glass-screened tablet. But in some cases, you might spend less getting an iPad and an Apple Pencil (and a keyboard if you also want to type sometimes). You can also do more on them thanks to the thousands of apps in the App Store. An iPad is pretty intuitive if you're familiar with the Apple ecosystem (though both ReMarkable and Supernote's ecosystems are also very intuitive). Past WIRED reviewers liked using an iPad with the GoodNotes and Notability apps; check out our guide to the Best iPads for more advice on which to buy.
paras.zh: 与玻璃屏幕平板电脑相比，电子墨水笔记本更护眼，感觉更接近纸张。但在某些情况下，您可能会花更少的钱购买 iPad 和 Apple Pencil（如果您有时还想打字，还可以购买键盘）。借助 App Store 中的数千个应用程序，您还可以对它们执行更多操作。如果您熟悉 Apple 生态系统，iPad 会非常直观（尽管 ReMarkable 和 Supernote 的生态系统也非常直观）。过去的《连线》评论者喜欢使用带有 GoodNotes 和 Notability 应用程序的 iPad；请查看我们的最佳 iPad 指南，了解更多购买建议。

paras.en: I also have an iPad, and I'll say the upside of a digital notebook is that the battery tends to last longer, especially if you're the type to use it for a day or two and then forget about it for a few days. My trusty Kindle Scribe usually manages to have plenty of battery available for whenever I feel the note-taking itch, even if it's been a week or two since I last touched it.
paras.zh: 我还有一台 iPad，我想说的是，数字笔记本的优点是电池续航时间更长，特别是如果你是那种会使用它一两天，然后几天就忘记它的人。我值得信赖的 Kindle Scribe 通常会在我记笔记的时候有充足的电量，即使距离我上次使用它已经有一两周了。

paras.en: Just because these devices look like paper doesn't mean they're as cheap to make as a sheet of paper. Like any tablet or smartphone, these devices are packed with features, a special ecosystem, and the E Ink technology is no small feat to perfect, along with a sensation similar to writing on paper. It's an impressive piece of technology.
paras.zh: 这些设备看起来像纸并不意味着它们的制造成本像一张纸一样便宜。与任何平板电脑或智能手机一样，这些设备都具有丰富的功能、特殊的生态系统，而且电子墨水技术的完善并非易事，而且还具有类似于在纸上书写的感觉。这是一项令人印象深刻的技术。

paras.en: Prices haven't gotten cheaper for this category in the wake of tariffs' causing technology prices to rise. ReMarkable recently raised the price of our top pick, the ReMarkable Paper Pro. Another favorite of ours from Supernote has gone up a little less than $50, and Kobo also slightly raised its prices, though the $10 increase is pretty minor compared to other increases we’ve seen. We'll continue to monitor prices and flag if more price changes are to come.
paras.zh: 关税导致科技产品价格上涨，此类别产品的价格并未因此而变得更便宜。ReMarkable 最近提高了我们首选产品的价格，即 ReMarkable Paper Pro。我们喜爱的另一款产品，Supernote 的产品价格上涨了不到 50 美元，Kobo 也略微提高了价格，不过与我们看到的其他涨价相比，10 美元的涨幅微不足道。我们将继续关注价格走势，并在价格发生更多变化时予以提示。

articles.title: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
articles.author: Matt Burgess, Lily Hay Newman

paras.en: With so much going on all the time, you may not have thought about ransomware and data extortion attacks in a minute, even though they’ve been among the the biggest cybersecurity threats to institutions—and, by extension, people—over the past decade. But in the new era of AI-powered and automated cyberattacks, the danger posed by ransomware is only increasing as cybercriminals profit by combining established methods with new techniques made possible or more accessible by AI.
paras.zh: 由于一直在发生如此多的事情，您可能不会在一分钟内想到勒索软件和数据勒索攻击，尽管它们是过去十年中对机构（乃至人们）最大的网络安全威胁之一。但在人工智能驱动的自动化网络攻击的新时代，随着网络犯罪分子通过将现有方法与人工智能实现或更容易获取的新技术相结合来获利，勒索软件带来的危险只会越来越大。

paras.en: It is difficult to determine exact numbers of ransomware attacks, given that victims don’t always disclose incidents and attackers wildly inflate their claims. But researchers who specialize in tracking and attempting to de-duplicate the field agree that claimed incidents have spiked over the last few months. Some put the number of alleged ransomware attacks on leak sites—where groups post alleged victims—at nearly 3,000 attacks over the summer. This would mean a 20 to 40 percent increase since the spring by some estimates. And, crucially, researchers emphasize that while volume always fluctuates somewhat, ransomware attacks overall have been consistently and concerningly elevated in recent years.
paras.zh: 鉴于受害者并不总是披露事件并且攻击者疯狂夸大其声明，因此很难确定勒索软件攻击的确切数量。但专门跟踪和尝试消除重复数据的研究人员一致认为，在过去几个月中，声称的事件激增。一些人认为，泄露网站（组织发布所谓的受害者信息）上的勒索软件攻击数量在今年夏天达到了近 3,000 起。据一些估计，这意味着自春季以来将增加 20% 至 40%。而且，至关重要的是，研究人员强调，虽然数量总是有所波动，但近年来勒索软件攻击的总体数量一直在持续上升，令人担忧。

paras.en: “What we see is most of the recent increase was fueled by international attacks; the United States was a little more steady, but still high, still a lot of attacks,” says Cynthia Kaiser, former FBI cyber deputy director who now leads research for the anti-ransomware platform Halcyon. “Internationally we’re seeing a lot more attacks. That to me is the really new part, and I do think it is in part fueled by AI.”
paras.zh: “我们看到最近的增长大部分是由国际攻击推动的；美国的情况稍微稳定一些，但仍然很高，仍然有很多攻击，”前联邦调查局网络副主任、现在领导反勒索软件平台 Halcyon 研究的辛西娅·凯泽 (Cynthia Kaiser) 说。 “在国际上，我们看到了更多的攻击。这对我来说是真正的新部分，我确实认为这在一定程度上是由人工智能推动的。”

paras.en: Fully AI-powered ransomware attacks have yet to emerge, perhaps because the criminal business model already works so effectively. But cybercriminals do appear to be using LLMs for some of the more mundane aspects of their attacks.
paras.zh: 完全由人工智能驱动的勒索软件攻击尚未出现，也许是因为犯罪商业模式已经非常有效。但网络犯罪分子似乎确实利用法学硕士来进行一些更平常的攻击。

paras.en: “We are seeing AI relied on more heavily in certain aspects of the ransomware attack chain, such as creating better phishing emails and in the negotiation process, but the ‘successful’ ransomware groups are still largely human operated,” says Allan Liska, a longtime ransomware researcher and threat intelligence analyst at Recorded Future. “But the fact that these groups are experimenting heavily with AI means that this could change going forward, and change quickly.”
paras.zh: Recorded Future 的长期勒索软件研究员兼威胁情报分析师 Allan Liska 表示：“我们看到人工智能在勒索软件攻击链的某些方面更加依赖，例如创建更好的网络钓鱼电子邮件和谈判过程，但‘成功’的勒索软件组织仍然主要由人为操作。” “但事实上，这些团体正在大量试验人工智能，这意味着这种情况未来可能会发生变化，而且变化很快。”

paras.en: Kaiser notes that broader trends in scamming are always relevant to ransomware, because attackers often use the same types of phishing and social engineering techniques to gain initial access to targeted systems. In Japan, for example, successful scamming has spiked drastically in recent months as AI enables foreign attackers to generate consistently convincing content in Japanese for the first time.
paras.zh: Kaiser 指出，更广泛的诈骗趋势始终与勒索软件有关，因为攻击者经常使用相同类型的网络钓鱼和社会工程技术来获得对目标系统的初始访问权限。例如，在日本，近几个月来，随着人工智能使外国攻击者首次能够用日语生成一致令人信服的内容，成功的诈骗事件急剧增加。

paras.en: A few ransomware groups—namely, the Gentlemen, Qilin, and Akira—have emerged as some of the most prominent and stable operations in recent months. However, in their shadow is a range of smaller groups, emerging actors, and fragmentation of the ransomware ecosystem. In recent weeks, multiple new ransomware groups have appeared and quickly claimed to have attacked dozens of businesses. Halycon’s analysis says around 111 ransomware groups made claims of attacks between July and September this year.
paras.zh: 一些勒索软件组织（即 Gentlemen、Qilin 和 Akira）已成为近几个月来最突出、最稳定的勒索软件组织。然而，在他们的阴影下，存在着一系列较小的组织、新兴参与者以及勒索软件生态系统的碎片化。最近几周，出现了多个新的勒索软件组织，并迅速声称攻击了数十家企业。 Halycon 的分析称，今年 7 月至 9 月期间，约有 111 个勒索软件组织声称遭受了攻击。

paras.en: One new group calling itself Global Secret Group claimed attacks on 48 victims, with more than half of these being listed on the same day, according to security firm ReliaQuest’s analysis. Another, called Storm, listed 71 victims in just 20 days. Not all of the attacks may be legitimate, but they still cause uncertainty for businesses.
paras.zh: 根据安全公司 ReliaQuest 的分析，一个自称“全球秘密组织”的新组织声称对 48 名受害者发动了袭击，其中一半以上是在同一天列出的。另一个名为 Storm 的网站在短短 20 天内就列出了 71 名受害者。并非所有攻击都是合法的，但它们仍然给企业带来不确定性。

paras.en: “That growth has all happened because, in my eyes, this acceleration that AI has provided to these threat actors, essentially allowing for them to go out and start their own groups,” says Brandon Tirado, the director of threat research at ReliaQuest.
paras.zh: ReliaQuest 威胁研究总监布兰登·蒂拉多 (Brandon Tirado) 表示：“在我看来，这种增长之所以发生，是因为人工智能为这些威胁行为者提供了加速，从本质上允许他们出去建立自己的组织。”

paras.en: Instead of being beholden to traditional “ransomware-as-a-service” providers, all of the researchers Kernel Panic spoke to say they have seen more lone-wolf operators branching out. Tirado says his team recently managed to identify who is behind one new group and found that it is being run by an inexperienced teenager who has made more than $800,000 in under two weeks. He declined to name the teen publicly.
paras.zh: Kernel Panic 采访的所有研究人员都表示，他们没有看到传统的“勒索软件即服务”提供商的做法，而是看到了更多的独狼运营商正在拓展业务。蒂拉多表示，他的团队最近成功查明了一个新组织的幕后黑手，并发现该组织由一名缺乏经验的青少年运营，而他在不到两周的时间里就赚了超过 80 万美元。他拒绝公开透露这名青少年的名字。

paras.en: Halcyon’s Kaiser agrees that more actors are using AI to attempt to strike out on their own with expanded capabilities to trick targets, exploit vulnerabilities, check their code, and even compromise other groups’ remote-access tools to gain redundant access to a victim in case one avenue gets blocked. But she adds that it’s still not clear how successful these upstarts will be long-term. She suspects that many of them may surge initially and then burn out, because they don’t have the institutional knowledge and expanded resources of an established group.
paras.zh: Halcyon 的 Kaiser 同意，越来越多的参与者正在使用人工智能来尝试自己出击，通过扩展的能力来欺骗目标、利用漏洞、检查其代码，甚至破坏其他组织的远程访问工具，以便在某一途径被封锁时获得对受害者的冗余访问。但她补充说，目前还不清楚这些新贵的长期成功程度如何。她怀疑他们中的许多人可能会在最初激增，然后精疲力尽，因为他们不具备现有团体的机构知识和扩展资源。

paras.en: While established attackers typically conduct “double extortion” attacks in which they deploy traditional ransomware that encrypts a victim’s systems while also exfiltrating a target’s data and then threatening to publish it online, those operating independently may be more likely to focus solely on data extortion to simplify their operations.
paras.zh: 虽然成熟的攻击者通常会进行“双重勒索”攻击，即部署传统的勒索软件来加密受害者的系统，同时窃取目标的数据，然后威胁将其发布到网上，但那些独立操作的人可能更有可能只专注于数据勒索，以简化他们的操作。

paras.en: “The number of attacks that Recorded Future has seen this year already dwarfs the total number for 2025,” Liska says, “but the number of attacks involving encryption may actually decrease year over year.”
paras.zh: “Recorded Future 今年发生的攻击数量已经让 2025 年的总数相形见绌，”Liska 表示，“但涉及加密的攻击数量实际上可能会逐年减少。”

paras.en: Spotted something we should include next week? Let us know at [email protected]. And stay safe out there.
paras.zh: 发现我们下周应该包括的内容了吗？请通过 [email protected] 告知我们。并在外面保持安全。

articles.title: Asian love ballads test Eurovision’s winning song formula.
articles.author: Francesca Regalado

paras.en: The Eurovision Song Contest crowned its first Asia champion in Bangkok on Saturday, in an event that tested whether a high-camp singing competition with an ardent fan base could appeal to audiences in a new market.
paras.zh: 周六，欧洲歌唱大赛在曼谷夺得了首个亚洲冠军，这场赛事考验了拥有热情粉丝基础的高强度歌唱比赛能否吸引新市场的观众。

paras.en: Carmelle of the Philippines was declared the winner of the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia, beating out artists and original songs from 10 other countries: Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, Laos, Malaysia, Mongolia, Nepal, South Korea, Thailand and Vietnam. The show was live-streamed on YouTube and broadcast by television stations across the region.
paras.zh: 菲律宾的 Carmelle 击败了来自孟加拉国、不丹、柬埔寨、老挝、马来西亚、蒙古、尼泊尔、韩国、泰国和越南等 10 个国家的艺术家和原创歌曲，荣获首届欧洲歌唱大赛亚洲区冠军。该节目在 YouTube 上进行了现场直播，并由该地区的电视台播出。

paras.en: Eurovision has been a fixture of the European cultural calendar since it began in 1956. Past winners include Sweden’s ABBA and the Canadian chanteuse Celine Dion, who represented Switzerland in 1988.
paras.zh: 自 1956 年开始以来，欧洲歌唱大赛一直是欧洲文化日历上的固定项目。过去的获奖者包括瑞典的 ABBA 和 1988 年代表瑞士参赛的加拿大歌手席琳·迪翁 (Celine Dion)。

paras.en: Asian artists have readily embraced the kitschy outfits and spectacular sets that are part of Eurovision tradition, with costumes that include traditional dress, as well as feathered capes and sequined corsets. Malaysia’s performer plans to enter the stage in a giant teardrop.
paras.zh: 亚洲艺术家欣然接受了欧洲电视网传统的俗气服装和壮观布景，他们的服装包括传统服装、羽毛斗篷和亮片紧身胸衣。马来西亚的表演者计划带着巨大的泪珠登上舞台。

paras.en: But the Eurovision format has not been tested in Asia. Fans and regional partners have expressed concern in recent weeks that budget constraints, production issues and weak audience demand could imperil the spinoff. Organizers say the contest could take time to build an audience.
paras.zh: 但欧洲歌唱大赛的形式尚未在亚洲进行测试。最近几周，粉丝和地区合作伙伴表示担心，预算限制、制作问题和观众需求疲软可能会危及衍生剧。组织者表示，比赛可能需要时间来吸引观众。

paras.en: “It would be profoundly arrogant to think that just because we have a heritage brand and a huge global audience for the European show, that we would walk in and demand it to be the same here,” said Martin Green, the European Broadcasting Union’s director of the Eurovision Song Contest. “Like any new thing, it needs to find its roots.”
paras.zh: 欧洲广播联盟欧洲电视网歌曲大赛总监马丁·格林表示：“仅仅因为我们在欧洲节目中拥有一个传统品牌和大量全球观众，就认为我们走进去并要求这里也一样，那就太傲慢了。” “就像任何新事物一样，它需要找到它的根源。”

paras.en: Two previous attempts to take the competition to Asia were abandoned by the European Broadcasting Union, which owns Eurovision, and its partners in the region. A Eurovision spinoff in the United States, NBC’s American Song Contest, ran for one season in 2022.
paras.zh: 欧洲电视网旗下的欧洲广播联盟及其在该地区的合作伙伴此前两次试图将比赛带到亚洲，但都被放弃了。 NBC 美国歌曲大赛是欧洲电视网在美国的衍生赛事，于 2022 年举办一季。

paras.en: The Asian edition kicking off on Saturday is far smaller than its European counterpart. Eurovision organizers said they were in talks with more countries to join future seasons. They include China, Japan and India, whose music industries have global reach.
paras.zh: 周六开幕的亚洲版规模远小于欧洲版。欧洲电视网组织者表示，他们正在与更多国家进行谈判，以加入未来的赛季。其中包括中国、日本和印度，它们的音乐产业具有全球影响力。

paras.en: “Bringing the world together through music is a fundamentally good idea,” Mr. Green said. “Europe shouldn’t keep it to itself.”
paras.zh: “通过音乐将世界团结在一起是一个根本上的好主意，”格林先生说。 “欧洲不应该把它藏在心里。”

paras.en: As Thailand’s Mang and Daou waited to learn whether they had won, the 26-year-old Mang was shown onscreen crying as if she couldn’t take the tension. That’s the sort of emotion needed to make Eurovision’s expansion into Asia a success. Acts have to want the title. But the show will also need the big Asian nations -- India, Japan and China -- to buy in, and much could now depend on the reaction in the Philippines to Carmelle’s win. The event was far less spectacular than a typical Eurovision in Europe. It also featured far too many ballads for my taste, but it was a fun afternoon’s viewing.
paras.zh: 当泰国选手 Mang 和 Daou 等待知道自己是否获胜时，26 岁的 Mang 在屏幕上哭泣，仿佛她无法承受紧张。这正是欧洲歌唱大赛在亚洲的成功扩张所需要的情感。行为必须想要标题。但该节目还需要亚洲大国——印度、日本和中国——的支持，而现在很大程度上可能取决于菲律宾对卡梅尔获胜的反应。这次活动远不如欧洲典型的欧洲歌唱大赛那么壮观。它还包含了太多不符合我口味的民谣，但这是一个有趣的下午观看。

paras.en: Shiesam Flores, 27, a clerk from the eastern region of Bicol in the Philippines, has been watching the show at a party with her friends — and hoping that Carmelle would prevail.
paras.zh: 27 岁的希萨姆·弗洛雷斯 (Shiesam Flores) 是菲律宾比科尔东部地区的一名职员，她一直在和朋友们的聚会上观看该节目，并希望卡梅尔能获胜。

paras.en: “It was nerve-wracking, nail biting suspense!” she said. “But we know she would win! What a talent!”
paras.zh: “这真是令人紧张、紧张的悬念！”她说。 “但我们知道她会赢！多么有才华啊！”

paras.en: Thailand takes a massive lead thanks to the public vote, but the genius of this voting process is we won’t know whether the Philippines can overcome them until the last seconds.
paras.zh: 由于公众投票，泰国取得了巨大的领先优势，但投票过程的巧妙之处在于，直到最后几秒我们才知道菲律宾是否能够战胜他们。

paras.en: The public gave Beatmosphere, from Bangladesh, just 19 points. They looked surprisingly happy after getting such a low total, and it’s now confirmed they’ve come in a distant last.
paras.zh: 公众只给来自孟加拉国的 Beatmosphere 打了 19 分。在获得如此低的总分后，他们看起来出奇地高兴，现在已经证实他们远远落在最后。

paras.en: The jury votes are all in, and it’s close. The Philippines is first with 93 points, Vietnam second with 83 points and Malaysia third with 82 points. We’re about to learn how many points each country’s act received from the public, starting with the current last place act, Bangladesh’s beatboxing-heavy crew Beatmosphere. It has 16 points.
paras.zh: 陪审团的投票已全部完成，而且结果很接近。菲律宾以93分排名第一，越南以83分排名第二，马来西亚以82分排名第三。我们将了解每个国家的表演从公众那里得到了多少分，从目前排名垫底的孟加拉国的 Beatbox 乐队 Beatmosphere 开始。它有16点。

paras.en: One of the best parts of Eurovision is how the public’s choice is often completely diffferent from those of the juries, so don’t worry if your favorite act isn’t top of the ranking after the jury votes are all in. The Philippine’s jury, the first we’ve heard from, just gave its 12 points to Malaysia. That doesn’t mean it’ll win
paras.zh: 欧洲歌唱大赛最精彩的部分之一就是公众的选择往往与评审团的选择完全不同，所以不用担心，在评审团全部投票结束后，您最喜欢的表演没有名列前茅。菲律宾评审团是我们收到的第一个评审团，刚刚给马来西亚打了 12 分。这并不意味着它会赢

paras.en: The problem Eurovision has with interval acts like Jeff Satur is that their stagecraft, singing ability and melodies are often a million times better than the artists in competition. Satur, who has 1.4 million monthly listeners on Spotify and over five million Instagram fans, has dozens of camp dancers onstage and a statue of a dragon. He would have cruised to victory if he’d been in competition, especially because of his ability to hold high notes close to the range only dogs can hear.
paras.zh: 欧洲电视网对于像杰夫·萨图尔这样的间隔表演者的问题是，他们的舞台技巧、歌唱能力和旋律往往比参赛艺术家好一百万倍。 Satur 在 Spotify 上拥有 140 万每月听众和超过 500 万 Instagram 粉丝，舞台上有数十名营地舞者和一尊龙雕像。如果他参加比赛的话，他一定会赢得胜利，特别是因为他能够在接近只有狗能听到的范围内保持高音。

paras.en: Simon Robinson, one of the fans who traveled to Bangkok for the Eurovision Song Contest on Saturday, said that his history with the competition is nearly as long as its seven-decade run.
paras.zh: 周六前往曼谷参加欧洲歌唱大赛的粉丝之一西蒙·罗宾逊 (Simon Robinson) 表示，他参加这项比赛的历史几乎长达七十年。

paras.en: He was eight years old when he first watched it with his family in Yorkshire, England, when Britain's Mary Hopkin finished in second place behind Ireland’s Dana.
paras.zh: 当他八岁的时候，他第一次和家人在英国约克郡观看了这场比赛，当时英国的玛丽·霍普金落后于爱尔兰的达纳，获得第二名。

paras.en: “I really liked the concept of bringing Europe together after the war,” said Mr. Robinson, 63, who now lives in Melbourne, Australia. He described the contest’s annual broadcast as a social activity for his family and neighbors.
paras.zh: “我真的很喜欢战后将欧洲团结在一起的想法，”现居澳大利亚墨尔本的 63 岁罗宾逊先生说。他将每年一度的比赛转播描述为他的家人和邻居的一项社交活动。

paras.en: “Eurovision helped to create the European identity,” he added.
paras.zh: “欧洲电视网帮助创造了欧洲身份，”他补充道。

paras.en: Other fans had their own motivations for traveling to see the contest’s first Asian edition.
paras.zh: 其他粉丝也有自己的动机前往观看该比赛的首届亚洲版。

paras.en: Some are Europeans living in Asia, on the hunt for nostalgia, while others are Americans who were eager to experience their first Eurovision.
paras.zh: 其中一些是生活在亚洲的欧洲人，正在寻找怀旧之情，而另一些则是渴望体验第一次欧洲歌唱大赛的美国人。

paras.en: Lee Hudson, an American television executive based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, said that he gets emotional when he talks about Eurovision, which he has watched since 2012.
paras.zh: 驻马来西亚吉隆坡的美国电视高管李·哈德森 (Lee Hudson) 表示，自 2012 年以来他一直观看欧洲歌唱大赛，当他谈到欧洲歌唱大赛时，他会变得情绪化。

paras.en: “The only reason I know any music from European countries is because I heard them on Eurovision,” he said. “Eurovision Asia makes sense because the musical cultures are distinct.”
paras.zh: “我知道来自欧洲国家的音乐的唯一原因是因为我在欧洲歌唱大赛上听到过它们，”他说。 “欧洲歌唱大赛亚洲赛很有意义，因为音乐文化各不相同。”

paras.en: Mr. Hudson said he still listens to Loreen’s “Euphoria,” which won the competition for Sweden in 2012.
paras.zh: 哈德森先生说他仍然听洛琳的《Euphoria》，这首歌在 2012 年为瑞典赢得了比赛。

paras.en: It was also the first Eurovision that Drew Andrea watched from his home in Sydney. A year later, he got a passport to fly to Sweden for the 2013 edition, and has attended every final since. Coming to Bangkok for Eurovision Asia was much more affordable, he said.
paras.zh: 这也是德鲁·安德里亚第一次在悉尼的家中观看欧洲歌唱大赛。一年后，他获得了飞往瑞典参加 2013 年世界杯的护照，并参加了此后的每一场决赛。他说，来曼谷参加亚洲欧洲电视网的费用要便宜得多。

paras.en: “Asia understands the brief — the kitschy costumes, the dance music,” he said.
paras.zh: “亚洲理解其中的要点——俗气的服装、舞曲，”他说。

paras.en: His top picks among the Asian performers were the Philippines’ Carmelle and Vietnam’s Toc Tien. “I think they hit the nail on the head with the song, staging, costume and traditional elements,” he said.
paras.zh: 他在亚洲表演者中的首选是菲律宾的Carmelle和越南的Toc Tien。 “我认为他们的歌曲、舞台、服装和传统元素击中了要害，”他说。

paras.en: Luca Cian, a professor of marketing at the University of Virginia who grew up in Italy, said that Eurovision built a global fan base by offering a shared cultural experience.
paras.zh: 在意大利长大的弗吉尼亚大学营销学教授卢卡·西安表示，欧洲歌唱大赛通过提供共同的文化体验建立了全球粉丝基础。

paras.en: “Millions of people across Europe watch it at the same moment,” he said. “Families have watch parties with food and drinks. There are public discussions. Rituals create community.”
paras.zh: “整个欧洲有数百万人在同一时刻观看它，”他说。 “家庭举办有食物和饮料的观看派对。有公开讨论。仪式创造社区。”

paras.en: Carmen Chung, a British accountant, said she hijacked her family’s holiday in Bangkok to attend Eurovision Asia with her brother Garry Chung, a banker who lives in Hong Kong. “We were raised on Eurovision,” she said of their childhood in Yorkshire.
paras.zh: 英国会计师卡门·钟 (Carmen Chung) 表示，她劫持了家人在曼谷的假期，与居住在香港的银行家哥哥加里·钟 (Garry Chung) 一起参加亚洲欧洲电视网 (Eurovision Asia)。 “我们是在欧洲电视网长大的，”她谈到他们在约克郡的童年时说道。

paras.en: European acts, she said, tend to copy whatever style of music won the previous year. “This year, because there are no expectations, everyone has just done their own thing,” she said. She and her brother said they were rooting for Bangladesh’s Beatmosphere, a beatboxing group that will perform an a cappella love song.
paras.zh: 她说，欧洲艺人倾向于模仿前一年获奖的音乐风格。 “今年，因为没有期望，每个人都做了自己的事情，”她说。她和她的兄弟表示，他们支持孟加拉国的 Beatmosphere，这是一个将表演无伴奏合唱情歌的口技组合。

paras.en: Martin Green, the director of the Eurovision Song Contest, said that about half of the tickets for Saturday’s final were purchased by “super fans” from outside Asia. Organizers have kept the inaugural show modest, with 11 participating countries and a 5,000-seat venue.
paras.zh: 欧洲歌唱大赛总监马丁·格林表示，周六决赛的门票中约有一半是由亚洲以外的“超级粉丝”购买的。主办方对首届展会保持低调，共有 11 个国家参与，场馆设有 5,000 个座位。

paras.en: Mr. Andrea said he didn’t mind the small scale.
paras.zh: 安德里亚先生说他不介意规模小。

paras.en: “I’m O.K. with humble beginnings as long as it keeps growing every year,” he said.
paras.zh: “我可以接受卑微的出身，只要它每年都能持续增长，”他说。

paras.en: The presenters are talking to the artists in the green room and trying to get them to talk excitedly about Bulgaria, the country that will host the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest. The winner tonight might get to perform at that event. That seems to be making this show less about Asia itself than a spin-off of the main Eurovision event
paras.zh: 主持人正在休息室与艺术家们交谈，试图让他们兴奋地谈论即将主办 2027 年欧洲歌唱大赛的国家保加利亚。今晚的获胜者可能会在那场活动中表演。这似乎使得这个节目不再是关于亚洲本身，而是欧洲歌唱大赛主要活动的衍生节目

paras.en: Eurovision voting involves two parts. Juries representing music industry professionals from each country are allocated half the votes, and the viewing public decides the other half. To try to build tension, the show always announces the jury votes first by going live to representatives from each country who reveals their top acts. In the European edition of the contest, some of those spokespeople are celebrities, and often they try to give mini speeches or make jokes. This part of the show is always awful. You have been warned.
paras.zh: 欧洲电视网投票涉及两个部分。代表各国音乐行业专业人士的评审团分配一半选票，而观众则决定另一半选票。为了营造紧张气氛，节目总是首先通过向每个国家的代表现场直播来宣布评审团的投票结果，并揭晓他们的最佳表演。在欧洲版的比赛中，一些代言人是名人，他们经常尝试发表小型演讲或开玩笑。节目的这一部分总是很糟糕。你已被警告过。

paras.en: There are a lot of European expatriates in this crowd. That much is obvious when Bulgaria’s Dara, the winner of this year’s Eurovision, takes the stage with her winning song, “Bangaranga.” Some fans even danced along with her choreography!
paras.zh: 这群人中有很多欧洲侨民。当今年欧洲歌唱大赛冠军保加利亚选手达拉带着她的获奖歌曲《Bangaranga》登上舞台时，这一点就显而易见了。有些粉丝甚至跟着她的舞蹈一起跳舞！

paras.en: Mohamad Iqbal Dzulqarnain, an Aina Abdul fan in Kuala Lumpur, said he felt her performance was better than the recording version.
paras.zh: 吉隆坡艾娜·阿卜杜勒 (Aina Abdul) 的粉丝穆罕默德·伊克巴尔·祖尔卡南 (Mohamad Iqbal Dzulqarnain) 表示，他觉得她的表演比录音版本更好。

paras.en: “She left no crumbs,” he said. “She is going to win the contest.”
paras.zh: “她没有留下任何面包屑，”他说。 “她将赢得比赛。”

paras.en: For a competition meant to introduce the diversity of Asian pop music to the world, the lineup for the first Eurovision Song Contest Asia has several notable absences.
paras.zh: 作为一项旨在向世界介绍亚洲流行音乐多样性的比赛，首届欧洲歌唱大赛亚洲赛的阵容有几个值得注意的缺席。

paras.en: For starters, the continent’s four most populous nations — China, India, Pakistan and Indonesia — won’t be there. Even Japan, a country globally considered a cultural powerhouse, is absent.
paras.zh: 首先，非洲大陆人口最多的四个国家——中国、印度、巴基斯坦和印度尼西亚——不会出席。就连被全球视为文化强国的日本也缺席了。

paras.en: That leaves some of the region’s best-known musical cultures out of the mix. India has Bollywood hits. China has produced both Mandopop and Cantopop, the genre associated with Hong Kong pop stars. JPop was once huge across Asia.
paras.zh: 这使得该地区一些最著名的音乐文化被排除在外。印度有宝莱坞热门歌曲。中国产生了华语流行音乐和粤语流行音乐，这是与香港流行歌星相关的流派。日本流行音乐曾经风靡整个亚洲。

paras.en: As a result, the only large pop powerhouse in this contest is South Korea.
paras.zh: 因此，本次比赛中唯一的流行乐强国是韩国。

paras.en: China’s absence is relatively simple to explain. Performers are entered by local broadcasters, and Eurovision has long had a messy relationship with China’s, which are heavily regulated and try to reflect the government’s social and political values. Mango TV once had a deal to broadcast the high-camp Eurovision to Chinese viewers, but Eurovision abruptly canceled it in 2018 after Mango TV censored acts whose performances featured gay themes. It also blurred rainbow flags in the performance arena.
paras.zh: 中国的缺席相对容易解释。表演者由当地广播公司进入，欧洲电视网长期以来与中国电视网的关系很混乱，中国电视网受到严格监管，并试图反映政府的社会和政治价值观。芒果台曾与中国观众签订了向中国观众转播欧洲电视网高营的协议，但由于芒果台审查了以同性恋为主题的表演，欧洲电视网在2018年突然取消了该协议。表演场上的彩虹旗也变得模糊。

paras.en: Frank-Dieter Freiling, a former Eurovision official, said in an interview that such censorship was against Eurovision’s values and that the show’s organizers had historically barred broadcasters from airing the competition with delays.
paras.zh: 前欧洲电视网官员弗兰克-迪特·弗莱林在接受采访时表示，这种审查制度违背了欧洲电视网的价值观，而且该节目的组织者历来禁止广播公司延迟播出比赛。

paras.en: It’s less clear why broadcasters from India, Pakistan, Japan and Indonesia are not participating. Assaf Blecher, Eurovision Asia’s executive producer, said that conversations with Chinese, Japanese and Indian broadcasters had not concluded in time. But he insisted that they “are knocking on our door.”
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚为什么印度、巴基斯坦、日本和印度尼西亚的广播公司没有参加。欧洲电视网亚洲频道执行制片人阿萨夫·布莱彻表示，与中国、日本和印度广播公司的对话尚未及时结束。但他坚称他们“正在敲我们的门”。

paras.en: Not participating saves those countries the potential embarrassment of being the regional power that comes in last.
paras.zh: 不参与可以让这些国家免于成为垫底的地区强国的潜在尴尬。

paras.en: Just look to Europe, where Britain and Germany often perform badly at Eurovision. In this year’s show, Britain’s Look Mum No Computer placed last, scoring only one point, while Germany finished third from last. Whenever that happens, political commentators give interviews suggesting that the results reflect those countries’ poor standing across Europe.
paras.zh: 看看欧洲，英国和德国在欧洲歌唱大赛上经常表现不佳。在今年的节目中，英国的 Look Mum No Computer 排名垫底，仅得一分，而德国则排名倒数第三。每当这种情况发生时，政治评论员都会接受采访，暗示结果反映了这些国家在欧洲的糟糕地位。

paras.en: Here at the watch party in Kathmandu, Pratik’s relatives are happy with his performance.
paras.zh: 在加德满都的观看派对上，普拉蒂克的亲戚对他的表现感到满意。

paras.en: “His voice was cracking during the selection round in Nepal,” said Sunita Rai, his sister-in-law. “Today’s performance was much more powerful.”
paras.zh: “在尼泊尔的选拔过程中，他的声音沙哑了，”他的嫂子苏尼塔·拉伊 (Sunita Rai) 说。 “今天的表现更加厉害了。”

paras.en: His relatives have been on social media all night, urging their friends who live overseas to vote for him. (You can’t vote for your own country’s performer.)
paras.zh: 他的亲戚整晚都在社交媒体上呼吁居住在海外的朋友为他投票。 （你不能投票给自己国家的表演者。）

paras.en: The presenters have just announced a technical issue! When Laos’s Thinla performed earlier, she had an earpiece problem and was unable to hear her own music. So that explains why she sang so out of tune. They’re now playing a recording of an earlier performance to everyone to try to ensure the event is fair
paras.zh: 演示者刚刚宣布了一个技术问题！老挝的Thinla早些时候表演时，她的耳机出现了问题，无法听到自己的音乐。这就解释了为什么她唱得那么跑调。他们现在正在向每个人播放早期表演的录音，以确保活动公平

paras.en: Rizal Kamal, a senior adviser to the Arts, Live Festival and Events Association, an entertainment nonprofit based in Malaysia, said he felt that Aina Abdul was the right singer to represent the country at Eurovision.
paras.zh: 马来西亚娱乐非营利组织艺术、现场节日和活动协会的高级顾问 Rizal Kamal 表示，他认为艾娜·阿卜杜勒是代表国家参加欧洲歌唱大赛的合适歌手。

paras.en: “Aina is seasoned in major competitions and she knows how to wow both the judges and the audience,” he said. “I am filled with pride.”
paras.zh: “艾娜在重大比赛中经验丰富，她知道如何让评委和观众惊叹不已，”他说。 “我充满了自豪。”

paras.en: Aina Abdul’s inventive wardrobe and her powerful voice sets her apart from the Asian peers, said Adriana Syuhaidah, a fan in Kuala Lumpur.
paras.zh: 吉隆坡的粉丝阿德里安娜·苏海达 (Adriana Syuhaidah) 表示，艾娜·阿卜杜勒 (Aina Abdul) 富有创意的着装和强大的声音使她在亚洲同龄人中脱颖而出。

paras.en: “She is the Lady Gaga of Malaysia,” she said.
paras.zh: “她是马来西亚的 Lady Gaga，”她说。

paras.en: When they sat down to plan the final show of the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest in Asia, the organizers faced a challenge: How could they introduce variety when most of the entries were slow-paced love songs?
paras.zh: 当他们坐下来筹划首届欧洲歌唱大赛在亚洲的决赛时，组织者面临着一个挑战：当大多数参赛作品都是慢节奏的情歌时，他们如何才能引入多样性？

paras.en: Nine of the competition’s 11 participating countries picked performers singing about love in a wide range of styles, from ballads to a cappella hip-hop. Their choices suggest that the bombastic music often associated with victors of the European edition might not be a winning formula for Asian viewers.
paras.zh: 参赛的 11 个国家中有 9 个国家挑选了表演者，他们以多种风格演唱爱情，从民谣到无伴奏嘻哈。他们的选择表明，通常与欧洲版胜利者联系在一起的夸张音乐可能不是亚洲观众的获胜秘诀。

paras.en: “Europeans tend to prefer songs with a crescendo, a hook and a grand ending, but also a strong social message,” said Dean Vuletic, a historian of contemporary Europe at the University of Luxembourg who is an authority on Eurovision.
paras.zh: 卢森堡大学当代欧洲历史学家、欧洲电视网权威迪安·武莱蒂克 (Dean Vuletic) 表示：“欧洲人往往更喜欢节奏渐强、扣人心弦、结局宏大，同时还带有强烈社会信息的歌曲。”

paras.en: “The audience doesn’t want to see an innocuous pop song,” he said.
paras.zh: “观众不想看到一首无害的流行歌曲，”他说。

paras.en: Electro-pop and dance songs have featured heavily on the list of Eurovision winners over the past decade. In May, Bulgaria’s Dara won with “Bangaranga,” a dance-pop song inspired by her diagnosis with attention deficit hyperactive disorder. Nemo, from Switzerland, won in 2024 with an EDM opera about their nonbinary identity, while in 2018, Israel’s Netta won with “Toy,” a pop anthem about female independence.
paras.zh: 过去十年，电子流行歌曲和舞曲歌曲在欧洲歌唱大赛获奖者名单中占有重要地位。五月，保加利亚的 Dara 凭借《Bangaranga》获胜，这是一首流行舞曲，灵感来自于她被诊断出患有注意力缺陷多动障碍。来自瑞士的 Nemo 在 2024 年凭借一部关于非二元身份的 EDM 歌剧获胜，而在 2018 年，以色列的 Netta 凭借一首关于女性独立的流行歌曲《玩具》获胜。

paras.en: Some countries hold a nationwide contest to select an artist and a song to represent them in Eurovision, while others leave the choice to Eurovision’s local broadcasting partner. Audiences in the Philippines voted for Carmelle in a televised competition, for example, while Vietnam Television chose Toc Tien.
paras.zh: 一些国家举办全国性竞赛，选择一位艺术家和一首歌曲代表他们参加欧洲歌唱大赛，而另一些国家则将选择权留给欧洲歌唱大赛的当地广播合作伙伴。例如，菲律宾观众在电视比赛中投票给卡梅尔，而越南电视台则选择​​了托克·田。

paras.en: The two are considered front-runners in the Asian edition, with their high-energy folk-pop songs about female empowerment.
paras.zh: 两人凭借关于女性赋权的高能量民谣流行歌曲被认为是亚洲版的领跑者。

paras.en: Malaysia’s Aina Abdul, another early favorite, will showcase her powerful vocals in “Bluest Sky,” a ballad with an orchestral arrangement that is about a troubled relationship. The track is reminiscent of “Wasted Love,” an opera-techno song that won Austria the European title in 2025.
paras.zh: 另一位早期受欢迎的马来西亚歌手艾娜·阿卜杜勒 (Aina Abdul) 将在《最蓝的天空》中展示她强大的歌声，这是一首管弦乐编曲的民谣，讲述了一段陷入困境的关系。这首歌让人想起《Wasted Love》，这是一首歌剧电子歌曲，为奥地利赢得了 2025 年欧洲冠军。

paras.en: Pratik Himal Rai of Nepal, who got married this summer, said love was easy to sing about because it can be understood across borders and languages.
paras.zh: 今年夏天结婚的尼泊尔人普拉蒂克·希马尔·拉伊 (Pratik Himal Rai) 表示，爱很容易歌颂，因为它可以跨越国界和语言来理解。

paras.en: “It is love that holds the world together,” he said in an interview.
paras.zh: “是爱将世界凝聚在一起，”他在接受采访时说道。

paras.en: He will sing “Ananta Maya” in Nepali. Other Eurovision Asia artists blend English lyrics with their national languages.
paras.zh: 他将用尼泊尔语演唱“Ananta Maya”。其他欧洲歌唱大赛亚洲艺术家将英语歌词与他们的民族语言融合在一起。

paras.en: In Europe, every winning song after 2022 has been in English. That year’s champion, Ukraine's Kalush Orchestra, sang in their own language on “Stefania,” a hip-hop track that interspersed a Ukrainian lullaby with rap verses and traditional woodwind instruments.
paras.zh: 在欧洲，2022 年之后的每首获奖歌曲都是英文的。那一年的冠军，乌克兰的卡卢什管弦乐团，用他们自己的语言演唱了一首嘻哈歌曲“Stefania”，其中穿插着乌克兰摇篮曲、说唱诗句和传统木管乐器。

paras.en: Winning songs tend to blend a country’s national instruments and musical motifs with internationally trendy pop, Mr. Vuletic said.
paras.zh: 乌莱蒂克先生说，获奖歌曲往往将一个国家的民族乐器和音乐主题与国际流行流行音乐融为一体。

paras.en: A traditional Bhutanese flute can be heard in “Lhayi Semo,” Nyendra’s love ballad. Monetrey’s “I Let You Go” uses a Cambodian bamboo xylophone and a tro, a string instrument played with a bow. A kulintang, a percussion instrument made of eight brass gongs, keeps the fast beat in Carmelle’s “Sobra-Sobra.”
paras.zh: 在 Nyendra 的情歌《Lhayi Semo》中可以听到传统的不丹长笛。莫内特里的《我让你走》使用了柬埔寨竹木琴和tro（一种用弓演奏的弦乐器）。鼓林堂是一种由八个铜锣制成的打击乐器，在卡梅尔的《Sobra-Sobra》中保持快节奏。
